द: द The third letter of the dental class, and eighteenth consonant in the Deva Nagari alphabet, corresponding to the letter D.

द n. (-दं) A wife. 	 nf. (दंदा) 	 1. Gift, donation. 	 2. Dividing, cutting, breaking, &c. 	 f. (दा) 	 1. Purifying, cleansing. 	 2. Preserving, cherish-ing. 	 3. Repentance. 	 m. (दः) 	 1. A donor, a giver. 	 2. A mountain. 3. A gift, a thing given.  E. दा to give, or दो to cut, &c. affix ड.
दंश: दंश r. 1st cl. (दंशति) To bite, to sting.

दंश m. (-शः) 	 1. A gadfly. 	 2. A tooth. 	 3. Biting, stinging. 	 4. Armour, mail. 	 5. Cutting, dividing, tearing. 	 6. Fault, defect. 	 7. A joint, a limb. 	 8. The sting of a snake. 	 9. Pungency. 	 f. (-शी) A small gadfly. E. दंश् to bite or sting, affix अच्, diminutive affix ङीष् ।
दंशक: दंशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What bites or stings. 	 m. (-कः) A gadfly.  E. दंश-ण्वुल् ।
दंशन: दंशन n. (-नं) 	 1. Biting, stinging. 	 2. Armour, mail.  E. दंश् to bite, &c. भावे ल्युट् aff.
दंशभीरु: दंशभीरु m. (-रुः) A buffalo.  E. दंश a gadfly, and भीरु afraid of; also with कन् added, दंशभीरुक m. (-कः) दंशात् भीरुः ।
दंशमूल: दंशमूल m. (-लः) A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.)  E. दंश biting, and मूल a root; the root of this plant is substituted in Bengal for horseradish.
दंशित: दंशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Armed, mailed. 	 2. Bitten, stung.  E. दंश armour, and इतच् affix, or दंश to bite, affix इतच् ।
दंशेर: दंशेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mischievous, noxious.  E. दंश् to bite or sting, Unadi affix एरच् ।
दंष्ट्रा: दंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) A large tooth, a tusk.  E. दंश् to bite, affix ष्ट्रन्, and टाप् fem. aff.
दंष्ट्रिका: दंष्ट्रिका f. (-का) The beard.  E. दंष्ट्रा a tooth, इकन् aff.
दंष्ट्रिन्: दंष्ट्रिन् mfn. (-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रिणी-ष्ट्रि) 	 1. Biting or wounding with the teeth, (any animal, &c.) 	 2. Tusked, having tusks or sharp teeth. 	 3. Carnivo-rous. 	 m. (-ष्ट्री) 	 1. A hog. 	 2. A snake.  E. दंष्ट्रा a tooth, and इनि aff.
दंसन: दंसन n. (-नं) Armour, mail: see दंशन ।
दक: दक n. (-कं) Water. E. See उदक, the initial vowel being dropped.
दक्ष: दक्ष r. 1st cl. (दक्षते) 	 1. To grow or increase. 	 2. To dispatch, to expedite, to do quickly. 	 3. To go, to move. 	 4. To hurt or kill. भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् ।

दक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Clever, able, dexterous. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A Bramhadika; according to one legend, son of BRAMHA, born from the thumb of his right hand, for the purpose of peopling the world: according to another, he is the son of the Munis, called Prachetasas. DAKSHA, had sixty daughters, of whom twenty-seven are the nymphs who form the lunar asterisms, and wives of the Moon; one of his daughters also SATI or DURGA, the wife of SIVA; and seventeen were married to KASYAPA, and were the mothers of all created beings. DAKSHA was on one occasion decapitated by SIVA: see दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत्; he is sometimes regarded as an Avatara of Bramha himself. 	 2. A Muni and legislator, who flourished in the beginning of the Treta Yuga. 	 3. A kind of tree. 	 4. The bull of SIVA. 	 5. A cock. 	 6. A scholar, a Pandit. 	 7. A dexterous or clever man. 	 8. SIVA. 9. A name of Agni or fire. 	 10. A general lover, one attached to many mistresses. 	 f. (-क्षा) The earth.  E. दक्ष् to grow or increase, affix कर्त्तरि अच ।
दक्षकन्या: दक्षकन्या f. (-न्या) 	 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. Any lunar mansion.  E. दक्ष, and कन्या the maiden, the daughter of DAKSHA, who in this case seems to be identified with Himalaya, the snowy mountain.
दक्षजा: दक्षजा f. (-जा) 	 1. The goddes DURGA. 	 2. A lunar asterism.  E. दक्ष, and जा born: see the preceding.
दक्षजापति: दक्षजापति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The deity SIVA.  E. दक्षजा a lunar asterism or DURGA, and पति husband.
दक्षता: दक्षता f. (-ता) Dexterity, cleverness.  E. तल् added to दक्ष; also with त्व, दक्षत्वम् ।
दक्षयज्ञ: दक्षयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The sacrifice made by DAKSHA.  E. दक्ष, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी: दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी f. (-नी) DURGA.  E. दक्षयज्ञ, and विनाशिनी destructress.
दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत्: दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत् m. (-कृत्) A name of SIVA.  E. दक्ष the Bramhadika, as DAKSHA, अध्वर a sacrifice, ध्वंसकृत् subduer or disturber: DAKSHA having on one occasion made a sacrifice, to which he invited all the gods, except his son-in-law SIVA, and his wife SATI, the latter went unbid, and being received coolly, threw herself into the fire; This being informed siva, tore off a lock of his hair and cast it vio-lently on the ground. It started up into being a demon named Birbhadra who being ordered by siva proceeded against DAKSHA, and an affray ensued, in which the gods and Rishis were maltreated and dispersed, and DAKSHA decapitated; he was restored to life, and the head of a ram substituted for the one he had lost.
दक्षाय्य: दक्षाय्य m. (-य्यः) 	 1. The bird of VISHNU, Garuḍa. 	 2. A vulture.  E. दक्ष् to hurt, आय्य Unadi aff.
दक्षिण: दक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Candid, sincere, honest, upright. 	 2. Right, (not left.) 	 3. South, southern. 	 4. Dependent, subject. 	 5. Clever, able, dexterous. 	 f. (-णा) 	 1. A present to Brahmans, upon solemn or sacrificial occasions. 	 2. The south. 	 3. Completion of any rite, fixing or establishing any act or place. 	 4. A form or figure of DURGA, in which the right side is said to be advanced. 	 5. Dona-tion to Brahmans, personified as a goddess, said to be born from KRISHNA'S right side.  E. दक्ष् to prosper, &c. Unadi affix इनन् ।
दक्षिणकालिका: दक्षिणकालिका f. (-का) A form of DURGA worshiped by the Tantrikas. E. दक्षिण, and कालिका a form of the same.
दक्षिणतस्: दक्षिणतस् ind. Southward, southerly.  E. तसि added to दक्षिण ।
दक्षिणापथ: दक्षिणापथ n. (-थं) 	 1. The south. 	 2. Southern road or course. 	 3. Deccan. E. दक्षिण, and पथ for पथिन् path.
दक्षिणापथ m. (-थः) The south, the southern direction or quarter.  E. दक्षिणा, and पथ for पथिन् path.
दक्षिणपूर्वा: दक्षिणपूर्वा f. (-र्वा) The south-east quarter.  E. दक्षिण south and पूर्व east.
दक्षिणस्थ: दक्षिणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Upon the right side, to the south, &c. 	 m. (-स्थः) A charioteer.  E. दक्षिण as above, and स्थ who stays or abides.
दक्षिणाग्नि: दक्षिणाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) One kind of sacred fire. that which is taken from the domestic or consecrated fire, and is placed to the south. E. दक्षिण south, and अग्नि fire.
दक्षिणाग्र: दक्षिणाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Pointing to the south, having the head or top to the south.  E. दक्षिण, and अग्र end.
दक्षिणाचल: दक्षिणाचल m. (-लः) The Malaya mountain.  E. दक्षिण south, and अचल mountain.
दक्षिणाचार: दक्षिणाचार m. (-रः) A worshipper of Sakti according to the purer or right-hand ritual.  E. दक्षिण, and आचार observance.
दक्षिणात्: दक्षिणात् ind. Southward. E. The fifth case of दक्षिण, used as a participle.
दक्षिणात्यय: दक्षिणात्यय m. (-यः) A southern, or an inhabitant of South.  E. दक्षिण, अत्यय who goes to or beyond.
दक्षिणापथजन्मन्: दक्षिणापथजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A southern, or the Andhakas, Guhas, Pulin-das, Savaras, Chuchukas, and Madrapas, all outcaste or barbar-ous tribes.  E. दक्षिणापथ, and जन्मन् birth.
दक्षिणाप्रवण: दक्षिणाप्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Declining, shelving or inclining to the south.  E. दक्षिणा, and प्रवण declivity.
दक्षिणामुख: दक्षिणामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Turning the face southwards.  E. दक्षिण south, and मुख the face, with आङ् prefixed.
दक्षिणायन: दक्षिणायन n. (-नं) The suns progress towards the south of the equator, the winter solstice.  E. दक्षिण, and अयन going.
दक्षिणारण्य: दक्षिणारण्य n. (-ण्यं) The peninsula, the great southern forest.  E. दक्षिण, and अरण्य a wood.
दक्षिणार्ह: दक्षिणार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Meriting a reward.  E. दक्षिण a present, and अर्ह fit for.
दक्षिणावर्त: दक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 	 1. A conch-shell with the valve opening to the right. 2. Curved to the right. 	 3. Turned towards the south.  E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्त a turn.
दक्षिणावर्त्त: दक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 	 1. A conch-shell with the valve opening to the right. 2. Curved to the right. 	 3. Turned towards the south.  E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्त a turn.
दक्षिणावर्तकी: दक्षिणावर्त्तकी f. (-की) A line of bees.  E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्तक turning.
दक्षिणावर्त्तकी: दक्षिणावर्त्तकी f. (-की) A line of bees.  E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्तक turning.
दक्षिणाशा: दक्षिणाशा f. (-शा) The south.  E. दक्षिण, and आशा quarter.
दक्षिणाशापति: दक्षिणाशापति m. (-तिः) A name of YAMA.  E. दक्षिण south, आशा quarter, and पति master or regent.
दक्षिणीय: दक्षिणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Meriting a reward.  E. दक्षिण a present or reward, affix छ ।
दक्षिणेन: दक्षिणेन ind. Southward, southerly. E. The third case of दक्षिण, used as a participle.
दक्षिणेर्मन्: दक्षिणेर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A deer struck by a hunter.  E. दक्षिण the right side, and इर्म्म wound, comp. irr. दक्षिणे ईर्मं व्रणं यस्य ।
दक्षिणेर्म्मन्: दक्षिणेर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A deer struck by a hunter.  E. दक्षिण the right side, and इर्म्म wound, comp. irr. दक्षिणे ईर्मं व्रणं यस्य ।
दक्षिण्य: दक्षिण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Meriting a reward.  E. दक्षिण a present, and यत् aff.
दग्ध: दग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 	 1. Burnt, scorched, consumed by fire. 	 2. Tasteless. 3. A term of abuse usually prefixed to the word it vilifies. 	 f. (-ग्धा) 1. The quarter where the sun is observable. 	 2. An epithet of certain lunations, on which it is unlucky to do any thing, and religious rites are prohibited. 	 n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass.  E. दह् to burn, affix क्त ।
दग्धकाक: दग्धकाक m. (-कः) A raven, or perhaps the carrion crow.  E. दग्ध burnt, (black,) and काक crow.
दग्धव्य: दग्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be burnt.  E. दह् to burn, तव्य aff.
दग्धिका: दग्धिका f. (-का) Scorched rice.  E. दग्ध burnt, कन् depreciative affix, and the fem. form.
दग्धेष्टका: दग्धेष्टका f. (-का) A burnt or vitrified brick.  E. दग्ध burnt, and इष्टक a brick.
दग्धोदर: दग्धोदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hungry, starving. 	 n. (-रं) The appetite, an empty or craving stomach.  E. दग्ध, and उदर the belly.
दग्ध्वा: दग्ध्वा ind. Having burnt.  E. दह् to burn, क्त्वा aff.
दघ: दघ r. 1st cl. (इ) दघि (दंघति) 1. To quit or abandon. 	 2. To cherish or protect. r. 5th cl. (दघ्नोति) 	 1. To hurt or kill. 	 2. To protect: some consider this root peculiar to the Vedas. भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् इदित् । घातनार्थे स्वा० प० सक० सेट् ।
दध्न: दध्न f. (-ध्नी) A termination affixed to nouns to denote “reaching to” &c. “As high as.”
दध्न m. (-ध्नः) A name of YAMA.  E. धा to have, reiterated, and न aff.
दण्ड: दण्ड r. 10th cl. (दण्डयति-ते) 	 1. To punish, especially by fine. 	 2. To fine, to amerce. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

दण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A stick, a staff. 	 m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. Punishment, castiga-tion, amercement, imprisonment or putting to death. 	 2. A name of Yama, regent of the dead. 	 3. An army. 	 4. A form of array, a line or column of troops. 	 5. A long measure, a pole of four cubits. 	 6. A churning stick. 	 7. A corner, an angle. 	 8. A horse. 	 9. A companion or attendant of the sun. 	 10. A stem or stick of a tree. 	 11. Subduing, subjecting. 	 12. Pride, arrogance. 	 13. A measure of time, a Danda, (1/60)th part of the day and night, or twenty-four minutes. 	 14. Standing upright or erect, being like a staff. 15. A son of IKSHWAKU.  E. दम् to tame, and ड Unadi aff. or दण्ड to punish, affix अच् ।
दण्डक: दण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of metre, the stanza of which exceeds twenty-seven syllables, and may extend to 200. 	 f. (-का) The penin-sula of India, from between the Narmada and Godaveri rivers to the south, the whole of which, in the days of RAMA, was a large forest.  E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and स्वार्थे क aff.
दण्डकारण्य: दण्डकारण्य n. (-ण्यं) The peninsula, the peninsular forest: see the last. E. दण्डक, and अरण्य a wood.
दण्डग्रहण: दण्डग्रहण n. (-णं) Becoming a mendicant or ascetic.  E. दण्ड the staff carried by the mendicant, and ग्रहण taking.
दण्डघ्न: दण्डघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A fighter, one who commits personal violence.  E. दण्ड a stick, and घ्न who strikes.
दण्डजित: दण्डजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suppressed by punishment.  E. दण्ड, and जित conquered.
दण्डढक्का: दण्डढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle drum.  E. दण्ड a stick, and ढक्का a drum.
दण्डताम्री: दण्डताम्री f. (-म्री) A perforated copper vessel, of given capacity, placed in a vessel of water; when filled with water, it sinks, marking a certain portion of time.  E. दण्ड twenty-four minutes, and ताम्री (q. v.) a copper vessel, &c.
दण्डदास: दण्डदास m. (-सः) A slave, a bondsman, one who has become so as a punishment or for debt.  E. दण्ड, and दास a slave.
दण्डधर: दण्डधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Having a stick or staff. 	 2. Having authority to punish. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of YAMA. 	 2. A king. 	 3. A potter. 4. A mendicant carrying a staff.  E. दण्ड punishment, a stick, &c. and धर who holds or possesses; also दण्डधार m. (-रः) दण्डधारिन्, &c. दण्डं लगुडं वा धरति धर-अच् ।
दण्डधारण: दण्डधारण n. (-णं) 	 1. Punishment. 	 2. Carrying a staff. 	 3. Following the order of a mendicant.  E. दण्ड, and धारण having.
दण्डन: दण्डन n. (-नं) Punishing, inflicting punishment.  E. दण्ड to tame, ल्युट् aff.
दण्डनायक: दण्डनायक m. (-कः) 	 1. General, a commander-in-chief. 	 2. A magistrate, a head police officer.  E. दण्ड a column of troops, and नायक a leader.
दण्डनीति: दण्डनीति f. (-तिः) Polity, the system of civil and military administration taught by CHANAKYA and others.  E. दण्ड (by) punishment or sub-jection, नी to get or obtain, and क्तिच् aff.
दण्डनीय: दण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Punishable, deserving punishment.  E. दण्ड to punish, अनीयर् aff.
दण्डनीयत्व: दण्डनीयत्व n. (-त्वं) Demerit, desert of punishment.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, दण्डनीयता ।
दण्डपांशुल: दण्डपांशुल m. (-लः) A porter, a warder or door-keeper.  E. दण्ड a staff, पा to cherish or bear, affix ड, दण्डपः again, अंशुल for अंशल strong, sturdy.
दण्डपाणि: दण्डपाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. YAMA. 	 2. A staff-bearer. 	 3. One of SIVA'S atten-dants worshipped at Benares.  E. दण्ड, and पाणि a hand.
दण्डपातिन्: दण्डपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Awarding punishment, fining.  E. दण्ड, punishment and पातिन् causing.
दण्डपारुष्य: दण्डपारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Assault and battery, a title of jurisprudence. 	 2. Infliction of cruel punishment, one of the seven vices of kings and rulers.  E. दण्ड punishment, पारुष्य severity.
दण्डपाल: दण्डपाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A door-keeper, a porter. 	 2. A small kind of fish, (Cyprinus danrica, HAM.) See अर्द्धसफर.  E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and पाल who cherishes. दण्डं देहं पालयति भक्षणात् पालि-अण् ।
दण्डपालक: दण्डपालक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sort of fish: see the preceding, which it is supposed to resemble. 	 2. A door-keeper.  E. कन् implying likeness, or pleonastic added.
दण्डपाशिक: दण्डपाशिक m. (-कः) A hangman, an executioner.  E. दण्ड, and पाश a noose, ठक् aff.
दण्डप्रणयन: दण्डप्रणयन n. (-नं) Inflicting punishment.  E. दण्ड, and प्रणयन leading.
दण्डभीति: दण्डभीति f. (-तिः) Fear of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and भीति fear.
दण्डभृत्: दण्डभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 	 1. Having a staff or stick. 	 2. Inflicting punishment. m. (-भृत्) 	 1. A potter. 	 2. An epithet of Yama.  E. दण्ड the stick or handle of his wheel, and भृत् who possesses or works with.
दण्डमानव: दण्डमानव m. (-वः) 	 1. An ascetic, one who used a staff. 	 2. A leader. E. दण्ड, and मानव a man.
दण्डयत्: दण्डयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Punishing, amercing, chastising.  E. दण्ड to punish, शतृ aff.
दण्डयात्रा: दण्डयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Subjection or conquest of a region or quarter. 	 2. A bridal procession. 	 3. Procession, moving in state or with attend-ants.  E. दण्ड punishment, &c. and यात्रा going.
दण्डयाम: दण्डयाम m. (-मः) 	 1. A name of YAMA. 	 2. The saint AGASTYA. 	 3. A day.  E. दण्ड punishment, &c. यम् to refrain, in the causal form, and घञ् aff. दण्डेन यच्छति यम वा कर्त्तरि यम घञ् ।
दण्डयोग: दण्डयोग n. (-गं) Infliction of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and योग application.
दण्डलेश: दण्डलेश n. (-शं) A small fine.  E. दण्ड, and लेश a little.
दण्डवत्: दण्डवत् ind. Prostrate, falling or lying prostrate.  E. दण्ड a stick, and वति aff.
दण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a stick, carrying a staff.  E. दण्ड, and मतुप् aff.
दण्डवादिन्: दण्डवादिन् m. (-दी) 	 1. A door-keeper or a warder. 	 2. One who threatens another with punishment or castigation.  E. दण्ड castigation, and वद् to speak, to threaten, affix णिनि.
दण्डवालधि: दण्डवालधि m. (-धिः) An elephant.  E. दण्ड a stick, and वालधि a tail.
दण्डवासिन्: दण्डवासिन् m. (-सी) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder, a chamberlain. 	 2. The magistrate or the head of a village.  E. दण्ड a staff or mace, or punishment, &c. वस् to abide, affix णिनि ।
दण्डविकल्प: दण्डविकल्प m. (-ल्पः) Appropriate punishment or sentence.  E. दण्ड, and विकल्प alternative.
दण्डविधि: दण्डविधि f. (-धिः) Criminal law, mode of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and विधि rule.
दण्डविशेष: दण्डविशेष m. (-षः) Kind or degree of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and विशेष sort.
दण्डविष्कम्भ: दण्डविष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) A post or stake, round which plays the string that works the churning stick.  E. दण्ड a stick, स्कम्भ to stop, with वि pre-fixed, and अण् aff. दण्डं मन्थानदण्डं विष्कभ्राति । (घोलमयार खुंँटि) ।
दण्डहस्त: दण्डहस्त m. (-स्तः) 	 1. A staff-bearer. 	 2. A door-keeper. 	 n. (-स्तं) A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)  E. दण्ड, and हस्त the hand.
दण्डाजिन: दण्डाजिन n. (-नं) Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery.
दण्डादण्डि: दण्डादण्डि ind. Single stick, cudgelling, fighting with sticks or staves. E. दण्ड a stick, repeated, with आ inserted, and इच् added.
दण्डार: दण्डार m. (-रः) 	 1. A carriage, a vehicle. 	 2. A potter's wheel. 	 3. A bow or any instrument for casting arrows or darts. 	 4. An elephant in rut, a furious or intoxicated elephant.  E. दण्ड a stick, ऋ to go, and अण् aff. दण्डं ऋच्छति ।
दण्डाहत: दण्डाहत m. (-तः) Buttermilk.  E. दण्ड a churning stick, and आहत struck, churned.
दण्डिक: दण्डिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A mace-bearer, &c. one carrying a stick or staff. 	 2. A fish, (Cyprinus dankena, HAM.)  E. दण्ड a staff, and ठन् aff.
दण्डिका: दण्डिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of necklace. 	 2. A string.  E. दण्ड a measure, and इकन् aff.
दण्डित: दण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Punished, chastised, sentenced, fined.  E. दण्ड to punish, affix क्त.
दण्डिन्: दण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a staff or stick. 	 m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder, a porter, a staff or mace-bearer. 	 2. A name of YAMA. 	 3. A man of the fourth order or beggar. 	 4. A mendicant carrying a staff. 	 5. A mendicant of a particular order, derived from SANKARACHARYA. 	 6. A Jina or Jaina saint.  E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and इनि aff.
दण्डोत्पला: दण्डोत्पला f. (-ला) A small shrub; also सहदेवा । मत्स्यभेदे च ।
दण्ड्य: दण्ड्य mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) Punishable, deserving punishment.  E. दण्ड punishment, and कर्मणि यत् affix implying fitness.
दत्: दत् m. (-दन्तः-दन्तौ-दन्तः) 2nd case plu. (दतः) A tooth: see दन्त; the nasal is dropped after the 2nd case.  E. दम् to subdue, affix डत्.
दत्त: दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Given, presented, made over, assigned. 	 2. Preserved, guarded, protected. 	 m. (-त्तः) 	 1. The name of a king. 	 2. A saint; also दत्तात्रेय. 	 3. A common surname or title of a man of the Vaisya or third tribe, at present common to the Kayeth class. 	 n. (-त्तं) A gift, a donation.  E. दा to give, affix कर्मणि क्त.
दत्तक: दत्तक m. (-कः) A son given: see the next.  E. कन् added to the last.
दत्तकपुत्त्र: दत्तकपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A son given away by his natural parents, to persons engaging to adopt him; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law.  E. दत्तक, and पुत्त्र a son; also simply दत्तक, and sometimes दत्त्रिम.
दत्तवत्: दत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gave, was giving.  E. दा to give, क्तवतु aff.
दत्तशुल्का: दत्तशुल्का f. (-ल्का) A bride for whom a sum of money has been paid to her father.  E. दत्त, and शुल्क dower.
दत्तात्मन्: दत्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-given. 	 m. (-त्मा) A youth or orphan, who gives himself to persons disposed to take the place of parents. E. दत्त given, and आत्मन् self.
दत्तात्रेय: दत्तात्रेय m. (-यः) A sage, the son of ATRI given to him by three deities BRAMHA, VISHNU and SIVA.  E. दत्त, and आत्रेय son of ATRI: also दत्त.
दत्तादत्त: दत्तादत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given and received.  E. दत्त, and आदत्त taken.
दत्तादर: दत्तादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Treated with respect.  E. दत्त, and आदर respect.
दत्तानपकर्मन्: दत्तानपकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Nonresumption of gifts.  E. दत्त a gift, अन for अ neg. before अपकर्म्मन् resuming.
दत्तानपकर्म्मन्: दत्तानपकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Nonresumption of gifts.  E. दत्त a gift, अन for अ neg. before अपकर्म्मन् resuming.
दत्तापहृत: दत्तापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Given and taken again.  E. दत्त, and अपहृत taken back.
दत्ताप्रदानिक: दत्ताप्रदानिक n. (-कं) Resumption of gifts; one of the eighteen titles of law.  E. दत्त, and अप्रदानिक not giving.
दत्तावधान: दत्तावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Attentive.  E. दत्त and अवधान attention.
दत्तासन: दत्तासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a seat given, requested to sit.  E. दत्त, and आसन a seat.
दत्ति: दत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Gift, donation.  E. दा to give, क्तिन् aff.
दत्त्रिम: दत्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Given. 	 2. Produced or effected by gifts. 	 m. (-मः) 1. A slave who is given by another. 	 2. A son given by his parents. E. दा to give, क्त्रिम aff.
दत्त्वा: दत्त्वा ind. Having given.  E. दा to give, क्त्वाच् aff.
दद: दद r. 1st cl. (ददते) 	 1. To give. 	 2. To relinquish. भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
दद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who gives or bestows.  E. दद to give, and श aff.
ददत्: ददत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Giving.  E. दा to give, शतृ aff.
ददन: ददन n. (-नं) Gift, giving, donation.  E. दद to give, affix भावे ल्युट् ।
ददि: ददि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Who or what gives or bestows.  E. दा to give, कि aff.
ददिवस्: ददिवस् mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वः) Giving, who or what gives.  E. दा to give, वसु aff.
ददृत्: ददृत् mfn. (-दृत्) Fearful, alarmed.  E. दॄ to fear, क्विप् affix, and the radi-cal vowel made short.
ददृशिवस्: ददृशिवस् mfn. (-वान्-शुषी-वः) Seeing, looking.  E. दृश् to see, वसु affix, इट् inserted.
ददृश्वस्: ददृश्वस् mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वः) Seeing, looking.  E. दृश् to see, वसु aff.
दद्रु: दद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Cutaneous and herpetick eruptions; also दद्रूः or with कन् added दद्रुक m. (-कः).
दद्रुघ्न: दद्रुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A kind of cassia, (C. tora.)  E. दद्रु herpes, and घ्न destroy-ing, remedying; also दद्रूघ्न । हन्ति हन-टक् ।
दद्रण: दद्रण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Herpetick, afflicted with herpes.  E. दद्रु, and न affix; also दद्रूण.
दद्रुरोगिन्: दद्रुरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Herpetick, diseased by herpes.  E. दद्रु herpes, रोग a disease, and इनि aff.
दद्रू: दद्रू m. (-द्रूः) Herpetick eruptions: see दद्रु.

दद्रू m. (-र्द्रूः) Cutaneous eruption, herpes.  E. दरिद्रा to be poor, ऊ Una-di affix, the form is irregular: by substituting the short vowel, and omitting the first र, this word and its compounds appear in a variety of forms, as दद्रु, दद्रू, दर्द्रू; also omitting the second र, दर्द्रू, &c. &c. q. v.
दद्रूण: दद्रूण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Diseased with herpes, herpetick; also दर्द्रुण, दर्द्रूण, &c.
दध: दध r. 1st cl. (दधते) 	 1. To hold, to possess or retain. 	 2. To give, to present, to assign or make over. (इ) दधि (दन्धति) To nourish. भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
दध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Who has or possesses.  E. धा to have, श aff.
दधत्: दधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Having, holding, possessing.  E. धा to have, शतृ aff.
दधान: दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, holding, possessing.  E. धा to have, शानच् aff.
दधि: दधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Holding, having, who or what has or possesses. n. (-धि) 	 1. Milk curdled or coagulated spontaneously by heat, or by the addition of buttermilk; it is an article of food of general use, and is held in high estimation amongst the Hindus, and is con-sidered, medicinally, as the remedy or preventative of most disorders. 	 2. Resin, turpentine; (all the synonimes are common to these two senses.) 	 3. A house, an abode.  E. धा to have, कि affix, and the root reiterated.
दधिकूर्चिका: दधिकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) A mixture of boiled and coagulated milk, or of water and sour curds.  E. दधि as above, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk. (छाना) ।
दधिकूर्च्चिका: दधिकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) A mixture of boiled and coagulated milk, or of water and sour curds.  E. दधि as above, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk. (छाना) ।
दधिचार: दधिचार m. (-रः) The churning stick.  E. दधि curdled milk, and चर् to move, in the causal form, affix णिच् अण् ।
दधिज: दधिज n. (-जं) Fresh butter.  E. दधि curdled milk, and ज born.
दधित्थ: दधित्थ m. (-त्थः) The wood-apple: see कपित्थ.  E. दधि, स्था to stand or be, affix ड; the root yielding a juice compared to curdled milk.
दधिधेनु: दधिधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of curds given away at any sacrifice.  E. दधि, and धेनु a cow.
दधिपुष्पिका: दधिपुष्पिका f. (-का) A flower, (Clitorea ternata.)  E. दधि curdled milk, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added in the fem. form.
दधिफल: दधिफल m. (-लः) The elephant or wood-apple; also दधित्थ.  E. दधि curdled milk, and फल fruit, the fruit having the acid taste of Dahi or Dadhi.
दधिभाण्ड: दधिभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A vessel for holding curds, a pail.  E. दधि, and भाण्ड a vessel.
दधिमण्ड: दधिमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Whey.  E. दधि, and मण्ड scum.
दधिमण्डोद: दधिमण्डोद m. (-दः) The sea of curds, or rather of whey.  E. दधिमण्ड, and उद water.
दधिशोण: दधिशोण m. (-णः) A monkey.  E. दधि, and शोण crimson; of a colour composed of that of curdled milk and crimson.
दधिसक्तु: दधिसक्तु m. plu. always (-क्तवः) Barley meal mixed with curds.  E. दधि, and सक्तु the meal of barley, after frying and grinding.
दधिसर: दधिसर m. (-रः) The skim of coagulated milk; also सर only.  E. दधि Dahi, and सर which goes on or upon.
दधिसार: दधिसार m. (-रः) Fresh butter.  E. दधि curdled milk, and सार essence.
दधिस्नेह: दधिस्नेह m. (-हः) Skim of Dahi, or curdled milk whey.  E. दधि curdled milk, and स्नेह oily substance.
दधिस्वेद: दधिस्वेद m. (-दः) Buttermilk.  E. दधि as above, and स्वेद exudation.
दधीच: दधीच m. (-चः) The name of a Muni or saint, famous for having devoted himself to death, that the gods might be armed with his bones in the shape of thunderbolts; they being the only effective weapons against the demon VRITRA; also दधीचि.
दधीचि: दधीचि m. (-चिः) A Muni or saint: see the last.
दधीच्यस्थि: दधीच्यस्थि n. (-स्थि) 	 1. The diamond. 	 2. The thunderbolt.  E. दधीचि a saint, and अस्थि a bone; the bones of the saint were converted into thunderbolts, which are of the same substance with the diamond, according to the Hindus.
दधृच्: दधृच् mfn. (धृक्) Shameless, impudent.  E. धृष् to be vain, affix क्विन्, deriv. irr.
दध्याकर: दध्याकर m. (-रः) The sea of curds.  E. दधि, and आकर a mine.
दध्यानी: दध्यानी f. (-नी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.  E. दधि curdled milk, नी with आङ् prefixed, affix क्विप् ।
दध्याह्व: दध्याह्व m. (-ह्वः) The wood-apple.  E. दधि, and आह्वा name.
दध्युत्तर: दध्युत्तर n. (-रं) The skim of curdled milk, whey.  E. दधि, and उत्तर upper part; also with कन् added दध्युत्तरक n. (-कं.)
दध्युद: दध्युद m. (-दः) The sea of curds.  E. दधि, and उद water; that which has curds for water.
दनु: दनु f. (-नुः) A daughter of DAKSHA, wife of KASYAPA, and mother of the demons or Daityas, the Titans of Hindu mythology.
दनुज: दनुज m. (-जः) An Asura.  E. दनु the mother of the giant race, and ज born.
दनुजद्विष्: दनुजद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A god, a deity.  E. दनुज a demon, and द्विष् the hater.
दनुजारि: दनुजारि m. (-रिः) A god, a deity.  E. दनुज, and अरि enemy.
दनुसूनु: दनुसूनु m. (-नुः) An Asura or infernal deity.  E. दनु as above, and सूनु off-spring; also similar compounds, as दनुज, &c.
दन्त: दन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A tooth. 	 2. The peak of a mountain. 	 3. The side or ridge of a mountain. 	 4. An arbour. 	 5. Ivory, elephant's tooth. 	 f. (-न्ती) A medicinal plant, commonly known by the same name Dan-ti, (Croton polyandrum.)  E. दम् to subdue, तन् Unadi aff.
दन्तक: दन्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. A crooked peak or projecting in a rock or mountain. 2. A bracket, a pin or shelf projection from a wall. 	 3. A tooth. कन् implying resemblance, added to दन्त ।
दन्तकर्षण: दन्तकर्षण m. (-णः) The common lime, (Citrus acida.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and कर्षण attracting, drawing.
दन्तकाष्ठ: दन्तकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A piece of stick, or of the small branch of a tree used as a tooth brush.  E. दन्त, and काष्ठ wood.
दन्तच्छद: दन्तच्छद m. (-दः) A lip.  E. दन्त a tooth, and छद a cover.
दन्तजात: दन्तजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Toothed, having teeth.  E. दन्त, and जात produced.
दन्तधावन: दन्तधावन n. (-नं) 	 1. A tooth brush, or a fibrous stick used for cleaning the teeth. 	 2. Cleaning the teeth. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A tree yielding an astringent resin, (Mimosa catechu.) 	 2. A plant, (Mimusops elengi) see वकुल.  E. दन्त a tooth, and धाव् to clean, affix ल्युट् ।
दन्तपत्र: दन्तपत्र n. (-त्रः) An ear-ring.  E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf or plate set with studs, resembling teeth.
दन्तपत्रक: दन्तपत्रक n. (-कं) A kind of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf: the petals or leaves of the flower resembling teeth in colour and shape; this comparison is frequent among the poets.
दन्तपवन: दन्तपवन n. (-नं) A dentifrice, or any thing taken to clean the teeth. E. दन्त, and पवन purifying. दन्तं पुनाति अनेन पू करणे ल्युट् ।
दन्तपुष्प: दन्तपुष्प m. (-प्पः) A plant, the flower of which is compared to a tooth, (Strychnos potatorum.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and पुप्प a flower. कुन्दे ।
दन्तफल: दन्तफल m. (-लः) A plant: see the preceding.  E. दन्त, and फल a fruit.
दन्तभाग: दन्तभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. An elephant's front or forehead. 	 2. Part of a tooth. E. दन्त the tusk, and भाग a part.
दन्तमल: दन्तमल mn. (-लः-लं) The tarter of the teeth.  E. दन्त a tooth, and मल dirt.
दन्तमांस: दन्तमांस n. (-सं) The gums.  E. दन्त, and मांस flesh.
दन्तमूलिका: दन्तमूलिका f. (-का) A plant: see दन्ती.  E. दन्त, and मूल a root, कन् fem. form.
दन्तवस्त्र: दन्तवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A lip.  E. दन्त a tooth, and वस्त्र a garment.
दन्तवासस्: दन्तवासस् m. (-साः) A lip.  E. दन्त a tooth, and वासस् vesture.
दन्तव्यसन: दन्तव्यसन n. (-नं) Fracture or decay of a tusk or tooth.  E. दन्त, and व्यसन misfortune.
दन्तवेष्ट: दन्तवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The gums.  E. दन्त, and वेष्ट what incloses.
दन्तशट: दन्तशट m. (-टः) A lime: see the next.
दन्तशठ: दन्तशठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. Elephant or wood-apple: see कपित्थ. 	 2. Common lime, (Citrus acida.) 	 3. A plant bearing an acid fruit, (Averhoa carambola,) 	 4. An orange. 	 5. Sourness, acidity. 	 f. (-ठा) Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and शठ noxious, bad.
दन्तशर्करा: दन्तशर्करा f. (-रा) Tarter of the teeth.  E. दन्त tooth, and शर्करा sand.
दन्तशाण: दन्तशाण n. (-णं) A dentifrice, composed chiefly of the powdered fruit of the chebulic myrobalan, and green sulphate of iron.  E. दन्त a tooth, and शाण a whetstone; sharpening or polishing the teeth.
दन्तशिरा: दन्तशिरा f. (-रा) The gum.  E. दन्त, and शिरा a long vein or tubular vessel.
दन्तशुद्धि: दन्तशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Cleaning the teeth.  E. दन्त, and शुद्धि cleaning.
दन्तश्लिष्ट: दन्तश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entangled in or between the teeth.  E. दन्त, and श्लिष्ट united.
दन्तसक्त: दन्तसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Touched by the teeth; entangled in or be-tween the teeth.  E. दन्त, and सक्त in contact.
दन्तहर्ष: दन्तहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Tenderness of the teeth; intolerance of any rough, aus-tere, or acid substances.  E. दन्त, and हर्ष delight.
दन्तहर्षक: दन्तहर्षक m. (-कः) The lime, (Citrus acida.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and हर्षक de-lighting, from हृष् to please, with वुन् affix; also with युच् affix दन्त-हर्षण. 	 m. (-णः) ।
दन्ताघात: दन्ताघात m. (-तः) A bite.  E. दन्त, and आघात a wound.
दन्तावल: दन्तावल m. (-लः) An elephant.  E. दन्त a tooth, वलच् affix, and the final of दन्त made long.
दन्तायुध: दन्तायुध m. (-धः) A hog.  E. दन्त a tooth or tusk, and आयुध a weapon.
दन्तार्व्वुद: दन्तार्व्वुद m. (-दः) A disease of the teeth or gums; gum boil, ulceration of the gums.  E. दन्त a tooth, and अर्व्वुद a swelling.
दन्तालिका: दन्तालिका f. (-का) A horse's bridle.  E. दन्त a tooth, अल भूषायाम् affix ण्वुल् and fem. form.
दन्तिका: दन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Danti, (Droton polyandrum.)  E. कन् added to दन्ती; also read दन्तिजा f. (-जा.)
दन्तिन्: दन्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिती-न्ति) Toothed, tusked. 	 m. (-न्ती) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A mountain.  E. दन्त a tooth, and इनि possessive aff.
दन्तिमद: दन्तिमद m. (-दः) The temporal juice of the elephant.  E. दन्ति and मद the effusion.
दन्तीवीज: दन्तीवीज n. (-जं) A strongly purgative nut, the fruit of the croton. E. दन्ती, and वीज seed.
दन्तुर: दन्तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Having a large or projecting tooth. 	 2. Waving, undulatory. 	 3. Rising (a hair), bristling.  E. दन्त a tooth, &c. affix उरच्, उन्नता दन्ताः सन्ति अस्य ।
दन्तोद्भेद: दन्तोद्भेद m. (-दः) Dentition.  E. दन्त, and उद्भेद out-break.
दन्तोलूखलिक: दन्तोलूखलिक m. (-कः) One who eats grain without its having been threshed, an anchorite.  E. दन्त a tooth, उलूखल a mortar, and ठन् affix; who winnows with his teeth. दन्ता एव उलूखलः कण्डनसाधनं विद्यते अस्य ।
दन्त्य: दन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) Dental of or belonging to the teeth.  E. दन्त, and यत् aff.
दन्दश: दन्दश m. (-शः) A tooth. E. Frequentative form of दश to bite.
दन्दशूक: दन्दशूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, malignant, venomous. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A snake or serpent. 	 2. A Rakshasa, a demon or goblin. E. दश to bite, affix ऊक, the radical reiterated, and नुक् inserted.
दन्द्रम: दन्द्रम n. (-मं) Going slowly or tortuously.  E. द्रम् to go, root redup. घञ् aff.
दन्द्रमण: दन्द्रमण n. (-णं) Going slowly or tortuously. 	 mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Who or what goes so.  E. द्रम् to go, root redup. युच् aff.
दभ: दभ r. 10th cl. (दभयति-ते) also दभि (दम्भयति-ते) To order, to command. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
दभ्र: दभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) Little, small. 	 m. (-भ्रः) The ocean.  E. दन्भ-रक् ।
दम: दम r. 4th cl. (इर, उ) इरदमु (दाम्यति) 1. To tame or subject as an enemy to quiet or pacify, to tranquilize. 	 2. To be tamed or tranquilized. दिवा० प० अक० सेट् ।

दम m. (-मः) 	 1. Punishing, chastisement, punishment. 	 2. Taming, sub-duing. 	 3. Self-command, endurance of the most painful austerities. 4. Self-restraint, subduing the senses, suppressing the appetites, passions, &c. 	 5. Mud, mire. 	 6. (In the Vedas,) The hall of sacri-fice.  E. दम् to tame or subdue, affix भावे घञ् ।
दम्: दम् ind. A wife.  E. दम् to subject, affix क्विप् ।
दमक: दमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A tamer, a subduer.  E. दम् to tame, affix ण्वुल् ।
दमघोष: दमघोष m. (-षः) A prince of the lunar race, king of Chedi, father of SISUPALA.
दमघोषसुत: दमघोषसुत m. (-तः) A name of SISUPALA, a king and enemy of KRISHNA. E. दमघोष a proper name, the father of SISUPALA, and सुत a son.
दमथ: दमथ mn. (-थः-थं) 	 1. Punishment, punishing, chastising. 	 2. Self-control, endurance of rigorous austerities. 	 n. (-थं) Taming, subduing. E. दम् to tame or subdue, Unadi affix अथच् ।
दमथु: दमथु mn. (-थुः-थु) 	 1. Punishment, restraint or subjection of others. 	 2. Self-denial, subjection of oneself.  E. दम् to tame, अथुच् aff.
दमन: दमन m. (-नः) 	 1. A hero. 	 2. A philosopher. 	 3. A kind of flower, common-ly Dona, (Artemisia.) 	 n. (-नं) Taming, subduing.  E. दम् to tame, भावे ल्युट् aff.
दमनीय: दमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be tamed, subjected, or subdued.  E. दम् to tame, अनीयर् aff.
दमयत: दमयत mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Taming, restraining, chastising. 	 f. (-न्ती) 	 1. The wife of NALA. 	 2. A kind of cucumber.  E. दम् to subdue, parti-cipial affix शतृ.
दमस्वसृ: दमस्वसृ f. (-सा) DAMAYANTI.  E. दम, स्वसृ sister of.
दमित: दमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tamed, subdued, patient of every suffering, exaction or privation.  E. दम् to tame, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.
दमिन्: दमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) A tamer, a dominator.  E. दम with शीलार्थे घिनुण् aff.
दमुनस्: दमुनस् m. (-नाः) 	 1. A name of Agni or fire. 	 2. A name of SUKRA, regent of Venus.  E. दम् to tame (all things), Unadi affix उनसि; also ऊनसि whence दमूनस् m. (-नाः.)
दम्पति: दम्पति m. du. (-ती) Husband and wife.  E. दम् a wife, and पति a husband. जाया च पतिश्च द्वन्द्वे जायाशब्दस्य पक्षे दमादेशः ।
दम्भ: दम्भ r. 5th cl. (उ) दम्भु (दम्नोति) 1. To act deceitfully, to cheat, to impose upon, to trick or deceive. 	 2. To split or divide. r. 10th cl. (दम्भयते) To collect, to gather, to arrange or string. स्वा० प० अक० सेट् । सङ्घाते चुरा० आ० ।
दम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Deceit, fraud, cheating. 	 2. Hypocrisy. 	 3. Sin, wicked-ness. 	 4. Arrogance, pride.  E. दम्भ to deceive, &c. affix घञ्.
दम्भिन्: दम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 	 1. Hypocritical. 	 2. Proud. 	 3. Wicked. 	 m. (-म्भी) A hypocrite, an impostor.  E. दम्भ, and णिनि aff.
दम्भोलि: दम्भोलि m. (-लिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt.  E. दम्भ to divide or split, affix उलि ।
दम्य: दम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) To be subjected or tamed. 	 2. To be punished. 	 m. (-म्यः) A steer, a young bullock.  E. दम् to tame, यत् affix.
दय: दय (ञ) ञिदय r. 1st cl. (दयते) 	 1. To give. 	 2. To move. 	 3. To take. 	 4. To protect. 	 5. To hurt or kill. भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
दय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Compassionate, tender-hearted. 	 mf. (-यः-या) Tender-ness, compassion, clemency.  E. दय् to preserve, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.
दयमान: दयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Preserving, protecting.  E. दय, and शानच् aff.
दयाकर: दयाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Kind, showing compassion.  E. दया, and कर who makes.
दयाकूर्च: दयाकूर्च्च m. (-र्च्चः) A Buddha, a Bauddha saint, or a form of BUDDHA, the founder of the sect.  E. दया compassion, and कूर्च्च boasting.
दयाकूर्च्च: दयाकूर्च्च m. (-र्च्चः) A Buddha, a Bauddha saint, or a form of BUDDHA, the founder of the sect.  E. दया compassion, and कूर्च्च boasting.
दयाकृत्: दयाकृत् mfn. (-त्) Compassionate.  E. दया, and कृत् doing.
दयान्वित: दयान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compassionate, charitable, kind.  E. दया, and अन्वित possessed of.
दयायुक्त: दयायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Compassionate, benevolent.  E. दया, and युक्त joined.
दयाल: दयाल m. (-लः) The breaking of a bank.
दयालु: दयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Tender, compassionate.  E. दया compassion, आलुच् affix; also दयालुक.
दयालुत्व: दयालुत्व n. (-त्वं) Tenderness, compassionateness.  E. त्व added to the last; with तल् दयालुता ।
दयावत्: दयावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Merciful, tender,  E. दया, and मतुप् aff.
दयाशील: दयाशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Kind, compassionate.  E. दया, and शील poss-essed of.
दयित: दयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beloved, dear, desired. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A husband. 	 2. A lover. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A woman. 	 2. A wife or mistress.  E. दय् to regard tenderly, affix क्त ।
दयिताधीन: दयिताधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hen-pecked, subject to a wife.  E. दयिता a wife, and अधीन subject.
दर: दर mn. (-रः-रं) 	 1. Fear, terror. 	 2. A hole in the ground. 	 n. (-रं) A conch-shell. ind. A little. 	 f. (-रा-री) 	 1. A natural or artificial excavation in a mountain, a cave, a cavern, a grotto, &c. 	 2. A valley.  E. दॄ to divide, to dread, &c. affix भावे अप् ।
दरणि: दरणि m. (-णिः) An eddy, a current.  E. दॄ to tear (down the banks), affix अनि; some books read दारणि, and others आरणि.
दरद्: दरद् f. (-त्) 	 1. Terror. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A precipice. 	 4. The heart. 	 5. A bank or mound. 	 6. A tribe of barbarians.  E. दॄ to divide or tear, अदि Unadi aff.
दरद: दरद mf. (-दः-दा) A country bordering on Kashmir, the mountains about Kashmir and above Peshawar. 	 m. (-दः) 	 1. Fear, terror. 	 2. A tribe of barbarians.  E. अच् added to the former.
दरविदलित: दरविदलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Slightly or a little burst or opened.  E. दर, and विदलित divided.
दरि: दरि f. (-रिः) A cave: see दर.  E. दॄ to divide, इन् aff.
दरित: दरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Frightened, terrified. 	 2. Torn, rent, divided. E. दर fear, इतच् affix; or दॄ to divide, affix क्त.
दरिद्र: दरिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Poor, needy, indigent, distressed.  E. दरिद्रा to be poor, affix क ।
दरिद्रता: दरिद्रता f. (-ता) Poverty, indigence.  E. दरिद्र, and तल् affix; also with त्व दरिद्रत्वम् ।
दरिद्रा: दरिद्रा r. 2nd cl. (दरिद्राति) 3rd plu. (दरिद्रति) To be poor or needy. अदा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
दरिद्रायक: दरिद्रायक mfn. (कः-का-कं) Poor, distressed.  E. दरिद्रा, and ण्वुल् aff.
दरिद्रित: दरिद्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Poor, impoverished.  E. दरिद्रा to be poor, affix क्त.
दरिद्रितृ: दरिद्रितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Poor, needy.  E. दरिद्रा, and तृच् affix; otherwise with ण्वुल् affix दरिद्रायक ।
दरीभू: दरीभू f. (-भूः) A cavern, a hollow.  E. दरी, and भू a place.
दरीभृत्: दरीभृत् m. (-भृत्) A mountain.  E. दरी a cave, and भृत् what has.
दरोदर: दरोदर m. (-रः) 	 1. A gamester. 	 2. A stake. 	 n. (-रं) Gambling: see दुरोदर.
दर्दर: दर्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cracked, flawed, slightly broken, (a vessel, &c.) m. (-रः) A mountain.  E. दॄ to tear or break, affix अच्, and the root repeated.
दर्दराम्र: दर्दराम्र m. (-म्रः) A sort of sauce or condiment; also मीनाम्रीण ।
दर्दरीक: दर्दरीक mn. (-कः-कं) A musical instrument. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. A frog.  E. दॄ to tear, Unadi affix ईकन्, and the radical reduplicate; what is struck, &c.
दर्दुर: दर्दुर m. (-रः) 	 1. A frog. 	 2. A cloud. 	 3. A mountain. 	 4. A sort or mu-sical instrument, a pipe or flute. 	 n. (-रं) A number of villages. 	 f. (-रा) A name of DURGA.  E. दॄ to tear, Unadi affix उरच्, and the ra-dical repeated.
दर्दुरपुट: दर्दुरपुट m. (-टः) The mouth or extremity of a pipe.  E. दर्दुर, and पुट a cup.
दर्द्रु: दर्द्रु m. (-र्द्रुः) Herpetick eruption: see दर्द्रू.
दर्द्रू: दर्द्रू m. (-र्द्रूः) A cutaneous disease, herpes; also दर्द्रू.
दर्द्रूघ्न: दर्द्रूघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Cassia, (tora:) also दद्रुघ्न and दर्द्रूघ्न.
दर्द्रूरोगिन्: दर्द्रूरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Herpetic, afflicted with herpes; also दर्द्र रोगिन्, दर्द्रु रोगिन्, &c.
दर्प: दर्प m. (-र्पः) 	 1. Pride, arrogance. 	 2. Musk. 	 3. Heat.  E. दृप् to be proud, to inflame, affix भावे घञ्, कर्त्तरि अच् वा ।
दर्पक: दर्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What kindles, inflames, or excites, m. (-कः) A name of KAMADEVA.  E. दृप् to inflame, affix ण्वुल्.
दर्पण: दर्पण m. (-णः) A mirror. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Kindling, inflaming. E. दृप् to excite, to shine, affix ल्यु ।
दर्पध्मात: दर्पध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Puffed up or swelling with pride.  E. दर्प, and ध्मात inflated.
दर्पह: दर्पह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Humbling, humiliating, pride-destroying.  E. दर्प, and ह what removes.
दर्पारम्भ: दर्पारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Incipient pride, conceit.  E. दर्प pride, आरम्भ commencement.
दर्पोपशान्ति: दर्पोपशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Conciliating or subduing arrogance.  E. दर्प, and उप-शान्ति allaying.
दर्ब: दर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) 	 1. A Rakshasa, an imp or goblin. 	 2. A mischievous man or animal, &c.  E. दॄ to tear, Unadi affix ब.
दर्ब्ब: दर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) 	 1. A Rakshasa, an imp or goblin. 	 2. A mischievous man or animal, &c.  E. दॄ to tear, Unadi affix ब.
दर्बट: दर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A constable, police officer set over a village, &c. 	 2. A warder, a door-keeper.
दर्ब्बट: दर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A constable, police officer set over a village, &c. 	 2. A warder, a door-keeper.

दर्ब्बि: दर्ब्बि f. (-र्ब्बिः-र्ब्बी) 	 1. A ladle or spoon. 	 2. The expanded hood of a snake.  E. दॄ to divide, Unadi affix बि; also with ङीप् added दर्ब्बी; some authorities made the final consonant the labial letter व, as as दर्व्वि, दर्व्वी; also दार्व्वी.
दर्ब्बिक: दर्ब्बिक m. (-कः) A ladle, a spoon. 	 f. (-का) A potherb: see दार्ब्बिका. E. कन् added to the preceding.
दर्ब्बीकर: दर्ब्बीकर m. (-रः) A snake.  E. दर्ब्बी the hood expanded, and कर who makes.
दर्भ: दर्भ m. (-र्भः) 	 1. Kusa or sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) 	 2. A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 	 3. Another species, (S. cylindricum.)  E. दृभि to collect, to arrange, affix घञ्; or दॄ to tear, Unadi affix भ.
दर्भट: दर्भट m. (-टः) A private apartment or house, a retirement.
दर्भपत्र: दर्भपत्र m. (-त्रः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)  E. दर्भ, and पत्र a leaf.
दर्श: दर्श m. (-र्शः) 	 1. Sight, seeing. 	 2. Day of new moon when it rises in-visible. 	 3. Half monthly sacrifice, performed at the change of the moon, by persons maintaining a perpetual fire.  E. दृश् to see, affix आधारे घञ्.

दर्शत: दर्शत m. (-तः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The moon.  E. दृश् to see, कर्मणि अतच् aff.
दर्शन: दर्शन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sight, seeing, looking. 	 2. The eye. 	 3. A Mirror. 	 4. Show-ing. 	 5. Aspect, appearance. 	 6. Directing, instructing. 	 7. A dream, a vision. 	 8. Virtue, moral merit. 	 9. Knowledge, especially religi-ous. 	 10. Understanding, intellect. 	 11. A Sastra, one of six religi-ous or philosophical systems, the Patanjala, Sankhya, Vaiseshika, Nyaya, Mimansa, and Vedanta. 	 12. Sacrifice. 	 13. Colour. 	 14. Vi-siting any sacred shrine, worshipping in the presence of any image. E. दृश् to see, affix भावकरणादौ ल्युट् ।
दर्शनप्रतिभू: दर्शनप्रतिभू m. (-भूः) A surety for appearance.  E. दर्शन, and प्रतिभू a surety.
दर्शनप्रातिभाव्य: दर्शनप्रातिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) Surety for appearance, bail.  E. दर्शन, and प्रातिभाव्य surety.
दर्शनीय: दर्शनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Beautiful, handsome, agreeable. 	 2. Visible, to be seen.  E. दर्श looking, and छ affix; or दृश् to see, and अनीयर् aff.
दर्शनीयमानिन्: दर्शनीयमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Vain, conceited, thinking oneself hand-some.  E. दर्शनीय, मन् to mind, णिनि aff.
दर्शयामिनी: दर्शयामिनी f. (-नी) The night or new moon, on which it rises invisible. E. दर्श new moon, and यामिनी night.
दर्शयितृ: दर्शयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Showing, displaying, who or what shows. 	 m. (-ता) 	 1. A warder, an usher, a door-keeper. 	 2. A show man, a guide, an exhibiter.  E. दृश् to see, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.
दर्शयित्वा: दर्शयित्वा ind. Having shown, having made manifest.  E. दृश् to see, causal form, क्त्वाच् aff.
दर्शयिष्यत्: दर्शयिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Showing, explaining or proposing to shew or explain.  E. दृश् to see, causal form, शतृ affix, with a future sense.
दर्शविपद्: दर्शविपद् m. (-द्) The moon.  E. दर्श day of new moon, and विपद् trouble.
दर्शित: दर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Visible, apparent. 	 2. Shown, displayed. 	 3. Explained. 	 4. Seen. 	 5. Understood.  E. दृश् to see, in the causal form, affix णिच् and क्त ।
दर्शितवत्: दर्शितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Having shown, showing, displaying. 2. Explaining, teaching.  E. दृश causal form, क्तवतु aff.
दल: दल r. 1st cl. (दलति) r. 10th cl. (दालयति-ते) 	 1. To cut, to divide, to split or pierce. 	 2. To be cut, &c. 	 3. To display. 	 4. To wither. भ्वा० अक० भेदे सक० भेदने सेट् । भेदने चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

दल mn. (-लः-लं) A leaf. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. A part, a portion, a fragment. 	 2. Dividing, tearing, cutting, splitting, &c. 	 3. A sheath, a scabbard. 4. An adulteration or alloy. 	 5. A heap or quantity. 	 6. The leaf of Tamala. 	 7. A half.  E. दल् to divide, to cut, &c. affix अच्.
दलकपाट: दलकपाट m. (-टः) A folded petal or leaf.  E. दल, and कपाट a door.
दलकोष: दलकोष m. (-षः) A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)  E. दल a leaf, and कोष a sheath.
दलत्: दलत् mfn. (-लत्-लन्ती-लत्) 	 1. Splitting, rending. 	 2. Being torn or cut. E. दल् to cut or be pierced, affix शतृ ।
दलद्धृदय: दलद्धृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Broken-hearted, cut to the heart, &c.  E. दलत्. and हृदय the heart.
दलन: दलन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Breaking to pieces, cutting, dividing, (who or what does so.) 	 n. (-नं) Tearing, rending, breaking, pulling to pieces. 	 f. (-नी) A clod or clump of earth or mould.  E. दल् to divide, affix करणे ल्युट् ।
दलनिर्मोक: दलनिर्म्मोक m. (-कः) The Bhurjapatra, a tree of which the bark is used, for hookah snakes, &c.  E. दल a leaf, and निर्म्मोक shedding, casting off.
दलनिर्म्मोक: दलनिर्म्मोक m. (-कः) The Bhurjapatra, a tree of which the bark is used, for hookah snakes, &c.  E. दल a leaf, and निर्म्मोक shedding, casting off.
दलप: दलप m. (-पः) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A sacred or religious institute.  E. दल् to be divided, Unadi affix कपन्.
दलपुष्पी: दलपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)  E. दल a leaf, and पुष्प a flower; the leaves surrounding the flower. केतक्याम् ।
दलसूचि: दलसूचि m. (-चिः) A thorn.  E. दल a leaf, and सूचि a needle.
दलस्नसा: दलस्नसा f. (-सा) The fibre or vein of a leaf.  E. दल a leaf, and स्नसा a fibre. पत्रशिरायाम् ।
दलाढक: दलाढक m. (-कः) 	 1. Sesamum growing wild or spontaneously. 	 2. An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 	 3. A plant commonly Nageshwara, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 4. A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) 	 5. Red chalk. 	 6. Cuttle fish bone. 	 7. A moat, a ditch. 	 8. A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) 9. An elephant's ear. 	 10. The driver of an elephant. 	 11. A hurri-cane, a high wind.  E. दल as above, ढौकृ to go, with आङ् prefix-ed, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
दलाढ्य: दलाढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) Mud, but mud especially on the banks of a river.
दलामल: दलामल n. (-लं) 	 1. A tree, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मरुवक. 	 2. A plant, (Artemisia.)  E. दल a leaf, and अमल clear, clean.
दलाम्ल: दलाम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sorrel.  E. दल the leaf, and अम्ल sour.
दलि: दलि mf. (-लिः-ली) A clod of clay or mould.  E. दल् to be divided, (by the harrow or plough,) Unadi affix इ ।
दलिक: दलिक m. (-कः) Timber, wood.  E. दल् to split, affix इकच् ।

दल्भ: दल्भ m. (-ल्भः) 	 1. Fraud, dishonesty. 	 2. Sin. 	 3. The name of a Muni or saint. 	 4. A wheel.  E. दल् to divide, and भ Unadi affix.

दवथु: दवथु m. (-थुः) 	 1. Anxiety, vexation, distress. 	 2. Inflammation of the eye, &c.  E. दु to be agitated, अथुच् aff.

With उप, to be in trouble, to be reduced in circumstances. With सम्, to pinch, to nip, to bite. दीप्तौ चु० उभ० अक० सेट् इदित् । दंशनार्थे चु० आत्म० and भ्वा० प० ।

दशधा: दशधा ind. In ten ways.  E. दश, and धाच् aff.
दशन्: दशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Ten.  E. दश् to bite, Unadi affix अन्, the nasal rejected.

दशनवासस्: दशनवासस् n. (-सः) A lip.  E. दशन tooth, and वासस् vesture.

दशनाङ्क: दशनाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bite, the mark of the teeth.  E. दशन, and अङ्क a mark.
दशनाढ्या: दशनाढ्या f. (-ढ्या) A kind of sorrel.
दशनोच्छिष्ठ: दशनोच्छिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Toothless. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) 	 1. Breathing, breathing out, expiration. 	 2. A lip. 	 3. Kissing, a kiss.  E. दशन a tooth, and उच्छिष्ठ expelled, ejected.
दशपारमिताधर: दशपारमिताधर m. (-रः) A Buddha or Bauddha saint.  E. दश, पारमिता a particular work or scripture of this sect, धर who has.
दशपुर: दशपुर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus:) see दाशपुर. 	 2. A district, part of Malwa or Bundelkhand. 	 3. A town or city.  E. दश for दाश a fisherman, and पुर or पूर to nourish, affix दश; also दश ten, and पुर a city: district of ten cities.
दशपूर: दशपूर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass: see the preceding; also दाशपूर.
दशबल: दशबल m. (-लः) A Buddha of Bauddha teacher.  E. दश ten, (the ten worlds,) बल powerful.

दशम: दशम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Tenth. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. The tenth day of the half month. 	 2. The tenth or last stage of human life, the last ten years of a century.  E. दशन् ten, and मट् aff.
दशमहाविद्या: दशमहाविद्या f. (-द्या) DURGA.  E. दश ten, (forms, or names,) महा great, and विद्या a name of DURGA.
दशमाल: दशमाल nf. (-लं-ली) A collection of ten garlands.  E. दश ten, माला a garland, टच् aff.
दशमिन्: दशमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Very old or aged.  E. दशमी the tenth, (stage of life,) and इनि aff.

दशमुख: दशमुख m. (-खः) A name of RAVANA.  E. दश ten, and मुख a face.
दशमुखान्तक: दशमुखान्तक m. (-कः) A name of RAMA.  E. दशमुख RAVANA, and अन्तक destroyer.
दशमूल: दशमूल n. (-लं) A tonic medicament prepared from the roots of ten plants.  E. दश ten, and मूल a root.

दशरात्र: दशरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of ten days and nights.  E. दश, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
दशरूपभृत्: दशरूपभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) A name of VISHNU.  E. दश ten, रूप forms, (Ava-taras,) and भृत् who assumes.
दशलक्षण: दशलक्षण n. (-णं) Ten marks or attributes.  E. दश, and लक्षण a mark.
दशवाजिन्: दशवाजिन् m. (-जी) The moon.  E. दश ten, and वाजिन् a horse, whose car is drawn by ten horses.
दशशत: दशशत n. (-तं) A thousand.  E. दश, and शत a hundred.
दशसहस्र: दशसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A myriad.  E. दश, and सहस्र a thousand.
दशा: दशा f. (-शा) or m. plu. (-शाः) 	 1. The ends of a piece of cloth, the end of a garment. 	 2. A state, a condition, a period or time of life, as youth, age, manhood, &c. 	 3. The wick of a lamp. 	 4. The mind or faculty, of understanding. 	 5. Aspect or position of the planets at birth.  E. दश् to bite, to cut or divide, or be cut or divided, अङ् aff.
दशाकर्ष: दशाकर्ष m. (-र्षः) A lamp.  E. दशा a wick, आकर्ष what possesses.
दशाकर्षिन्: दशाकर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) A lamp.  E. दशा a wick, आङ् before, कृष् to make lines, affix इनि.
दशानन: दशानन m. (-नः) The giant RAVANA.  E. दश ten, and आनन a face.
दशानिक: दशानिक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
दशाफल: दशाफल n. (-लं) Result of circumstance of the condition of life.  E. दशा, and फल fruit.
