दुर्गलङ्घन: दुर्गलङ्घन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. Overcoming difficulties, making way through arduous passages or affairs, &c. 	 m. (-नः) A camel.  E. दुर्ग, and लङ्घन who traverses.
दुर्गव्यसन: दुर्गव्यसन n. (-नं) Defect in a citadel, its being ill-guarded, &c.  E. दुर्ग, and व्यसन misfortune.
दुर्गसञ्चर: दुर्गसञ्चर m. (-रः) 	 1. Progress or passage through an almost impervious or inaccessible spot. 	 2. A bridge, &c. or any contrivance for pass-ing a river, a defile, &c.  E. दुर्ग a defile, &c. सञ्चर going; also with संचार, दुर्गसंचार m. (-रः) सम् + चर करणे अप् ।
दुर्गसम्पद्: दुर्गसम्पद् f. (-द् or -त्) Essential part of a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and सम्पद् wealth.
दुर्गाधिकारिन्: दुर्गाधिकारिन् m. (-री) The governor of a fort.  E. दुर्ग, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.
दुर्गाध्यक्ष: दुर्गाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The governor of a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and अध्यक्ष super-visor.
दुर्गानवमी: दुर्गानवमी f. (-मी) The ninth of the light half of Kārtik, sacred to DURGĀ as JAGADDHĀTRI form.  E. दुर्गा, and नवमी the ninth.
दुर्गावरोध: दुर्गावरोध m. (-धः) Investing or besieging a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and अवरोध investing.
दुर्गाश्रयण: दुर्गाश्रयण n. (-णं) Taking refuge in a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and आश्रयण seeking shelter.
दुर्घोष: दुर्घोष (-षः-षा-षं) Harsh-voiced, roaring, bellowing. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. A bear. 2. A loud or disagreeable cry.  E. दुर्, and घोष sound.
दुर्जन: दुर्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Bad, wicked, vile. 	 2. Malicious, mischief-mak-ing. 	 m. (-नः) A bad man.  E. दुर् bad, vile, जन a man. दुष्टो जनः प्रा० स० ।
दुर्जनत्व: दुर्जनत्व n. (-त्वं) Wickedness, villainy.  E. त्व added to दुर्जन; also with तल् affix दुर्जनता ।
दुर्जय: दुर्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Invincible, difficult to be subdued or overcome, E. दुर्, and जय victory. दुःखेन जीयते दुर् + जि कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्जर: दुर्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult of digestion, indigestible.  E. दुर्, and जर digesting. दुःखेन जीर्य्यति जॄ-अच् ।
दुर्जात: दुर्जात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inauspiciously born or produced. 	 2. Improper. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Misfortune, calamity. 	 2. Disparity, unconformity, impro-priety.  E. दुर् bad, जात born. दुष्टं जातम् प्रा० स० ।
दुर्जाति: दुर्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 	 1. Vile, wicked. 	 2. Low, outcaste.  E. दुर्, जाति kind.
दुर्ज्ञेय: दुर्ज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Difficult to be known or understood.  E. दुर्, and ज्ञेय to be known. दुःखेन ज्ञायते ज्ञा + कर्मणि यत् ।
दुर्णय: दुर्णय m. (-यः) Want of conduct, impropriety, impolicy.  E. दुर्, and नय policy.
दुर्णीत: दुर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Ill-behaved, ill-governed. 	 2. Impolitic. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Misconduct. 	 2. Impolicy.  E. दुर and नीत conducted.
दुर्णीति: दुर्णीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Impolicy. 	 2. Misconduct.  E. दुर्, and नीति policy.
दुर्दम: दुर्दम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Difficult to be subdued.  E. दुर्, and दम taming. दुःखेन दम्यते असौ दुर + दम-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्दर: दुर्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Tearing. 	 2. Distressing. 	 m. (-रः) A kind of drug, Rishabha.  E. दुर्, and दर what tears.
दुर्दर्श: दुर्दर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Dazzling painful to the sight. 	 2. Difficult to be seen or met with.  E. दुर्, and दृश seeing. दुःखेन दृश्यते असौ दुर् + दृश्-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्दान्त: दुर्दान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Untameable, intractable, difficult to be res-trained or disciplined. 	 m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Strife, tumult. 	 2. A caff.  E. दुर्, and दान्त daunted. दुःखेन दान्तः दमितः दमि + क्त वा नि० ।
दुर्दिन: दुर्दिन n. (-नं) 	 1. A dark or cloudy day. 	 2. Rain, or cloudy and rainy weather.  E. दुर् bad, vile, दिन a day. दुष्टं दिनम् प्रा० स० ।
दुर्दुरुट: दुर्दुरुट m. (-टः) An atheist.  E. दुर् vile, repeated, अट् to go or be, affix घञ्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.
दुर्दृष्ट: दुर्दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ill seen, (literally or figuratively) ill-examined, imperfectly investigated. 	 2. Looked at with an evil eye.  E. दुर् bad, दृष्ट seen.
दुर्दैव: दुर्दैव n. (-वं) Bad luck, misfortune.  E. दुर्, and दैव fate.
दुर्द्धरुट: दुर्द्धरुट m. (-टः) A pupil who obeys his teacher only after judging of the propriety or obedience.
दुर्द्रुम: दुर्द्रुम m. (-मः) A green onion.  E. दुर् bad, and द्रुम a tree: see दुद्रुम.
दुर्द्धर्ष: दुर्द्धर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 	 1. Difficult of attainment or approach. 	 2. Haughty, distant.  E. दुर्, pride. दुःखेन धृष्यते असौ दुः + धृष-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्धर: दुर्धर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be sustained or borne, troublesome, unbearable. 	 2. Irresistible, difficult to be restrained. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A division of hell. 	 2. A kind of drug, commonly Rishabha. 	 3. The name of an Asura or Titan.  E. दुर् bad, ill, धर having, possessing; it is also written दुर्द्धर । दुःखेन धार्य्यते दुर् + धृ-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्नामक: दुर्नामक n. (-कं) Hæmorrhoids.  E. दुर्, bad नामन् a name, and कप् added; see the next.
दुर्नामन्: दुर्नामन् mf. (-मा-म्नी) A cockle. 	 n. (-म) Piles or hæmorrhoids. E. दुर्, bad and नामन् a name, fem. affix, टाप् or ङीष्; also in the first sense, with a final vowel दुर्नामा. 	 f. (-मा) ।
दुर्निग्रह: दुर्निग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Ungovernable, difficult of restraint.  E. दुर्, and निग्रह restraint.
दुर्निवार: दुर्निवार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be stopped, hindered, condradict-ed, &c. Invincible, unconquerable.  E. दुर्, and निवार resistance.
दुर्निरीक्ष्य: दुर्निरीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Hard to be looked at, as the sun, &c. E. दुर and निरीक्ष्य to be seen.
दुर्ब: दुर्ब r. 1st cl. (इ) दुर्बी (दूर्बति) To hurt, to injure, to wound, to kill दूर्ब, &c.
दुर्बल: दुर्बल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Feeble, thin, emaciated. 	 2. Weak, impotent. 	 m. (-ल्) One who is circumcised, or whose glans penis is void of pre-puce.  E. दुर् implying depreciation or diminution, and बल strong, potent. दुःस्थितं बलमस्य ।
दुर्बुद्धि: दुर्बुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Silly, ignorant.  E. दुर्, and बुद्धि under-standing.
दुर्भक्ष्य: दुर्भक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be eaten with difficulty.  E. दुर्, and भक्ष्य eating.
दुर्भगा: दुर्भगा f. (-गा) 	 1. A wife not loved or liked by her husband. 	 2. A bad or ill tempered woman.  E. दुर् little or ill, भग affection.
दुर्भर: दुर्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Burdensome, troublesome, hard to be supported. E. दुर्, and भर what bears.
दुर्भिक्ष: दुर्भिक्ष n. (-क्षं) Dearth, famine.  E. दुर्, and भिक्षा alms; when charity ceases.
दुर्भाग्य: दुर्भाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unfortunate, unlucky.  E. दुर्, and भाग्य fortune.
दुर्भेद्य: दुर्भेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 	 1. To be broken with difficulty. 	 2. Firm, con-stant, not easily disunited.  E. दुर्, and भेद्य to be broken.
दुर्मति: दुर्मति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Silly, ignorant, simple, a blockhead.  E. दुर्, and मति mind.
दुर्मनस्: दुर्मनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Sad, distressed, meditating or thinking sor-rowfully.  E. दुर् distress, मनस् the mind.
दुर्मर: दुर्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dying. with difficulty, retentive of life: f. (-र्) Bent grass: see दूर्व्वा.  E. दुर् with difficulty, मृ so perish, affix अच् ।
दुर्मल्लिका: दुर्मल्लिका f. (-का) A minor drama, a comedy, a farce.
दुर्मुख: दुर्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) 	 1. Scurrilous, foul-mouthed. 	 2. Hideous ugly. 	 m. (खः) 	 1. One of the monkey chiefs. 	 2. One of the principal Nagas or serpents. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. An Asura.  E. दुर् bad, ill, मुख mouth or face.
दुर्मूल्य: दुर्मूल्य n. (-ल्यं) Any thing of high price or value.  E. दुर्, and मूल्य price.
दुर्मेधस्: दुर्मेधस् mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः) Of little or contemptible understanding, dull, stupid, ignorant, uninformed.  E. दुर् bad, मेधस् understanding.
दुर्योधन: दुर्योधन m. (-नः) The elder of the Kuru princes, and leader in the war against his cousins, the Pāndus and KRISHNA.  E. दुर् vile, ill, युध् to make war, affix युच्; the author and leader of an unjust warfare.
दुर्योनि: दुर्योनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of low or impure origin.  E. दुर्, and योनि place of birth.
दुर्लभ: दुर्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 	 1. Difficult of attainment. 	 2. Excellent, eminent. 3. Dear, beloved. 	 m. (-भः) A plant, (a sort of Hedysarum:) see
दुरालभा: दुरालभा f. (-भा) A prickly nightshade.  E. दुर् difficult, लभ् to gain, affix खल् but without any nasal.
दुर्वच: दुर्वच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 	 1. Speaking ill or improperly. 	 1. Speaking in pain. 	 3. Difficult of utterance or articulation. 	 4. What ought not to be spoken. 	 n. (-चं) 	 1. Abuse, censure. 	 2. Evil or unlucky speech.  E. दुर्, वच् to speak. दुःखेन उच्यते दुर् + वच्-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्वचस्: दुर्वचस् n. (-चः) Abuse, bad language.  E. दुर् bad, वचस् speech.
दुर्वर्ण: दुर्वर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a bad species or class. 	 n. (-र्णं) 	 1. Silver. 	 2. A sort of perfume, commonly Elabāluka: see एलवालुक.  E. दुर् bad, vile, and वर्ण species; the reduplication of the व is optional in this and the following words. हेमापेक्षया निकृष्टो वर्णोऽस्य । रजते ।
दुर्वर्णक: दुर्वर्णक n. (-कं) Silver.  E. दुर् inferior, वर्ण species, कन् pleonasm; in-ferior as compared with gold.
दुर्वह: दुर्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be borne or supported.  E. दुर्, and वह bearing. दुःखेन उह्यते असौ दुर् + वह-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्वाच्: दुर्वाच् mfn. (-वाक्) An ill speaker, morally or physically. 	 f. (-वा) Speak-ing ill, either inelegantly or abusively.  E. दुर् ill, वाच् speech. गर्हिता वाक् प्रा० स० ।
दुर्वाच्य: दुर्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) Any unlucky or ill omened speech. 	 2. censure, abuse. E. दुर् improperly, वाच्य to be spoken. दुष्टं निन्द्यं वाच्यम् प्रा० स० ।
दुर्वाद: दुर्वाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who speaks ill, (grammatically, &c.) or one who utters abusive or unbecoming language.  E. दुर् ill, bad, वाद speaking. दुष्टो वादः प्रा० स० ।
दुर्वार: दुर्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Irresistible, not to be prevented or checked. E. दुर् and वार preventing. दुःखेन वार्य्यते असौ दुर् + वारि-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्वासस्: दुर्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Ill dressed. 	 m. (-साः) The name of a Rishi or saint, the son of ATRI, and an incarnation or portion of SIVA, famous for his choleric temperament.  E. दुर्, and वासस् vesture.
दुर्विध: दुर्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 	 1. Poor, pauper, indigent. 	 2. Wicked, melevo-lent. 	 3. Foolish, stupid.  E. दुर् bad, ill, विध habit, custom.
दुर्विनीत: दुर्विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill mannered, ill trained or behaved. 	 m. (-तः) A restive horse.  E. दुर् with difficulty, विनीत led, managed.
दुर्विभाव्य: दुर्विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Incomprehensible, inconceivable.  E. दुर्, and विभाव्य to be observed.
दुर्विवाह: दुर्विवाह m. (-हः) A bad mode or form of marriage.  E. दुर् and विवाह marriage.
दुर्विषह: दुर्विषह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be sustained or supported.  E. दुर् and वि before, सह to bear. दुःखेन विषह्यते असौ दुर् + वि + सह कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्वृत्त: दुर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Vile, wicked, leading a low or infamous life, following disreputable habits or business, a cheat, a juggler, a rogue, a blackguard, &c.  E. दुर् bad, वृत्त to be or abide. दुष्टं वृत्तम् प्रा० स० ।
दुर्वृत्ति: दुर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Leading a disreputable life, following a degrading business, &c. 	 2. Juggling, fraud.  E. दुर्, and वृत्ति maintenance.
दुर्हन: दुर्हन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What is killed with difficulty.  E. दुर् before, हन् to kill. दुःखेन हन्यते असौ दुर् + हन-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुर्हृद्: दुर्हृद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) Inimical, ill disposed. 	 m. (-द् or -त्) An enemy. E. दुर् bad, हृद् heart. दुःस्थं हृद् हृदयमस्य प्रा० स० ।
दुर्हृदय: दुर्हृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Evil-minded, bad-hearted.  E. दुर् bad, ill, हृदय the heart.
दुल: दुल r. 10th cl. (दोलयति-ते) 	 1. To raise, to throw up. 	 2. To excite. 	 3. To shake, to swing. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
दुलि: दुलि m. (-लिः) A Muni or saint. 	 f. (-लि or -ली) A small or female tortoise.  E. दुल् to throw up, (mud, &c.) affix कि fem. affix option-ally ङीष् ।
दुश्चर: दुश्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Going with trouble of difficulty. 	 2. Acting ill, behaving wickedly. 	 3. Unattainable. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A bivalve shell. 2. bear.  E. दुर् bad, चर् to go, अच् or टच् aff.
दुश्चरित: दुश्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, abandoned, wicked. 	 m. (-तं) Misbehaviour, ill conduct, wickedness.  E. दुर् and चरित conduct.
दुश्चर्मन्: दुश्चर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting.  E. दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.
दुश्चर्म्मन्: दुश्चर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting.  E. दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.
दुश्चेष्टित: दुश्चेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, doing or besieging evil. 	 n. (-तं) Evil purpose or action, misconduct, error.  E. दुर् and चेष्टित exerted.
दुश्च्यवन: दुश्च्यवन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA.  E. दुर् ill, च्यवन the name of a saint: INDRA having raised his arm to hurl his thunderbolt at Chyavana had it fixed in that position by the curse of the saint; other ety-mologies are given.
दुश्छद: दुश्छद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tattered, hardly covered.  E. दुर् and छद covering.
दुश्शासन: दुश्शासन m. (-नः) One of the Kaurava princes.  E. दुर्, and शासन government.
दुष: दुष (इर, औ) इरदुषौ r. 4th cl. (दुष्यति) 	 1. To do or act wrong or impro-perly. 	 2. To be impure. With प्र and आङ prefixed, To become manifest or apparent. दिवा० पर० अक० अनिट् ।
दुष्कर: दुष्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be done. 	 2. One who behaves ill, does wrong, &c. wicked, bad. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Æthen atmo-sphere. 	 2. Doing any thing with pain or difficulty. E. दुर् bad, and कर what does from कृ with कर्मणि खल् aff. दुःखेन क्रियते ।
दुष्कर्मन्: दुष्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Wickedness, sin. 	 2. Any difficult or painful act. E. दुर् and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कर्म्मन्: दुष्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Wickedness, sin. 	 2. Any difficult or painful act. E. दुर् and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कुल: दुष्कुल n. (-लं) A low family or race.  E. दुर bad, कुल race.
दुष्कुलीन: दुष्कुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of a low or degraded family. 	 m. (-नः) A sort of perfume, commonly Chor.  E. दुर् bad and कुलीन family or species.
दुष्कृत: दुष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Done wrong or wickedly. 	 2. Done with diffi-culty or pain. 	 n. (-तं) Sin, crime, guilt.  E. दुर् evil, कृत done, commit-ted. दुष्टं कृतम् प्रा० स० ।
दुष्कृतकर्मन्: दुष्कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, reprobate. 	 n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कृतकर्म्मन्: दुष्कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, reprobate. 	 n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कृतवहिष्कृत: दुष्कृतवहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Holy, free from sin. दुष्कृत, and वहिष्कृत excluded.
दुष्कृतिन्: दुष्कृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Wicked, an evil doer.  E. दुष्कृत, and इनि aff.
दुष्क्रम: दुष्क्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Difficult of access. 	 2. Going ill or laboriously. 2. Ill arranged, unmethodical.  E. दुर्, and क्रम going.
दुष्क्रीत: दुष्क्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dear, bought too dearly or unadvisedly.  E. दुर् bad, क्रीत purchased: a bad bargain.
दुष्ख: दुष्ख n. (-ष्खं) Pain in general: see दुःख ।
दुष्ट: दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Low, vile, 2. Weak, impotent. 	 3. Wicked, depraved. 	 4. spoiled, injured. 	 5. violated. 	 6. Contaminated, degraded. 	 7. Worthless. 	 f. (-ष्टा) A harlot, a wanton. 	 n. (-ष्टं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.  E. दुष् to be corrupt. &c. affix क्त.
दुष्टचारिन्: दुष्टचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked.  E. दुष्ट, and चारिन् practising. दुष्टं चरति चर-णिनि ।
दुष्टचेतस्: दुष्टचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) 	 1. Melevolent. 	 2. Stupid.  E. दुष्ट, and चेतस् the heart or mind.
दुष्टता: दुष्टता f. (-ता) 	 1. Wickedness, badness. 	 2. Contamination, defilement. 	 3. Violation.  E. तल् added to दुष्ट; also त्वं दुष्टत्वम् ।
दुष्टभाव: दुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Innately bad.  E. दुष्ट, and भाव nature.
दुष्टभावता: दुष्टभावता f. (-ता) Wickedness, innate depravity.  E. दुष्टभाव, and तल् aff.
दुष्टमति: दुष्टमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wicked, depraved.  E. दुष्ट, and मति mind.
दुष्टवृष: दुष्टवृष m. (-षः) A lazy ox.  E. दष्ट as above, and वृष an ox.
दुष्टव्रण: दुष्टव्रण m. (-णः) A dull boil or sore, a sinus.  E. दुष्ट bad, and व्रण sore.
दुष्टान्वित: दुष्टान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defiled, rendered impure.  E. दुष्ट, and अन्वित possessed of.
दुष्ठु: दुष्ठु ind. Ill, bad. 	 2. Improperly, incorrectly. 	 mfn. (-ष्ठुः-ष्ठुः-ष्ठु) Ill behaved, unprincipled, depraved.  E. दु ill, स्था to be, affix कु ।
दुष्पत्र: दुष्पत्र m. (-त्रः) Chor, a perfume.  E. दुर् bad, पत्र a leaf.
दुष्पर्श: दुष्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Not to be touched, unpleasant to the touch. m. (-र्शः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji:) see दुस्पर्श । दुर् + स्थल-कर्मणि खल् ।
दुष्पान: दुष्पान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Difficult to be drunk.  E. दुर्, and पान drinking. दुःखेन पीयते असौ खलर्थे कर्मणि युच् । भावे युच् वा ।
दुष्प्रकृति: दुष्प्रकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a bad nature or disposition.  E. दुर्, and प्रकृति naure दुःस्था प्रकृतिरस्य प्रा० ब० ।
दुष्प्रधर्षणी: दुष्प्रधर्षणी f. (-णी) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)  E. दुर् with difficulty, प्र before, धृष् to show, to guide, affix ल्युट्; also with णिनि affix दुष्प्रधर्षिणी ।
दुष्प्रधर्षा: दुष्प्रधर्षा f. (-र्षा) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 	 2. The date tree. E. दुर्, and प्र before, धृष् to guide, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
दुष्प्रमय: दुष्प्रमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Immeasurable, difficult to be measured.  E. दुर्, and प्र before, मी to measure, खल् aff.
दुष्प्रलम्भ: दुष्प्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Difficult of attainment.  E. दुर्, and प्र before, लभ् to gain, खल् affix, नुम् inserted.
दुष्प्राप: दुष्प्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Difficult of attainment, difficult to be got or reached.  E. दुर्, and प्राप obtaining.
दुष्प्राप्य: दुष्प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Remote, unattainable, difficult of approach or attainment.  E. दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable.
दुष्मन्त: दुष्मन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince of the lunar line, the husband of SAKUNTALĀ. E. दुर्, and झ affix, मुम्, aug; also read दुष्यन्त.
दुष्यन्त: दुष्यन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince: see that last.  E. दुष् to do wrong, झ aff.
दुस्तर: दुस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult to be crossed.  E. दुर्, and तर crossing.
दुस्त्यज: दुस्त्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Difficult to be relinquished or parted with. E. दुर् and त्यज abandoning.
दुस्सथ: दुस्सथ m. (-थः) 	 1. A dog. 	 2. A cock.
दुह: दुह (औ) दुहौ r. 2nd cl. (दोग्धि, दुग्धे) 3rd pers. plu. (दुहन्ति) To milk, (इर) दुहिर r. 1st cl. (दोहति) 	 1. To hurt, to afflict, to give pain. 	 2. To kill. अदा० उभ० द्विक० अनिट् । भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
दुह m. (धुक्) A milker.  E. दुह्, and क्विप् aff.
दुहत्: दुहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 	 1. Relinquishing, parting with. 	 2. Milking. E. दुह to milk, शतृ aff.
दुहितुःपति: दुहितुःपति m. (-तिः) A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.  E. दुहितृ a daughter, in the possessive case, and पति a husband.
दुहितृ: दुहितृ(-ता) A daughter.  E. दुह् to milk, (the mother,) Unadi affix तृच्, and इट् inserted.
दुह्य: दुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be milked, milkable.  E. दुह् to milk, affix क्यप्; also ण्यत्प्रत्ययं कृत्वा दोह्य ।
दू: दू (ओ, ङ) ओदूङ r. 4th cl. (दूयते) 	 1. To suffer or be consumed with pain. 	 2. To inflict pain or anxiety. दिवा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
दू f. (-दूः) Pain, distress.  E. दू, and क्विप् aff.
दूडभ: दूडभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Unfortunate, distressed.  E. दूर् difficult, दन्भ to deceive, deriv. irr. दुःखेन दभ्यते असौ दन्भ-कर्मणि खल् ।
दूडाश: दूडाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Pained, afflicted.  E. दुर bad, painful, दशि to hurt, deriv. irr. दुःखेन दाश्यते दुर् + दाश्-कर्मणि खल् ।
दूढ्य: दूढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Bad, vile.  E. दुर्, and ध्यै to meditate, क aff. दुष्टं ध्यायति दुर् + ध्यै-क ।
दूणाश: दूणाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Destroyed or annihilated with trouble or difficul-ty  E. दूर् before, णश् to destroy, deriv. irr. दुःखेन नाश्यते दुर् + नाशि-कर्मणि खल्.
दूत: दूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sent, despatched. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A messenger or envoy, a news-carrier. 	 2. An ambassador. 	 f. (-तिः-ती) A female messenger, a confidante, a procuress, a go-between. &c.  E. दु to go, Unadi affix क्त, and the vowel made long; or दू to suffer, affix क्त fem. affix क्तिन् or क्तिच् and optionally ङीप् ।
दूतघ्नी: दूतघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, resembling the Kadamba: see कदम्बपुष्पी.  E. दूत a messenger, घ्नी what destroys. दूतं खेदं हन्ति हन-टक् । ङीप् ।
दूति: दूति f. (-तिः) See दूत दु-वा ति दीर्घश्च ।
दूतिका: दूतिका f. (-का) A female messenger, a confidante, &c. see दूत, &c.  E. कन् added to दूति; also with the penultimate, vowel made long, दूतीका ।
दूत्य: दूत्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. An embassy, a message. 	 2. The abstract state or condi-tion of a message or a messenger.  E. दूत a messenger, and यत् aff.
दूद: दूद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Afflicting, harassing.  E. दू, and द what gives or occasions.
दून: दून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Suffering pain or fatigue. 	 2. Going, moving. 	 3. Shaken, agitated.  E. दु उपतापे to suffer, affix क्त ।
दूनवत्: दूनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Being agitated or distressed. 	 2. Gone, having gone.  E. दू to be agitated, क्तवतु aff.
दूर: दूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Distant, remote. 	 n. adv. (-रं) Far, far off. 	 2. Widely. deeply.  E. दुर with difficulty, इण् to go, Unadi affix रक्, deriv. irr. or दैप् शुद्धौ वा कू ।
दूरग: दूरग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 	 1. Going afar or a long way. 	 2. Remote.  E. दूर, and ग what goes.
दूरगामिन्: दूरगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going far. 	 m. (-मी) An arrow, &c.  E. दूर, and गामिन् what goes.
दूरतस्: दूरतस् ind. Afar, far off, from a distance, from afar.  E. दूर, and तसि aff.
दूरता: दूरता f. (-ता) Remoteness, distance.  E. दूर, and तल्; also with त्वं दूरत्वम् ।
दूरदर्शन: दूरदर्शन n. (-नं) 	 1. Foresight. 	 2. Long-sightedness. 	 m. (-नः) A vulture. E. दूर, and दर्शन seeing.
दूरदर्शिन्: दूरदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Long-sighted, far-seeing, (literally or metaphorically.) 	 m. (-र्शी) 	 1. A Pandit, a learned man, a teacher. 2. A prophet, a seer. 	 3. A vulture.  E. दूर far, and दर्शिन् who sees, from दृश् to see, with णिनि affix; also with क्विप् affix दूरदृश् ।
दूरदृश्: दूरदृश् m. (-दृक्) 	 1. A learned man. 	 2. A vulture: see the preceding.
दूरदृष्टि: दूरदृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Long-sightedness. 	 2. Foresight.  E. दूर, and दृष्टि sight.
दूरपातिन्: दूरपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Far going.  E. दूर, and पातिब् who goes.
दूरभाज्: दूरभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ज्) Distant.  E. दूर, and भाज् what shares.
दूरभिन्न: दूरभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Struck or wounded deeply.  E. दूर, and भिन्न divided.
दूरयायिन: दूरयायिन mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going far.  E. दूर, and यायिन् what goes.
दूरवस्त्रक: दूरवस्त्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked, undressed.  E. दूर, and वस्त्र clothes.
दूरवासिन्: दूरवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Residing in a foreign land, outlandish. E. दूर, and वासिन् who or what abides.
दूरविभिन्न: दूरविभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Unconnected by the ties of nature, of a differ-ent nature.  E. दूर, and विभिन्न separated.
दूरवेधिन्: दूरवेधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Missile, projectile, (weapons, &c.)  E. दूर afar, and वेधिन् what pierces or wounds.
दूरसंस्थ: दूरसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, distant.  E. दूर, and संस्थ what stays.
दूरसंस्थान: दूरसंस्थान n. (-नं) Being or residing at a distance.  E. दूर, and संस्थान site.
दूरस्थ: दूरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, far off.  E. दूर, and स्थ what stays or is; also दूरस्थित, and दूरस्थायिन्, &c.
दूराप्लाव: दूराप्लाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Jumping far.  E. दूर, and आप्लाव a leap.
दूरावस्थित: दूरावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Standing being or afar off.  E. दूर, and अवस्थित situated.
दूरीकरण: दूरीकरण n. (-णं) Removing, placing at a distance.  E. दूर, and करण making, च्वि aff.
दूरीकृत: दूरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Removed, placed afar off.  E. दूर, and कृत made, च्वि aff.
दूरीभूत: दूरीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remote, far off.  E. दूर, and भूत become, च्वि aff.
दूरेत्य: दूरेत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Far, distant.  E. दूर, and एत्य aff.
दूरेरितेक्षण: दूरेरितेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Squint-eyed.  E. दूर afar, ईरित sent, and ईक्षण sight.
दूर्वा: दूर्वा f. (-र्वा) Bent grass, commonly Durbā, (Panicum dactylon.)  E. दूर्व to hurt or be hurt, affix अच् or घञ्; fem. affix टाप् what hurts sin, or is injured by cattle. दूर्वति रोगान् अनिष्टं वा ।
दूर्वावण: दूर्वावण n. (-णं) A thicket of Durbā grass.  E. दूर्वा and वन wood; also with the final unchanged, दूर्वावन ।
दूर्य: दूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Fæces, ordure.  E. दूर far, या to go, aff. यत् । पुरीषे, शट्याम् च ।
दूर्य्य: दूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Fæces, ordure.  E. दूर far, या to go, aff. यत् । पुरीषे, शट्याम् च ।
दूलाश: दूलाश m. (-शः) Which is to be injured with difficulty.  E. दूडाश + डस्य वा लः । दःखेन हिंस्ये ।
दूश्य: दूश्य n. (-श्यं) A tent. see दूष्य । दू-खेदे सम्पदा, भावे क्विप् तां श्यायते गमयति अन्तर्भूतण्यर्थे श्यै गतौ क ।
दूष: दूष r. 4th cl. (दूष्यति) 	 1. To be or become bad. 	 2. To make bad.
दूषक: दूषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Ill, low, contemptible, infamous. 	 2. Spoiling, corrupting, contaminating, who or what does so.  E. दुष् to be vile, affixes णिच् and ण्वुल् ।
दूषण: दूषण m. (-णः) Rakshasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Blame, fault, defect, offence. 	 2. Spoiling, ruining, vitiating. defiling. 	 3. Violating, (as a girl.) 	 4. Breaking, (as an agreement.)  E. दूष् to become vile or wicked. affix भावे ल्युट् ।
दूषणारि: दूषणारि m. (-रिः) RĀMA.  E. दूषण the brother of RĀVANĀ, and अरि a foe.
दूषयाण: दूषयाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Vitiating, defiling, spoiling.  E. दूष् to make bad, शानच् aff.
दूषि: दूषि f. (-षिः-षी) The rheum of the eyes.  E. दूष् to make bad, affix इन् or क with ङीष् added; also दूषिका and दूषीका ।
दूषिका: दूषिका f. (-का) 	 1. The rheum of the eyes. 	 2. A pencil or painting brush.  E. दूष् to make bad, (the eyes, &c.) affix ण्वुल्, or स्वार्थे क वा, fem. form; also दूषी, दूषि and दूषीका ।
दूषित: दूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Calumniated, falsely accused, especially of adultery. 	 2. Contaminated, corrupted, spoiled. 	 3. Violated. 	 4. Blamed censured. 	 f. (-ता) A girl who has been violated or deflower-ed.  E. दूष् to become or make bad, affix क्त ।
दूषीका: दूषीका f. (-का) The secretion or rheum of the eyes.  E. दूष् to hurt, (the eyes,) Unadi affix ईकन्ः see दूषिका ।
दूषीविष: दूषीविष n. (-षं) Poison that may be overcome by drugs or charms, or that does not act upon the system.  E. दूषी rheum, and विष venom.
दूष्य: दूष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Reprehensible, contemptible, vile, bad. 	 f. (-ष्या) An elephant's leathern-girth. 	 n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Clothes. 	 2. A tent. 	 3. Pus, matter.  E. दूष् to be or become wicked or bad, यत् or ण्यत् affix, fem. affix टाप् ।
दृ: दृ r. 6th cl. usually with आङ् prefixed (आद्रियते) To reverence, to revere, to respect. r. 5th cl. (दृणोति) To hurt or kill. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दरति दारयति-ते) To fear, to be afraid of. तुदा० आ० सक० अनिट् । स्वादि० पर० सक० अनिट् । भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् । चुरा० उभ० ।
दृंहित: दृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased.  E. दृहि to increase, क्त affix.
दृक: दृक n. (-कं) A hole. दॄ विदारे कक् ह्रस्वश्च न कित्त्वम् ।
दृकाण: दृकाण m. (-णः) A demigod, presiding over the third part of a sign of the zodiac, (in Astrology.)
दृक्कर्ण: दृक्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A snake.  E. दृश् an eye, and कर्ण an ear; whose eyes are his ears in the opinion of the Hindus, the snake has no visible external ear.
दृक्प्रिया: दृक्प्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Beauty. 	 2. Splendor.  E. दृश् and प्रिय amiable.
दृक्श्रुति: दृक्श्रुति m. (-तिः) A snake.  E. दृश्, and श्रुति the ear; see दृक्कर्ण ।
दृगध्यक्ष: दृगध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The sun.  E. दृश् the sight, अध्यक्ष ruler.
दृग्गोल: दृग्गोल m. (-लः) A small circle on the axis of the earth, within the greater circle of the armillary sphere, and accompanying each planetary circle.  E. दृश्, and गोल circle.
दृग्विष: दृग्विष m. (-षः) A serpent or other such venomous reptile.  E. दृश् eye, and विष poison; whose eye is venomous.
दृङ्मण्डल: दृङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) A small circle within the great circles of the armillary sphere, accompanying each planetary circle or orbit.  E. दृश्, and मण्डल sphere.
दृडक: दृडक m. (-कः) A fire-place, or hole made in the ground for cooking.
दृढ: दृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Much, exceeding; (in this sense it is also an adverb declinable in the neuter gender.) 	 2. Hard, firm. 	 3. Able, powerful. 	 4. Bulky, massive, solid. 	 5. Strong. 	 6. Confirmed. 	 n. (-ढं) Iron.  E. दृह् to increase, affix क्त.
दृढकण्टक: दृढकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Dhaliākāra.  E. दृढ much or many and कण्टक a thorn.
दृढकाण्ड: दृढकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bamboo.  E. दृढ, and काण्ड a stem.
दृढकारिन्: दृढकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Persevering, determined.  E. दृढ and कारिन् who does, (any act.)
दृढगात्रिका: दृढगात्रिका f. (-का) Granulated sugar.  E. दृढ firm, गात्र substance, affix कप् ।
दृढग्रन्थि: दृढग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A bamboo.  E. दृढ, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
दृढता: दृढता f. (-ता) 	 1. Firmness, hardness. 	 2. Steadiness. 	 3. Solidity. 	 4. Strength.  E. तल् added to दृढ; also with त्वं दृढत्वम् ।
दृढदंशक: दृढदंशक m. (-कः) A shark.  E. दृढ hard, दंशक a biter.
दृढधन्वन्: दृढधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A good archer.  E. दृढ, and धन्वन् a bow.
दृढधुर्: दृढधुर् mfn. (-धूः-धूः-धु) Strong, able to bear a weight or load.  E. दृढ, and धुर् a burthen.
दृढनिश्चय: दृढनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted. E. दृढ, and निश्चय certainty.
दृढफल: दृढफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut.  E. दृढ hard, and फल fruit.
दृढबद्ध: दृढबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound or tied tightly.  E. दृढ, and बद्ध bound.
दृढबन्धिनी: दृढबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.)  E. दृढ firmly, बन्ध to bind, affixes णिनि, and ङीप्; winding closely round a tree or stem.
दृढभक्ति: दृढभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Faithful, devoted.  E. दृढ and भक्ति faith.
दृढमुष्टि: दृढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggardly close-fisted, m. (-ष्टिः) A sword, any weapon with a hilt or handle.  E. दृढ firm, and मुष्टि a handle, a fist.
दृढमूल: दृढमूल m. (-लः) The cocoanut.  E. दृढ, and मूल root.
दृढलोमन्: दृढलोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-मं) Having coarse hair on the skin. 	 m. (-मा) 	 1. A wild hog. 	 2. Coarse hair, bristles.  E. दृढ firm, stiff, and लोमन् the hair of the body.
दृढव्रत: दृढव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Observing steadily a religious vow or obligation, E. दृढ, and व्रत a vow.
दृढसन्धि: दृढसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्थिः-न्धि) 	 1. Strong knit, well fixed or compact, (the person, &c.) 	 2. Close, compact, free from interstices. 	 3. Closely connected or allied.  E. दृढ firm, and सन्धि union, a joint, &c.
दृढसूत्रिका: दृढसूत्रिका f. (-का) A plant from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see सूर्व्वा.  E. दृढ firm, and सूत्र a thread, a fibre, affix क ।
दृढसौहृद: दृढसौहृद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Firm in friendship, constant.  E. दृढ, and सौहृद friendship.
दृढस्कन्ध: दृढस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, a sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका.  E. दृढ firm, and स्कन्ध stem.
दृढाङ्ग: दृढाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm-bodied, hard, strong. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) A dia-mond.  E. दृढ, and अङ्ग body.
दृढार्त्ति: दृढार्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 	 1. The end of a bow. 	 2. Great pain.  E. दृढ, and आर्त्ति end of a bow, &c.
दृढाभक्ति: दृढाभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A faithful mistress or wife.  E. दृढा fem. form, and भक्ति attachment.
दृढायुध: दृढायुध m. (-धः) A hero, one firm in battle.  E. दृढ, and आयुध war.
दृत: दृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respected, honoured. 	 f. (-ता) Cumin.  E. दृ to res-pect, affix क्त.
दृति: दृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A bellows. 	 2. A fish. 	 3. A skin of leather, or a leather bag for holding water. 	 4. Skin, hide.  E. दृ to divide, क्तिन् aff.
दृतिधारक: दृतिधारक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Acanpātā.  E. दृति a bellows, and धारक having; having leaved compared to a leather bellows.
दृतिहरि: दृतिहरि m. (-रिः) A dog.  E. दृति here said to mean skin in general, and हरि who steals, from हृ with इन् aff.
दृतिहार: दृतिहार m. (-रः) A carrier of skins or bags, a water carrier, &c.  E. दृति, and हृ to take, अण् aff.
दृन्भू: दृन्भू m. (-न्भूः) 	 1. The thunderbolt. 	 2. The sun. 	 f. (-न्भूः) 	 1. A snake in general. 	 2. A wheel.  E. दृभ् to fear, Unadi affix कू, क्विप् and नुम् inserted; न being optionally changed to म, before भ, the word is also read दृम्भू ।
दृप: दृप r. 4th cl. (ञि ईर ऊ) ञि ईरदृपू (दृप्यति) 1. To be glad, to rejoice. 	 2. To be arrogant. to be vain or proud. r. 6th cl. (दृपति) To pain, to inflict pain, to torture. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्पति दर्पयति-ते) To light, to kindle or inflame. हर्षे गर्वे च अक० दिवा० वेट् । तुदा० पर० सक० सेट्० । भ्वा० पर० । चुरा० उभ० ।
दृप्त: दृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Proud, arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud, affix क्त.
दृप्यत्: दृप्यत् mfn. (-प्यन्-प्यती-प्यत्) Being proud or arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud, शतृ aff.
दृप्र: दृप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) 	 1. Strong, powerful. 	 2. Proud, arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud Unadi affix रक् ।
दृफ: दृफ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to hurt. तुदा० मुचादि० अक० पर० सेट् ।
दृब्ध: दृब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Strung, tied. 	 2. Afraid, frightened. 	 3. Pained, tortured.  E. दृभ् to pain, to string, affix कर्मणि कर्त्तरि वा क्त ।
दृभ: दृभ (ई) दृभी r. 6th cl. (दृभति) 	 1. To string, to arrange. 	 2. To give pain. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्भति दर्भयति-ते) To fear, to be afraid. तुदा० पर० सक० सेट् । भ्वा० पर० अक० । चुरा० उभ० ।
दृम्प: दृम्प r. 6th cl. (दृम्पति) To inflict pain, to torture. तुदा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
दृम्फ: दृम्फ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to torture. तुदा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
दृम्फू: दृम्फू f. (-म्फूः) A snake, in general.  E. दृम्फ to give pain, affix कूः see दृन्भू ।
दृम्भू: दृम्भू f. (-म्भूः) A snake, &c.: see दृन्भू ।
दृश: दृश (औ ईर) औदृशीर r. 1st cl. (पश्यति) To see. With उत् prefixed, 1. To see, to observe. 	 2. To anticipate, to foresee. 	 3. To doubt, to think doubtingly. भ्वा० पर० सक० अनिट् ।
दृश्: दृश् mfn. (दृक्) 	 1. A seer, a looker. 	 2. Wise, possessed of knowledge f. (-दृक्) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Sight, seeing.  E. दृश् to see, affix क्विप्ः also दृशा and दृशि, &c.
दृशद्: दृशद् f. (-शद्-शत्) 	 1. A stone, a rock. 	 2. A flat stone for grinding condiments upon.  E. दॄ to divide, Unadi affix अदि, augment षुक्, and ष changed to श; the crude form may also be दृषत् or दृषद्, &c.
दृशद्वती: दृशद्वती f. (-ती) 	 1. The name of a river which forms the eastern bound-ary of the Āryāvarta or holy land of the Hindus, running on the north-east of Delhi. 	 2. A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. दृशद् a stone or rock, and मतुप् poss. aff.
दृशा: दृशा f. (-शा) The eye. E. See दृश, टाप् being here added.
दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य: दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य n. (-ङ्क्ष्यं) A lotus, or rather a kind of nelumbium. E. दृश् the eye, काङ्क्ष्य to desire, with आङ् prefix, and यत् affix; desirable as an object of comparison to the eye.
दृशान: दृशान n. (-नं) Light. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of an Asura; also VIROCHANA 2. A holy or spiritual teacher. 	 3. A king, a ruler, a protector or cherisher of the world. 	 4. A Brāmhan.  E. दृश् to see, आनच् Unādi affix; by whom or which, sight, &c. is enjoyed.
दृशि: दृशि f. (-शिः or -शी) The eye. 	 2. A Sāstra.  E. दृश् to see, affix कि, ङीष् is optionally added.
दृशोपम: दृशोपम n. (-मं) The white lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)  E. दृशा the eye, उपमा resemblance; what resembles the eye.
दृश्य: दृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. Visible, to be seen. 	 2. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 m. (-श्यः) (In Arithmetic,) A given quantity or number.  E. दृश् to see, क्यप् aff.
दृश्यत्व: दृश्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Vision, sight.  E. त्व added to the last.
दृषद्: दृषद् f. (-पद् or -षत्) 	 1. A stone or rock. 	 2. A flat stone or plate on which spices, &c. are ground.  E. दॄ to divide, Unadi affix अदि, and षुक् augment; also दृशद्.
दृष्ट: दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen, visible, apparent. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Obvious danger or calamity.  E. दृश् to see, affix क्त ।
दृष्टकूट: दृष्टकूट n. (-टं) A riddle, an enigma.  E. दृष्ट seen, कूट trick.
दृष्टदोष: दृष्टदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Found out, exposed detected.  E. दृष्ट, and दोष fault.
दृष्टरजस्: दृष्टरजस् f. (-जाः) A girl arrived at puberty.  E. दृष्ट seen, (by whom,) and रजस् the menstrual discharge.
दृष्टवन्: दृष्टवन् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Seeing, beholding, having seen.  E. दृश् to see, क्तवतु aff.
दृष्टान्त: दृष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A science, a Sāstra. 	 2. An example, an illustration. 3. Death, dying.  E. दृष्ट obvious or seen, and अन्त end.
दृष्टि: दृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Sight, seeing. 	 3. Knowledge, wisdom. 	 4. The sight of the eye, the pupil. 	 5. Aspect, (of the stars.)  E. दृश् to see, affix भावे क्तिन्.
दृष्टिकृत्: दृष्टिकृत् n. (-कृत्) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)  E. दृष्टि the eye, कृ to make, affix क्विप् and तुक् added; also with क्त affix दृष्टिकृत n. (-तं) दृष्टिं करोति ।
दृष्टिगुण: दृष्टिगुण m. (-णः) A butt, a mark for archers, &c.  E. दृष्टि the eye, and गुण object.
दृष्टिनिपात: दृष्टिनिपात m. (-तः) A look, a look at or on.  E. दृष्टि, and निपात alighting.
दृष्टिपात: दृष्टिपात m. (-तः) A look, a glance.  E. दृष्टि, and पात falling.
दृष्टिपूत: दृष्टिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kept pure by the sight, i. e. watched, that no impropriety is committed, or impurity contracted.  E. दृष्टि, and पूत purified.
दृष्टिबन्धु: दृष्टिबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fire-fly.  E. दृष्टि sight, and बन्धु a friend.
दृष्टिविक्षेप: दृष्टिविक्षेप m. (-पः) A leer, a side glance.  E. दृष्टि the eye, विक्षेप casting.
दृष्टिविष: दृष्टिविष m. (-षः) A snake.  E. दृष्टि, and विष poison, venomous in his look.
दृष्ट्वा: दृष्ट्वा ind. Having seen.  E. दृश् to see, क्त्रा aff.
दृह: दृह r. 1st cl. (दर्हति) also (इ) दृहि r. 1st cl. (दृंहति) To grow, to increase, to prosper. भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
दृहित: दृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased, thriven.  E. दृह् to grow, affix क्त with इट् inserted; also from दृहि, दृंहित ।
दॄ: दॄ r. 9th cl. (दृणाति) To tear, to rend, to divide or pull to pieces. r. 1st cl. (दरति) To fear, to dread. क्या-प्वा० पर० अक० सेट् । भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । दिवा० पर० सक० सेट् । दीर्य्यति ।
दे: दे (ङ) देङ् r. 1st cl. (दयते) To preserve, to cherish or protect. भ्वा० आ० सक० अनिट् ।
देदीप्यमान: देदीप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining repeatedly or intensely, glowing, blazing.  E. दोप to kindle, intense, form, शानच् aff.
देय: देय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To given, fit or proper for a gift.  E. दा to give, कर्मणि यत् affix, and the vowel changed.
देव: देव (ऋ) देवृ r. 1st cl. (देवते) To sport or play. भ्वा० आ० अक० सेट् ।

देव m. (-वः) 	 1. A deity, a god. 	 2. A king, in poetical language. 	 3. A husbands's brother: see देवृ. 	 4. A cloud. 	 5. A fool, a dolt. 	 6. A child. 	 7. A man following any particular line or business. 	 8. A spear-man, a lancer. 	 9. Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 10. Sport, play. 	 11. A term or surname applicable to a Bramhan; also to a man of the kayestha class. 	 n. (-वं) An organ of sense. 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 	 2. A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. A goddess, the wife of any deity of divine being. 	 2. A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ. 3. A queen, one who has been consecrated as well as the king, (in the theatrical language chiefly.) 	 4. A respectful epithet or title applied to a woman of the first class. 	 5. Worship, reverence. 6. A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) 	 7. Another plant: see मूर्व्वा. E. दिव् to play, (in heaven, &c.) affix अच्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष् ।
देवक: देवक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 	 1. Who or what sports or plays. 	 2. Divine, celestial, like a deity. 	 m. (-कः) A proper name, the maternal grandfather of KRISHNA.  E. दिव् to play, ण्वुल् affix; or देव, and कन् aff.
देवकर्दम: देवकर्दम m. (-मः) A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower.  E. देव, and कर्दम mud.
देवकात्मजा: देवकात्मजा f. (-जा) The mother of KRISHNA.  E. देवक as above, and आत्मजा daughter.
देवकार्य: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods.  E. देव,, and कार्य्य business.
देवकार्य्य: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods.  E. देव,, and कार्य्य business.
देवकाष्ठ: देवकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A kind of pine: (Pinus devadaru.)  E. देव divine, and काष्ठ wood.
देवकिरी: देवकिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
देवकी: देवकी f. (-की) DEVAKĪ, the daughter of DEVAKA, wife of VĀSUDEVA, and mother of KRISHNA.  E. देवक, अञ् patronymic affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with the vowel changed by the affix, दैवकी.
देवकीनन्दन: देवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. देवकी as above, and नन्दन a son.
देवकीय: देवकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divine, belonging or relating to a divinity. E. देव, and छ aff.
देवकीसूनु: देवकीसूनु m. (-नुः) The deity KRISHNA.  E. देवकी as above, and सूनु a son; also similar compounds, as देवकीनन्दन, and देवकीपुत्र ।
देवकुण्ड: देवकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A natural spring.  E. देव, and कुण्ड a well.
देवकुल: देवकुल n. (-लं) A temple.  E. देव a god, and कुल a house.
देवकुसुम: देवकुसुम n. (-मं) Cloves.  E. देव a deity, and कुसुम a flower fit for a deity.
देवखात: देवखात n. (-तं) 	 1. A cave or hollow a midst mountains. 	 2. A natural pond or reservoir.  E. देव a deity, and खात dug; not the work of men.
देवखातक: देवखातक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A natural pond or one in front of a temple. 2. A natural cavern, a grotto.  E. देव a deity, खात dug, and कन् affix; dug by divine hands, or in honour of a god.
देवखातविल: देवखातविल n. (-लं) A cavern, a chasm.  E. देवखात, and विल a hole.
देवगान्धारी: देवगान्धारी f. (-री) One of the Rāginis, or female personification of the modes of music.
देवगायन: देवगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba, a celestial quirister.  E. देव a god, and गायन a singer.
देवगिरी: देवगिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
देवगुरु: देवगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. देव, and गुरु teacher; the preceptor of the gods.
देवगृह: देवगृह n. (-हं) 	 1. A celestial or planetary sphere, the dwelling of the gods. 	 2. A temple.  E. देव, and गृह house.
देवचिकित्सक: देवचिकित्सक m. du. (-कौ) The two sons of ASWINĪ, and physicians of heaven.  E. देव a god, and चिकित्सक a physician.
देवच्छन्द: देवच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) A garland or necklace of pearls, &c. composed of 100 strings.  E. देव a deity, and छदि to cover, affix घञ् ।
देवजग्ध: देवजग्ध n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass.  E. देव a deity, and जग्ध eaten.
देवजग्धक: देवजग्धक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass.  E. कन् pleonastic, added to the preceding.
देवट: देवट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) An artist, an artisan.  E. दिव् to sport, अटन् Unādi aff.
देवट्टी: देवट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.) गङ्गाचिल्ल्याम् ।
देवतरु: देवतरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig tree. 	 2. A tree of Swarga or paradise, the Mandāra tree. 	 3. The tree of plenty. 	 4. Any venerable and ancient tree: usually the place of assembling in a village.  E. देव a deity, and तरु a tree.
देवता: देवता f. (-ता) 	 1. A god, a deity or divine being. 	 2. Divinity; see देवत्व. E. देव divine, स्वार्थे तल् affix of the abstract: in the first case, अन् added; of whom the attribute is divinity.
देवतागार: देवतागार m. (-रः) A temple.  E. देवता, and आगार a house.
देवताड: देवताड m. (-डः) 	 1. A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 	 2. A name of Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 	 3. A name or fire. 	 4. A sort of creeper: see घोषक.  E. देव a deity, &c. तड् to torment, affix अण्.
देवताडक: देवताडक m. (-कः) A grass: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to देवताड ।
देवताधिप: देवताधिप m. (-पः) A name of INDRA.  E. देवता a deity, अधिप ruler or chief.
देवताभ्यर्चन: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol.  E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन wor-shipping.
देवताभ्यर्च्चन: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol.  E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन wor-shipping.
देवतायतन: देवतायतन n. (-नं) A temple.  E. देवता, and आयतन dwelling.
देवतीर्थ: देवतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) The part of the hand sacred to the gods, the tips of the fingers.  E. देव, and तीर्थ a shrine.
देवत्व: देवत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Divinity, the abstract attribute of divine being. 	 2. Identification with a deity, deification.  E. देव a deity, and त्व abs-tract affix; also with तल् देवता ।
देवदत्त: देवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by the gods, god-given. 	 m. (-त्तः) 1. The younger brother of Buddha. 	 2. The conch of ARJUNA. 	 3. One of the vital airs that which is exhaled in yawning E. देव a deity, and दत्त given; the name is often used in gram-matical and other examples, in the place of some one, a certain person, &c.
देवदत्ताग्रज: देवदत्ताग्रज m. (-जः) A name of Buddha.  E. देवदत्त as above, and अग्रज elder born.
देवदानी: देवदानी f. (-नी) A sort of creeper, commonly Hātighoshā.  E. देव a deity, and दान a gift, भावे ल्युठ् । fem. affix ङीष् ।
देवदारु: देवदारु mn. (-रुः-रु) A species of pine, (Pinus devadaru;) in Bengal it is usually applied to the Uvaria longifolia, and in the Peninsula to another tree, (Erythroxylon sideroxylloides.)  E. देव a deity, and दारु timber.
देवदासी: देवदासी f. (-सी) A courtezan, especially one employed as a dancer, &c. in a temple.  E. देव a deity, and दासी a female slave.
देवदीप: देवदीप m. (-पः) An eye.  E. देव an organ of sense, and दीप a lamp.
देवदूती: देवदूती f. (-ती) 	 1. A female messenger of the gods. 	 2. A sort of plant; also मधुकुक्कुटी.  E. देव, and दूती a messenger.
देवदेव: देवदेव m. (-वः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A name of SIVA.  E. देव god, repeated; god of gods.
देवद्रोणी: देवद्रोणी f. (-णी) The procession of a deity or idol.  E. देव a deity, द्रुण्, to go, affixes घञ् and ङीप् ।
देवद्र्यञ्च्: देवद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Approaching or adoring a deity.  E. देव an idol, अञ्च् to go to or to worship, affix क्विप्, and द्रि inserted.
देवधान्य: देवधान्य n. (-न्यं) A sort of grain cultivated in many parts of Hindustan, (Andropogon saccharatus.)  E. देव a deity, and धान्य corn.
देवधूप: देवधूप m. (-पः) A fragrant resin, (Bdellium,) used in the incense.  E. देव a deity, and धूप incense.
देवन्: देवन् m. (-वा) A husband's brother.  E. दिव् to play. अन् Unādi aff.
देवन: देवन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sport, play, pastime, &c. 	 2. Emulation, desire to excel or overcome. 	 3. Affair, business, profession. 	 4. Gaming. 	 5. Splen-dour, lustre, beauty. 	 6. Light. 	 7. Praise. 	 8. Motion. 	 9. Grief, sorrow. 	 10. A garden, a play or pleasure ground. 	 11. A lotus. 	 m. (-नः) A die or dice. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Service. 	 2. Sport, wanton sport or pastime.  E. दिव् to play, &c. affix ल्युट्, or युच्, fem. aff टाप् ।
देवनन्दिन्: देवनन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) One of INDRA'S doorkeepers.  E. देव a deity, and नन्दिन् who pleases.
देवनल: देवनल m. (-लः) A kind of reed, (Arundo bengalensis)  E. देव, and नल a reed; also read देवनाल ।
देवनारक: देवनारक m. (-कः) A superhuman being, also देवनामक ।
देवनिकाय: देवनिकाय m. (-यः) A heaven, a paradise, the residence of a divinity. E. देव, and निकाय abode.
देवनिन्दक: देवनिन्दक m. (-कः) A heretic, an unbeliever, a reviler of the gods. E. देव, and निन्दक a calumniator.
देवनिन्दा: देवनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Heresy. atheism.  E. देव, and निन्दा abuse.
देवनिर्मित: देवनिर्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Natural, created.  E. देव, and निर्मित made by.
देवपति: देवपति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA.  E. देव a deity, and पति master.
देवपत्नी: देवपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 	 1. The wife of a deity. 	 2. Sweet potato.  E. देव a deity, &c. and पत्नी wife.
देवपथ: देवपथ f. (-थः) Heaven, the firmament, the celestial path or way.  E. देव a deity, and पथिन् a road, final affix अ ।
देवपद: देवपद n. (-दं) The royal presence.  E. देव, and पद for पाद a foot; also देवपाद ।
देवपर: देवपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Addicted to play. 	 2. Future, what will be, (predestined, &c.) see दैवपर ।
देवपशु: देवपशु m. (-शुः) An animal consecrated to a deity.  E. देव, and पशु an animal.
देवपुत्त्री: देवपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) A medicinal plant: see पृक्का.  E. देव a deity, and पुत्त्री a daughter.
देवपुर: देवपुर f. (-पूः) The capital of INDRA.  E. देव a god, and पुर् a city.
देवप्रतिमा: देवप्रतिमा f. (-मा) An idol.  E. देव, and प्रतिमा image.
देवप्रश्न: देवप्रश्न n. (-श्नं) Astrology, consulting the stars or gods.  E. देव a deity, and प्रश्न asking.
देवबल्लभ: देवबल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria, Rox.) See पुन्नाम.  E. देव a deity, and बल्लभ a friend.
देवब्रह्मन्: देवब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्मा) A name of the Muni NĀRADA.  E. देव a deity, ब्रह्मन् BRAMHĀ; BRAMHĀ amongst the saints and demigods.
देवब्राह्मण: देवब्राह्मण m. (-णः) A venerable Brahman, one esteemed by deities. E. देव, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman or देवपूजकः ब्राह्यणः । देवले ।
देवभवन: देवभवन n. (-नं) 	 1. The holy fig tree. 	 2. Paradise. 	 3. A temple.  E. देव a deity, and भवन a dwelling.
देवभाज्: देवभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ग्) Belonging to a god.  E. देब, and भाज् what has.
देवभू: देवभू m. (-भूः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. Swarga or paradise.  E. देव divine, and भू being.
देवभूति: देवभूति f. (-तिः) The Ganges of heaven.  E. देव a deity, and भूति being, abiding. देवानामैश्वर्य्येच ।
देवभूय: देवभूय n. (-यं) 	 1. Divinity, godhead. 	 2. Inferior deification or identifica-tion with a deity.  E. देव a deity, and भूय being, becoming.
देवमञ्जर: देवमञ्जर n. (-रं) The jewel of KRISHNA suspended on his breast.
देवमणि: देवमणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. The jewel of KRISHNA. 	 3. A twist of hair on a horse's neck.  E. देव a deity, मणि a jewel.
देवमातृ: देवमातृ f. (-ता) A name of ADITI.  E. देव, and मातृ a mother; the mother of gods.
देवमातृक: देवमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Watered by rain, (corn, land, &c.)  E. देव a cloud, मातृ a mother, and कप् affix; cherished by the clouds as by a parent.
देवमानक: देवमानक m. (-कः) The jewel worn by KRISHNA: see कौस्तुभ.  E. देव a deity, मान respect, affix कन्. or कप्
देवमास: देवमास m. (-सः) The eighth month of pregnancy; also देवमासक.  E. देव divine, and मास a month.
देवयज्: देवयज् m. (-यक्) A worshipper of the gods.  E. देव, and यज् to worship, क्विप् aff.
देवयजि: देवयजि m. (-जिः) 	 1. A worshipper of the gods. 	 2. A Muni.  E. देव, and यजि who worships. देवं यजते यज्-इन्.
देवयज्ञ: देवयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The Homa or burnt sacrifice.  E. देव, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the sacrifice appropriated to the gods.
देवयात्रा: देवयात्रा f. (-त्रा) The procession of a deity or idol, or sacred festival when the images are carried in procession.  E. देव a god, and यात्रा going. देवानां यात्रा ।
देवयान: देवयान n. (-नं) The car or vehicle of god. 	 f. (-नी) The daughter of SUKRA.  E. देव a deity, and यान going. यायते अनेन या-करणे ल्युट् ।
देवयितृ: देवयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Sporting, playing.  E. देव to play, शतृ aff.
देवयु: देवयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) 	 1. Pious, righteous, virtuous. 	 2. Frequenting holy festivals. 	 m. (-युः) A deity.  E. देव a deity, या to go, Unadi affix कु ।
देवयोनि: देवयोनि m. (-निः) A superhuman being, a demon or demigod.  E. देव a deity, and योनि place of production.
देवर: देवर m. (-रः) A husband's brother, especially his younger brother. E. देव् to play, &c. affix अरच् । दीव्यते अनेन दिव-करणे अरच् ।
देवरथ: देवरथ m. (-थः) The car or vehicle of a deity.  E. देव a deity, and रथ a carriage.
देवराज: देवराज m. (-जः) INDRA.  E. देव a deity, राजन् a king, and टच् aff.
देवरात: देवरात m. (-तः) 	 1. A sort of crane. 	 2. The name of a king; also Parikshit.
देवरूपिन्: देवरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Godlike, of divine form.  E. देव, and रूप form. इनि aff.
देवर्षि: देवर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Rishi, a saint of the celestial class, as NĀRADA, ATRI, MARĪCHĪ, BHARADWĀJA, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, BHRIGU, VASISHTHA, PRACHETAS; also BHARATA, TUMBURU, KANĀDA, and others.  E. देव divine, and ऋषि a saint: see ऋषि, and राजर्षि ।
देवल: देवल m. (-लः) 	 1. An attendant upon an idol; a Brahman of an inferior order, who subsists upon the offerings made to the images which he attends, and who conducts the ceremonies of all sorts of people for hire. 	 2. A Muni; according to some authorities, a name of NĀ-RADA; to others, of a different saint, who is also a legislator, the son of ASITA and also named ASHTĀVAKRA. 	 3. A husband's bro-ther: see देवर. 	 4. A holy or virtuous man.  E. देव a deity, ला to bring, and क aff. or देव-कलच् ।
देवलक: देवलक m. (-कः) The attendant on an idol: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to देवल ।
देवलता: देवलता f. (-ता) Double jasmine.  E. देव divine, and लता a creeper.
देवलोक: देवलोक m. (-कः) 	 1. Heaven or paradise. 	 2. Any one of the seven superior worlds, from earth to the highest or Satya loka, in op-position to those below the earth. 	 3. The particular sphere or heaven of any divinity.  E. देव, and लोक a world.
देववक्त्र: देववक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) Fire or its deity AGNI.  E. देव a deity, and वक्त्र a face, here implying, mouth; the mouth of the gods, eating or con-suming the oblations made to them.
देववल्लभ: देववल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree: see पुन्नाग ।
देववर: देववर m. (-रः) A superior or supreme deity. 	 n. (-रं) A divine boon or blessing.  E. देव, and वर best.
देववर्द्धकि: देववर्द्धकि m. (-किः) A name of VIŚWAKARMĀ, the divine architect. E. देव a deity, वर्द्धकि a carpenter.
देववृक्ष: देववृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 2. A tree of heaven or paradise. 	 3. A plant yielding a fragrant resin, (Bdellium.)  E. देव a god, वृक्ष a tree.
देवव्रत: देवव्रत m. (-तः) 	 1. A worshipper of the gods. 	 2. A name of BHĪSHMA. n. (-तं) Any obligation or vow of a deity.  E. देव a deity, and व्रत religious obligation.
देवश्रुत: देवश्रुत m. (-तः) A god. 	 2. A sacred treatise or branch of scripture. 	 3. A name of NĀRADA.  E. देव divine, and श्रुत heard.
देवसभा: देवसभा f. (-भा) An assembly of the gods.  E. देव a deity, and सभा assembly.
देवसभ्य: देवसभ्य m. (-भ्यः) 	 1. A player, a gambler, a frequenter of clubs or assem-blies. 	 2. An attendant on a deity.  E. देव sport in general, or gam-bling, सभा an assembly, and यत् aff.
देवसन्ध: देवसन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Divine, relating to a deity.  E. देव, and सन्ध con-nected.
देवसहा: देवसहा f. (-हा) A small shrub: see सहदेवा.  E. देव a deity, सह् to bear, affixes टाप् and अञ् ।
देवसात्: देवसात् ind. In or on a deity, becoming as a deity, appropriate or offer-ed to one.  E. देव, and साति aff.
देवसायुज्य: देवसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) 	 1. Inferior deification, the state or being of the infe-rior gods. 	 2. Absorption into or identification with a deity.  E. देव a god, स with युज् to join or be joined, affix क्विप्, देवसयुज् junc-tion with a deity, ष्यञ् added, implying the state or condition.
देवसृष्टा: देवसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Spirituous liquor.  E. देव, and सृष्ट created, made by the gods.
देवसेना: देवसेना f. (-ना) 	 1. The daughter of INDRA. 	 2. An army or host of celes-tials.  E. देव Indra or any deity, and सेना an army.
देवसेनापति: देवसेनापति m. (-तिः) A name of SKANDA.  E. देवसेना as above, and पति ruler; commander of the hosts of heaven.
देवस्व: देवस्व n. (-स्वं) The property applicable to religious purpose, endowment, &c.  E. देव divine, and स्व wealth.
देवाजीव: देवाजीव m. (-वः) An attendant upon an idol, a low Brahman, subsist-ing by attendance upon an image, and upon the offerings made to it.  E. देव a deity, and आजीव who gets a livelihood; also इनि added देवाजीविन् m. (-वी.)
देवात्मन्: देवात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 	 1. One with or identified with a deity. 	 2. Belonging to a deity, consecrated, sacred. 	 m. (-त्मा) The holy, fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. देव, and आत्मन् the self or soul.
देवानाम्प्रिय: देवानाम्प्रिय m. (-यः) 	 1. A goat. 	 2. An ascetic, one who relinquishes or abandons the world. 	 3. A fool, an ideot.  E. देव in the second case plural, and प्रिय beloved; the beloved of the gods.
देवान्न: देवान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice or food that has been first presented to an idol. E. देव, and अन्न food.
देवापि: देवापि m. (-पिः) The son of PRATĪPA, supposed to be still alive, near the Sumeru mountain.
देवाभीष्ट: देवाभीष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sacred, dedicated to a deity. 	 f. (-ष्टा) Betel, (Piper betel.)  E. देव, and अभीष्ट wished.
देवायतन: देवायतन n. (-नं) A temple.  E. देव, and आयतन abode.
देवायुध: देवायुध n. (-धं) The rainbow.  E. देव, and आयुध a weapon.
देवालय: देवालय n. (-यं) 	 1. A division of heaven, the residence of the gods. 	 2. A temple.  E. देव, and आलय an asylum.
देवाला: देवाला f. (-ला) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.  E. देव a deity, and अल adopted to, fem. affix टाप् ।
देवार्ह: देवार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Divine, worthy of the gods.  E. देव, and अर्ह fit for.
देवावास: देवावास m. (-सः) 	 1. A temple. 	 2. The holy fig tree.  E. देव a deity, and आवास abode.
देवाश्व: देवाश्व m. (-श्वः) The horse of INDRA.  E. देव a deity, and अश्व a horse.
देविक: देविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Appertaining to or derived from a deity. E. देव, and ठन् affix; also देविय and देविल ।
देविका: देविका f. (-का) The name of a river, the Saraju or Deva.  E. देवी, and कन् affix, fem form.
देविल: देविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Virtuous, pious, just. 	 2. Appertaining to a deity: see देविक.  E. देव, and इलच् Unādi aff.
देवीकोट्ट: देवीकोट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A town, the city of VĀNA, probably DEVICOTTA, on the Coromandel coast.  E. देवी a name of DURGA, and कोट्ट a house or abode.
देवृ: देवृ m. (-वा) 	 1. A husbands's brother, but especially his younger brother. 2. The husband of a woman previously married.  E. दिव् to play, Unādi affix ऋण्.
देवेज्य: देवेज्य m. (-ज्यः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. देव a deity, and इज्य a tea-cher, the Guru or spiritual preceptor of the gods.
देवेष्ट: देवेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Acceptable to the gods, wished for by them E. देव, and इष्ट wished.
देवोद्यान: देवोद्यान n. (-नं) A sacred grove, one near a temple or consecrated to a deity.  E. देव a deity, and, उद्यान a garden.
देश: देश m. (-शः) 	 1. A country, a region, whether inhabited or uninhabited. 2. A part, a portion. 	 3. Institute, ordinance.  E. दिश् to point, to show, affix घञ् ।
देशक: देशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what shows, points out, describes, &c. m. (-कः) 	 1. A ruler, a governor. 	 2. A guide. 	 2. An instructor. E. दिश to command, affix ण्वुल् ।
देशकारी: देशकारी f. (-री) A mode of music, a Rāgini.
देशकालविद्: देशकालविद् mfn. (-विद्) Knowing what is suited to time and place.  E. देश, काल time, and विद् who knows.
देशकालव्यवस्थित: देशकालव्यवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regulated by time and place.  E. देश, and काल time, व्यवस्थित determined.
देशदृष्ट: देशदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Considered locally, judged as to place,  E. देश, and दृष्ट seen.
देशधर्म: देशधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Local law, the law of usage of the country,  E. देश, and धर्म्म moral merit.
देशधर्म्म: देशधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Local law, the law of usage of the country,  E. देश, and धर्म्म moral merit.
देशरूप: देशरूप n. (-पं) Propriety, fitness.  E. देश ordinance, रूप form, essence.
देशव्यवहार: देशव्यवहार m. (-रः) Local usage, custom of the country.  E. देश, and व्यवहार practice.
देशान्तर: देशान्तर n. (-रं) 	 1. foreign country. 	 2. Longitude or difference of long-itude.  E. देश, and अन्तर different.
देशापेक्ष: देशापेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Spying, searching out a land.  E. देश, and अपेक्ष who inspects.
देशिक: देशिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A traveller, a stranger, a so-journer. 	 2. A Guru or spiritual teacher.  E. देश a country, &c. ठक् aff.
देशित: देशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Directed, commanded. 	 2. Shown. 	 3. Advised, instructed.  E. दिश् to show, and क्त affix, with इट् inserted.
देशिन्: देशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 	 1. Of or belonging to a country. 	 2. Showing, instructing, guiding. 	 f. (-नी) The index or fore-finger.  E. दिश् to show, affix णिनि or देश्, and इनि aff.
देश्य: देश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. What is proper to be proved or ordered. 	 2. Local. 	 3. Present at any transaction, on the spot. 	 n. (-श्यं) 	 1. The postulate, the statement or exhibition of a question or argu-ment. 	 2. The fact or charge to be proved or substantiated. 	 m. (-श्यं) An eyewitness of any thing, one who was on the spot. E. दिश् to show or command, affix ण्यत्; or देश, and यत् aff.
देष्णु: देष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 	 1. Difficult of subjection, untamable, intract-able, ungovernable, Liberal in giving, a donor. 	 m. (-ष्णुः) A wash-erman.  E. दा to give, &c. इष्णुच् Unadi affix.
देह: देह mn. (-हः-हं) The body.  E. दिह to collect together, affix घञ् ।
देहकोष: देहकोष m. (-षः) 	 1. The skin. 	 2. A feather, a wing.  E. देह body, and कोष a sheath or covering.
देहक्षय: देहक्षय m. (-यः) Disease, sickness.  E. देह the body, and क्षय a wasting.
देहच्युत: देहच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Separated or detached from the body, (as excre-ment or the spirit, &c.)  E. देह, and च्युत fallen.
देहत्याग: देहत्याग m. (-गः) 	 1. Voluntary death. 	 2. Death in general.  E. देह, and त्याग leaving.
देहद: देहद m. (-दः) Quicksilver.  E. देह, and द what gives.
देहधारक: देहधारक n. (-कं) A bone.  E. देह the body, and धारक sustainer.
देहधि: देहधि m. (-धिः) A wing.  E. देह the body, धा to have, and कि aff.
देहधृज्: देहधृज् m. (-धृक्) Air, wind.  E. देह the body, धृज् to pervade, क्विप् aff.
देहभृत्: देहभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 	 1. Living-being. 	 2. Embodied, corporeal. 	 m. (-त्) Life, vitality.  E. देह the body, भृत् what has or supports.
देहयात्रा: देहयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Death, dying. 	 2. Food.  E. देह the body, यात्रा proceeding, (to or by which.)
देहला: देहला f. (-ला) Spirituous liquor.  E. देह the body, ला to seize, affix उ, and टाप् ।
देहलि: देहलि f. (-लिः or ली) 	 1. The threshold of a door, the lower past of the wooden frame of a door, or a raised terrace in front of it.  E. देह here said to imply plastering of cow-dung, &c. ला to have or get, affix कि or क, and ङीष् ।
देहसार: देहसार m. (-रः) Marrow.  E. देह, and सार essence.
देहवत्: देहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Corporeal, inhabiting a body.  E. देह, and मतुप् aff.
देहात्मवादिन्: देहात्मवादिन् m. (-दी) A Chārvāka, a materialist. देह, and आत्मन् the soul, and वादिन् who maintains; asserting that the body and soul are one.
देहावरण: देहावरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Armour. 	 2. Dress.  E. देह, and आवरण screening.
देहिका: देहिका f. (-का) A sort of insect, (a flea.)  E. देह the body, affix ठन्, and ठाप् ।
देहिन्: देहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 	 1. Corporeal, embodied, having body. 	 2. Living, a living being. 	 m. (-ही) The spirit.  E. देह, and इनि aff.
दै: दै (प) दैप् r. 1st cl. (दायति) To purify or cleanse.
दैतेय: दैतेय m. (-यः) A demon, an Asur, the Titan or giant of Hindu mytho-logy.  E. दिति the mother of the giants, and ढक् affix of descent.
दैत्य: दैत्य m. (-त्यः) A Daitya or demon: see the preceding. 	 f. (-त्या) 	 1. A perfume, commonly Mura. 	 2. A drug: see चण्डा. 	 3. Spirituous liquor. 	 4. The wife of a demon.  E. दिति, and ण्य aff.
दैत्यगुरु: दैत्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of SUKRA, regent of Venus.  E. दैत्य, and गुरु a teacher; the spiritual preceptor of the Daityas, or Titans.
दैत्यदेव: दैत्यदेव m. (-वः) 	 1. A name of VARUNA, deity of the waters. 	 2. Air or wind personified.  E. दैत्य a demon, and देव a god.
दैत्यपुरोधस्: दैत्यपुरोधस् m. (-धाः) A name of SUKRA.  E. दैत्य, and पुरोधस् a family priest: see दैत्यगुरु ।
दैत्यपुरोहित: दैत्यपुरोहित m. (-तः) A name of SUKRA, regent of Venus.  E. दैत्य, and पुरोहित a family priest.
दैत्यमातृ: दैत्यमातृ f. (-ता) A name of DITI, the mother of the Titanic race of Daityas.  E. दैत्य, and मातृ a mother.
दैत्यमेदजा: दैत्यमेदजा f. (-जा) the earth.  E. दैत्य, मेद marrow, ज born.
दैत्ययुग: दैत्ययुग m. (-गः) An age of the demons, consisting of 12,000 divine years, or the sum the four Yugs or ages of men.  E. दैत्य a demon, and युग an age.
दैत्यारि: दैत्यारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. a deity in general.  E. दैत्य, and अरि a foe; the enemy of the Daityas.
दैत्याहोरात्र: दैत्याहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day and night of demons, being a year of mortals. E. दैत्य a demon, अहन् a day, and रात्रि a night.
दैन: दैन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Diurnal, daily, relating to a day. 	 n. (-नं) Poverty, wretchedness.  E. दीन or दिन and अण् aff.
दैनन्दिन: दैनन्दिन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Diurnal, quotidian.  E. दिनदिन day by day अण् aff.
दैनन्दिनप्रलय: दैनन्दिनप्रलय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world after fifteen years of BRAMHA'S age.  E. दैनन्दिन, and प्रलय destruction.
दैनार: दैनार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Bought with a Dinar, of the value of one, &c. E. दीनार, and अण् aff.
दैनिक: दैनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Diurnal, of or relating to a day. 	 f. (-की) A day's hire wages.  E. दिन a day, affix ठञ् ।
दैन्य: दैन्य n. (-न्यं) 	 1. Meanness, covetousness. 	 2. Poverty, humbleness.  E. दीन a pauper, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
दैप: दैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Relating or belonging to a lamp.  E. दीप, and अण् aff.
दैर्घ्य: दैर्घ्य n. (-र्घ्यं) Length.  E. दीर्घ long, ष्यञ् aff.
दैव: दैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of or relating to divinity or a deity, divine, celestial, &c. 	 mn. (-वः-वं) Destiny, fate, fortune. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. The part of the hand sacred to the gods; the tips of the fingers, (some exclude the thumbs.) 	 2. One of the forms of marriage; the gift of a daughter at a sacrifice to the officiating priest. 	 f. (-वी) a division of medicine, the medical use of charms, &c.  E. देव a deity, and अण् affix of reference or relation.
दैवकर्मन्: दैवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Burnt-offering, oblations to the gods.  E. दैव, and कर्म्म rite.
दैवकर्म्मन्: दैवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Burnt-offering, oblations to the gods.  E. दैव, and कर्म्म rite.
दैवकी: दैवकी f. (-की) The mother of KRISHNA.  E. दैवक father of the lady, affix of descend अण्, fem. affix ङीष्ः see देवकी ।
दैवकीनन्दन: दैवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) KRISHNA.  E. दैवकी as above, नन्दन a son; also दैवकीनन्दन.
दैवकोविद: दैवकोविद mf. (-दः-दा) A conjuror or fortune-teller.  E. दैव fortune, and कोविद skillful.
दैवचिन्तक: दैवचिन्तक m. (-कः) A fatalist.  E. दैव, and चिन्तक who thinks of.
दैवचिन्ता: दैवचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Fatalism, reliance on fate.  E. दैव, and चिन्ता thinking also दैवचिन्तनम् ।
दैवज्ञ: दैवज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Prophetic, fore-telling, acquainted with fate. 	 m. (-ज्ञः) An astrologer. 	 f. (-ज्ञा) A female fortune-teller.  E. दैव, and ज्ञ who knows.
दैवत: दैवत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) 	 1. Of or relating to a god. 	 mn. (-तः-तं) 	 1. A god, a deity. 	 2. An idol. 	 n. (-तं) A number of gods.  E. देवता a deity, अण् pleonastic dor referential affix.
दैवदीप: दैवदीप m. (-पः) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. A heavenly lamp.  E. देव, and दीप a lamp.
दैवदुर्विपाक: दैवदुर्विपाक m. (-कः) Hardness of fortune, unpropitiousness of fate. E. दैव, and दुर्विपाक unfavourableness.
दैवपर: दैवपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Fated, willed, predestined. 	 2. Trusting to fate, a fatalist.  E. दैव fate, &c. पर after, according to.
दैवप्रश्न: दैवप्रश्न m. (-श्न) Astrology, fortune-telling.  E. दैव fate. &c. प्रश्न asking.
दैवयुग: दैवयुग m. (-गः) An age of the gods or immortals: see दैत्ययुग ।
दैवयोग: दैवयोग m. (-गः) The occurrence of unforeseen event, the intervention of destiny.  E. दैव, and योग juncture.
दैवलक: दैवलक m. (-कः) The servant or worshipper of an evil spirit.
दैवलेखक: दैवलेखक m. (-कः) An astrologer, a fortune-teller.  E. दैव fate लिख to write, ण्वुल aff.
दैववाणी: दैववाणी f. (-णी) A voice from heaven.  E. दैव and वाणी speech.
दैवाकरि: दैवाकरि m. (-रिः) 	 1. YAMA. 	 2. SATURN. 	 f. (-री) YAMUNĀ.  E. दिवाकर the sun, and इञ् patron. aff.
दैवात्: दैवात् ind. By chance, by accident, unavoidably, fatally. E. The 5th case of दैव used as a participle.
दैवानुरोधिन्: दैवानुरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Subject or obedient to the gods.  E. दैव divine (will), अनुरोधिन् assenting to.
दैवायत्त: दैवायत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Dependant upon destiny.  E. दैव, and आयत्त subject to.
दैवासुर: दैवासुर n. (-रं) The natural enmity between the gods and Asurs.  E. दैव, and असुर, with अण् added in this sense.
दैवाहोरात्र: दैवाहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day of the gods, the human year: see दैत्याहोरात्र ।
दैविक: दैविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to the gods, divine, deific, &c. E. देव a deity, and ठक् aff.
दैवोढा: दैवोढा f. (-ढा) A woman married according to the Daiva ritual.  E. दैव, and ऊढा married.
दैवोपहत: दैवोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky.  E. दैव, and उपहत struck by; also with कन्, दैवोपहतकः ।
दैव्य: दैव्य n. (-व्यं) Gate, fortune.  E. देव a deity and यञ् affix: see दैव ।
दैशिक: दैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Provincial, national, belonging to a country, produced in it, &c. देश, and ठञ् aff.
दैष्टिक: दैष्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fated, predestined. 	 m. (-कः) A predestinarian, a fatalist.  E. दिष्ट fate, affix ठक् ।
दैष्टिकता: दैष्टिकता f. (-ता) Fatalism, predestinarianism.  E. तल् added to दैष्टिक; with त्व, दैष्टिकत्वम् ।
दैहिक: दैहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Corporeal, bodily.  E. देहे भवः तस्थ इदं वा ठक् ।
दो: दो r. 4th cl. (द्यति) To cut, to divide: अव is usually prefixed.
दोःशिखर: दोःशिखर n. (-रं) The shoulder.  E. दोस्, and शिखर crest.
दोःसहस्रभृत्: दोःसहस्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) The name of a king, also called KĀRTA-VĪRYA. E. दोस् an arm, सहस्र a thousand, and भृत् possessing: having a thousand arms.
दोग्धृ: दोग्धृ mfn. (-ग्धा-ग्ध्री-ग्धृ) 	 1. A milker, who or what milks. 	 2. What yields milk. 	 m. (-ग्धा) 	 1. A poet, a panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward. 	 2. A calf. 	 3. A cowherd. 	 f. (-ग्धी) A cow.  E. दुह् to milk, तृच् aff.
दोदुल्यमान: दोदुल्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swinging or being swung repeatedly or violently.  E. दुल् to swing, intens, form, शानच् aff.
दोध: दोध m. (-धः) A calf.  E. दुह् to milk, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.
दोधक: दोधक n. (-कं) A form of metre.
दोधूयमान: दोधूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking or trembling violently  E. धू to shake, intens. form, शानच् aff.
दोरक: दोरक mf. (-रकः-रिका) A string for fastening the wires of a lute.
दोर्गडु: दोर्गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Crooked-armed. having a cripple or crooked arm. E. दोस् an arm, and गडु a cripple.
दोर्ग्रह: दोर्ग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Strong, powerful. 	 m. (-हः) Pain in the arm. E. दोस् an arm, and ग्रह who takes or uses.
दोर्दण्ड: दोर्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The arm.  E. दोस्, and दण्ड a stick.
दोर्मध्य: दोर्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle of the arm.  E. दोस् the arm, and मध्य the centre.
दोर्मूल: दोर्मूल n. (-लं) The armpit.  E. दोस् the arm, and मूल the root.
दोल: दोल m. (-लः) 	 1. Swinging. 	 2. A festival on the 14th of Phālgun, the swinging of the juvenile KRISHNA. 	 m. (-लः-ला or ली) 	 1. A litter, a swinging cot, a dooly. 	 2. A swing. 	 f. (-ला) The indigo plant.  E. दुल् to throw up or toss, to swing, affix अच्; fem. affix टाप् or ङीष् ।
दोलायमान: दोलायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Swinging, being swung. 	 2. Doubting, perplexed, vacillating.  E. दुल् to swing, causal form, शानच् aff.
दोलिका: दोलिका f. (-का) A swing.  E. कन् added to दोली ।
दोष: दोष m. (-षः) 	 1. Fault, defect, blemish. 	 2. Sin, offence, transgression. 3. Disorder of the humours of the body, or defect in the functions of bile, circulation, or wind. 	 4. A calf.  E. दुष् to be defective, affix घञ् ।
दोषक: दोषक m. (-कः) A calf.  E. कन् added to दोष ।
दोषकल्पन: दोषकल्पन n. (-नं) Reprehending, condemning.  E. दोष, and कल्पन attributing.
दोषग्राहिन्: दोषग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Malicious, malignant, censorious.  E. दोष a fault, ग्रह् to take, affix णिनि ।
दोषज्ञ: दोषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing faults, &c. 	 m. (-ज्ञः) 	 1. A Pandit, a teacher, a sage. 	 2. A physician.  E. दोष fault, defect, and ज्ञ who knows.
दोषत्रय: दोषत्रय n. (-यं) 	 1. Vitiation of the three humours, bile, wind, and phlegm. 2. Any combination of three defects.  E. दोष, and त्रय triad.
दोषप्रसङ्ग: दोषप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Censure, condemnation.  E. दोष, and प्रसङ्ग attribution.
दोषभाज्: दोषभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Wrong, faulty, doing wrong, being defective or to blame.  E. दोष, and भाज् who or what shares.
दोषवत्: दोषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Faulty, defective. 	 2. wicked.  E. दोष, and मतुप् aff.
दोषा: दोषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Night. 	 2. The arm. ind. (-षा) 	 1. By night, at night. 	 2. At the beginning of the night.  E. दम् to tame, ङीस् affix, and टाप् added.
दोषाकर: दोषाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Defective, faulty. 	 m. (-रः) The moon.  E. दोषा night, and कर a ray, or दोष and आकर a mine.
दोषातन: दोषातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Nocturnal, by night.  E. दोषा by night, द्यु aff.
दोषातिलक: दोषातिलक m. (-कः) A lamp.  E. दोष night, and तिलक excellence.
दोषास्य: दोषास्य m. (-स्यः) A lamp.  E. दोषा night, and आस्य a face.
दोषिक: दोषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Faulty, defective, bad. 	 m. (-कः) Sickness, disease.  E. दोष defect, ठन् aff.
दोषिन्: दोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) 	 1. Faulty, defective. 	 2. Wicked, bad.  E. दुष् to be defective, affix णिन् ।
दोषैकदृश्: दोषैकदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Malevolent, censorious, discovering defects only. E. दोष a fault. एक one, alone, and दृष् seeing.
दोस: दोस m. (-दोः) 	 1. The arm. 	 2. The side of a triangle, or square, &c. E. दम् to subdue, affix डोम् ।
दोस्क: दोस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Worn, &c. on the arms.  E. दोस् the arm, क aff.
दोस्थ: दोस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Placed on the arm. 	 m. (-स्थः) 	 1. Play, sport. 2. player, one who sports or plays. 	 3. Service. 	 4. A servant.  E. दु bad, स्था to stay, ड affix दुस्थ, अण् added.
दोह: दोह m. (-हः) 	 1. A milk-pail. 	 2. Milk. 	 3. Milking. 	 4. Satisfaction, success.  E. दुह् to milk, &c. affix घञ् ।
दोहज: दोहज n. (-जं) Milk.  E. दोह milking, and ज produced.
दोहडिका: दोहडिका f. (-कः) The Prakrit metre, commonly Doha; a stanza of four lines, containing thirteen and eleven syllabic instants alter-nately.
दोहद: दोहद n. (-दं) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. The longing of a pregnant woman, especially as a sign of impregnation.  E. दोह here said to mean satisfaction, and द what gives.
दोहदलक्षण: दोहदलक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. The fœtus, the embryo, sometimes confounded with womb. 	 1. The period of passing from one season of life to another, as from childhood to youth from youth to manhood. E. दोहद longing, and लक्षण a sign.
दोहदवती: दोहदवती f. (-ती) A pregnant woman longing for any thing.  E. दोहद as above, and मतुप् aff.
दोहदान्विता: दोहदान्विता f. (-ता) A pregnant woman longing for any thing.  E. दोहद as above, and अन्वित attached or become inherent.
दोहन: दोहन nf. (-नं-नी) A milk vessel, a milkpail. 	 n. (-नं) Milking.  E. दुह् to milk, affix ल्युट् ।
दोहल: दोहल m. (-लः) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. Longing. 	 f. (-ली) The Asoka tree. E. दोह satisfaction, and ल what gets: see दोहद ।
दोहलवती: दोहलवती f. (-ती) A pregnant woman longing for any thing: see दोहदवती ।
दोहापनय: दोहापनय m. (-यः) Milk.  E. दोह milking, अप below, णी to bring, affix अप् ।
दोहिन्: दोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Milking, a milker.  E. दुह् to milk, घिनुण् aff.
दोहीयस्: दोहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Yielding a great abundance of milk.  E. दोह milk, ईयसुन् aff.
दोह्य: दोह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be milked, milkable.  E. दुह to milk, ण्यत् affix, also दुह्य ।
दौःसाधिक: दौःसाधिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sort of head borough or beadle, the superin-tendent of a village. 	 2. A door keeper, a warder, a porter.  E. दुर् bad, difficult, साध् to accomplish, affix ठक् ।
दौकूल: दौकूल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Covered with silk, (a car, &c.)  E. दुकूल wove silk, affix अण् ।
दौत्य: दौत्य n. (-त्यं) An embassy or message.  E. दूत a messenger, affix ष्यञ्: see दूत्य ।
दौरात्म्य: दौरात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Wickedness, depravity.  E. दुरात्मन् wicked, ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्गन्धि: दौर्गन्धि n. (-न्धि) Fœtor, bad smell.  E. दुर्गन्ध ill smelling, and इञ् aff.
दौर्ग्य: दौर्ग्य n. (-र्ग्यं) Difficulty, Inaccessibility.  E. दुर्ग and ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्जन्य: दौर्जन्य n. (-न्यं) Wickedness, depravity, vileness.  E. दुर्ज्जन and ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्बल्य: दौर्बल्य n. (-ल्यं) Weakness, debility.  E. दुर्बल and ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्भागिनेय: दौर्भागिनेय m. (-यः) The son of a woman disliked by her husband. 	 f. (-यी) The daughter of such a woman.  E. दर्भगा such a woman, ढक् affix and इनङ् augment.
दौर्भाग्य: दौर्भाग्य n. (-ग्यं) Ill-luck, misfortune.  E. दुर् bad, भाग portion, ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्मनस्य: दौर्मनस्य n. (-स्यं) 	 1. Evil disposition or thought. 	 2. Despair. 	 3. Affliction, distress.  E. दुर्मनस् and ष्यञ् aff.
दौर्वीण: दौर्वीण n. (-णं) 	 1. The sap or juice of bent grass. 	 2. A clean leaf.  E. दूर्वा bent grass, and खञ् aff.
दौर्हृद: दौर्हृद n. (-दं) Wish, desire, but especially the longing of pregnant women.  E. दुर् pained, हृद् to heart, affix अण.
दौलेय: दौलेय m. (-यः) A turtle or tortoise.  E. दूली a female tortoise. affix ढक् ।
दौल्मि: दौल्मि m. (-ल्मिः) A name of INDRA.
दौवारिक: दौवारिक m. (-कः) A warder, a porter.  E. दु bad, वार impediment, and ठक् aff.
दौश्चर्म्म्य: दौश्चर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) Paraphymosis, circumcision.  E. दुश्चर्म्म and ष्यञ् aff.
दौष्कुलेय: दौष्कुलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sprung of a bad or low family or race. E. दुष्कुल of a bad race, affix ढक् also दुष्कुलीन.
दौष्ठव: दौष्ठव n. (-वं) Badness, wickedness.  E. दुष्ट and अण् aff.
दौष्मन्ति: दौष्मन्ति m. (-न्तिः) A name of BHARAT, the first sole monarch of India. E. दुष्मन्त DUSHMANTA, husband of SAKUNTALĀ, and father to BHARAT, इञ् affix of descent; it is perhaps preferably read दौष्यन्ति from दुष्यन्त.
दौहित्र: दौहित्र m. (-त्रः) A daughter's son. 	 f. (-त्री) A daughter's daughter. E. दुहितृ a daughter, affix अञ्.
द्यावाक्षमा: द्यावाक्षमा f. always dual, (-मे) Heaven and earth.  E. द्यौ heaven, क्षमा the earth, form irr.; also similar compounds, as द्यावापृथिवी, द्यावा-भूमी, &c.
द्यावापृथिवी: द्यावापृथिवी f. always dual, (-व्यौ) Heaven and earth.  E. द्यौ heaven, and पृथिवी the earth: see the preceding.
द्यावाभूमी: द्यावाभूमी f. always dual, (-भ्यौ) Heaven and earth.  E. द्यौ, and भूमी the earth: see the two words preceding.
द्यु: द्यु r. 2nd cl. (द्योति) 	 1. To advance towards or against, to assail. 	 2. To advance before or in front of, to approach.
द्यु m. (-द्युः) A name of AGNI or fire. 	 n. (-द्यु) 	 1. A day. 	 2. Heaven, sky, æther. 	 3. Heaven, paradise.  E. द्यु to go to or towards, affix क्विप् ।
द्युग: द्युग m. (-गः) A bird.  E. द्यु, and ग who goes.
द्युगण: द्युगण m. (-णः) A given term of days, as a month, &c.  E. द्यु, and गण a number.
द्युत्: द्युत् m. (द्युत्) A ray of light.  E. द्युत् to shine, affix क्विप्.
द्युति: द्युति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Light. 	 2. Beauty or splendour. 	 3. A ray of light. 	 4. Stimulating, exciting.  E. द्युत् to shine, affix कि.
द्युतिकर: द्युतिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Shining, bright. 	 2. Handsome. 	 m. (-रः) The polar star, or in mythology, the divine sage DHRUVA.  E. द्युति light, and कर who makes.
द्युतित: द्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enlightened, illuminated, &c.  E. द्युत् to shine, affix क्त; also with the vowel changed द्योतित्र ।
द्युतिमत्: द्युतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Resplendent, bright.  E. द्युति, and मतुप् aff.
द्युतिला: द्युतिला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.)  E. द्युति beauty, and ला to possess, affixes ड and टाप् ।
द्युनिवास: द्युनिवास m. (-सः) 	 1. Heavenly abode, heaven. 	 2. A deity.  E. द्यु, and निवास abiding.
द्युनिवासिन्: द्युनिवासिन् m. (-सी) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. A pious person.  E. द्यु, and निवासिन् who abides.
द्युनिश: द्युनिश n. (-शं) Day and night.  E. द्यु a day, निशा night.
द्युपति: द्युपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. A name of INDRA.  E. द्यु, a day or paradise, and पति ruler.
द्युमणि: द्युमणि m. (-णिः) The sun.  E. द्यु a day, and मणि a gem.
द्युमयी: द्युमयी f. (-यी) The daughter of VISWAKARMĀ, and wife of the sun. E. द्यु a day, and मयट् affix of identity.
द्युम्र: द्युम्र n. (-म्रं) 	 1. Wealth, property, substance. 	 2. Strength, power. E. द्यु day, म्रा to remember or regard, affix क ।
द्युवन्: द्युवन् m. (-वा) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Heaven.  E. द्यु to go (through the heavens,) Unādi affix कनिन्.
द्युषद्: द्युषद् m. (-षद् or -षत्) 	 1. A god, a deity. 	 2. A planet.  E. द्यु heaven, षद् to go, affix क्विप्; it is also written द्युसद्.
द्यूत: द्यूत mn. (-तः-तं) Gaming, playing with dice, or any thing not possess-ing life.  E. दिव् to play, क्त aff.
द्यूतकर: द्यूतकर m. (-रः) A gambler.  E. द्यूत and कर who practises.
द्यूतकार: द्यूतकार m. (-रः) 	 1. The keeper of a gaming house. 	 2. A gambler. E. द्यूत gaming, and कार who practises, also with कन् added, द्यूतकारक.
द्यूतकृत्: द्यूतकृत् m. (-कृत्) A gambler.  E. द्यूत, and कृत् who practises: see the last.
द्यूतपूर्णिमा: द्यूतपूर्णिमा f. (-मा) The day of full moon in the month Kartic, (October-November,) the night of which is spent in games of chance, in honour of the goddess of fortune, LAKSHMI.  E. द्यूत gaming, and पूर्णिमा day of full moon; also with अण् pleonastic affix added, and ङीष् fem. affix द्यूतपौर्णिमा, f. (-मी).
द्यूतप्रतिपत्: द्यूतप्रतिपत् f. (-पत्) The first day of the moon's increase in Kartic. when BALI is to be venerated.  E. द्यूत, and प्रतिपद् the first lunation.
द्यूतवीज: द्यूतवीज n. (-जं) A Couri, a small shell used as a coin in most parts of India.  E. द्यूत, gaming, and वीज seed.
द्यूतवृत्ति: द्यूतवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A gambler.  E. द्यूत  E. वृत्ति, subsistence.
द्यूतसभा: द्यूतसभा f. (-भा) A gaming house or assembly.  E. द्यूत and सभा an assembly.
द्यूताधिकारिन्: द्यूताधिकारिन् m. (-री) The keeper of a gaming house.  E. द्यूत, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.
द्यून: द्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Playing, sportive. 	 n. (-नं) The seventh sign of the zodiac, reckoning from that which the sun enters.  E. दिव् to play, &c. affix क्त.
द्यै: द्यै r. 1st cl. (द्यायति) To despise, to reprove, to treat or name with contempt.
द्यै ind. Fie, for shame.  E. द्यै, and क्विप् aff.
द्यो: द्यो f. (-द्यौ) 	 1. Heaven, paradise. 	 2. Heaven, sky.  E. दिव् to sport, Unādi affix डो आधारे; where the gods, &c. sport. द्योतन्ते देवा अत्र ।
द्योत: द्योत m. (-तः) Sun-shine, light, lustre, heat.  E. द्युत् to shine, भावे घञ् aff.
