द्योतन: द्योतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) Bright, shining. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Sight, seeing. 	 2. Making manifest. 	 3. Illumination. 	 4. An illumination. 	 m. (-नः) A lamp.  E. द्युत् to shine, affix भावे ल्युट् or शीलार्थेयुच् ।
द्योतमान: द्योतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, bright, radiant.  E. द्युत् to shine, शानच् aff.
द्योतयमान: द्योतयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Enlightening, irradiating.  E. द्युत् to shine, causal v. शानच् aff.
द्योतित: द्योतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Enlightened, &c. 	 2. Shining.  E. द्युत् to light, affix क्त ।
द्योतितप्रभ: द्योतितप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Resplendent.  E. द्योतित, and प्रभा splendor.

द्रुवय: द्रुवय n. (-यं) Measure in general.  E. द्रु a tree, and वय affix, implying measure.
द्रुसल्लक: द्रुसल्लक m. (-कः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida.)  E. द्रु a thing or substance, सल्लका the olibanum plant: a resinous plant.
द्रुह: द्रुह m. (ध्रुक्) An injurer.  E. द्रुह to hate, affix क्विप् ।
द्रुह r. 4th cl. (द्रुह्यति) To bear hatred, to seek to hurt or injure. दिवा० प० सक० सेट् ।
द्रुह m. (-हः) A son. 	 f. (-ही) A daughter.  E. द्रुह to hurt, affix क ।
द्रुहण: द्रुहण m. (-णः) A name of BRAMHĀ: see the next. द्रुं संसारगतिं हन्ति हन्-अच् ।
द्रुहिण: द्रुहिण m. (-णः) A name of BRAMHĀ.  E. द्रुह् to injure or hurt, (the wicked,) and इनन् affix, or द्रु a tree, (figuratively the universe,) हन् to destroy, इनि affix, destroyer of the world; न changed to ण; also द्रुहण ।
द्रुह्यत्: द्रुह्यत् mfn. (-ह्यन्-हन्ती-ह्यत्) 	 1. Attacking, assailing, defying. 	 2. Tyrannis-ing over, oppressing.  E. द्रुह् to hate, शतृ aff.
द्रू: द्रू r. 9th cl. (ञ) द्रूञ् (द्रूणोति, द्रणुते, द्रूणाति, द्रूणीते) 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. स्वा० क्य्रा० उ० सक० सेट् ।
द्रू m. (द्रूः) Gold.  E. द्रु to go, क्विप् affix, and the vowel made long.
द्रूघण: द्रूघण m. (-णः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. An iron club. 	 3. A sort of hatchet.  E. द्रु a tree, हन् to strike, affix अप्, घ and ण substituted for ह and न, and the vowel of द्रु made long; also optionally द्रुघण, द्रुघन, and द्रूघन ।
द्रूण: द्रूण m. (-णः) A scorpion; also द्रुण and द्रोण ।
द्रेक: द्रेक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) द्रेकृ (द्रेकते) 1. To sound. 	 2. To grow or increase. 	 3. To manifest joy or elevation by noise. भ्वा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
द्रेक्क: द्रेक्क m. (-क्कः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign.
द्रेक्काण: द्रेक्काण m. (-णः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign, the Decanus of European astrology, whence the word is probably derived.
द्रै: द्रै r. 1st cl. (द्रायति) To sleep; नि is usually prefixed.
द्रोण: द्रोण mn. (-णः-णं) 	 1. A measure of capacity, the same as an Āḍhaka: see आढक. 	 2. A measure of four Āḍhakas. 	 3. In common use, a measure of thirty-two Seers, or rather more than sixty-four lbs. avoirdupois. 	 4. The sixteenth part of a Khāri, or forty-eight gallons. m. (-णः) 	 1. A proper name, the military preceptor of the Pāndus. 2. A raven, or perhaps the carrion crow. 	 3. A scorpion: see द्रुण. 	 4. A large piece of water, one four hundred poles long. 	 5. One of the principal clouds. 	 6. A small tree bearing white flowers. 	 f. (-णिः-णी) 	 1. Any oval vessel made of wood, stone, &c. in the shape of a boat, and used for holding or pouring out water, as a bathing tub, a baling vessel, a bucket, a watering pot, &c. 	 2. A trough or rack for feeding cattle. 	 3. The name of country. 	 4. The name of a mountain. 	 m. (-णिः) The name of a river. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. The indigo plant. 	 2. The union of two mountains, the valley or chasm be-tween them. 	 3. A sort of boat, implying the sort of water vessel, probably described above. 	 4. A measure of capacity equal to 128 Seers.  E. द्रु to go, न or नि Unādi affix, and ङीष् added to either form.
द्रोणकाक: द्रोणकाक m (-कः) A raven.  E. द्रोण the same, and काक a crow.
द्रोणकाकल: द्रोणकाकल m. (-लः) A raven.  E. द्रोण as above, काकल here said to mean a crow, from का imitative sound, caw, and कल who utters.
द्रोणक्षीरा: द्रोणक्षीरा f. (-रा) A cow that yields a Dronā of milk.  E. द्रोण the measure so called, and क्षीरा milk; also other analogous compounds, ut infra.
द्रोणगन्धिका: द्रोणगन्धिका f. (-का) A plant: see रास्ना ।
द्रोणघा: द्रोणघा f. (-घा) A cow that yields a Dronā of milk.  E. द्रोण the measure, दुह् to milk, deriv irr.
द्रोणदुग्धा: द्रोणदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) A cow that yields a Dronā of milk.  E. द्रोण, and दुग्ध milk.
द्रोणदुघा: द्रोणदुघा f. (-घा) See the last.  E. द्रोण, and दुह to milk, affix कप्, and ह changed to घ.
द्रोणपुष्पी: द्रोणपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, known commonly by the same name; also गोशीर्षक.  E. द्रोण the measure, and पुष्प a flower.
द्रोणमाना: द्रोणमाना f. (-ना) A cow yielding a Dronā of milk.  E. द्रोण, and मान a measure: see द्रोणक्षीरा ।
द्रोणमुख: द्रोणमुख m. (-खः) The capital of a district, the chief of four hundred villages.
द्रोणम्पच: द्रोणम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Liberal in entertaining, one who cooks a Dronā.  E. द्रोण, and पच् to cook, स्वच् aff.
द्रोणाचार्य: द्रोणाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A proper name; Drona, the son of BHARADWĀJA, and the Achārya or teacher of the Pāndava princes. E. द्रोण as above, and आचार्य्य a preceptor; also with कन् added द्रोणाचार्य्यक ।
द्रोणाचार्य्य: द्रोणाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A proper name; Drona, the son of BHARADWĀJA, and the Achārya or teacher of the Pāndava princes. E. द्रोण as above, and आचार्य्य a preceptor; also with कन् added द्रोणाचार्य्यक ।
द्रोणिका: द्रोणिका f. (-का) The indigo plant.  E. द्रोणी the same, and कन् added.
द्रोणीदल: द्रोणीदल m. (-लः) A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)  E. द्रोणी a water vessel, and दल a leaf, the leaves being boat-shaped.
द्रोणीमुख: द्रोणीमुख m. (-खः) The principal of four hundred villages: see द्रोणसुख ।
द्रोह: द्रोह m. (-हः) 	 1. Mischief, malice, trespass, injury. 	 2. Offence, wrong. 3. Rebellion.  E. द्रुह् to hurt or injure, affix भावे घञ् ।
द्रोहचिन्तन: द्रोहचिन्तन n. (-नं) Injurious design, malice prepense; the wish, thought, or attempt to injure.  E. द्रोह as above, and चिन्तन thinking, meditating.
द्रोहाट: द्रोहाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A hunter, a deer-killer. 	 2. A sort of metre the Doha or stanza of Hindī poetry. 	 3. A religious impostor, a tar-tuffe, a hypocrite.  E. द्रोह injury, mischief, and अट who goes or is. द्रोहेण अटति अट-अच् ।
द्रोहिन्: द्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 	 1. Hurting, harming, endeavouring to hurt, malignant, malicious. 	 2. Rebellious.  E. द्रुह् to seek to hurt, घिनुण् aff.
द्रोणायण: द्रोणायण m. (-णः) A name of AŚWATTHĀMĀ, son of Drona.  E. द्रोण as above, and फक् affix; also with फिञ् affix. द्रौणायणि, इञ् affix द्रौणि ।
द्रौणिक: द्रौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sown with a Dronā of grain, (fields, &c.) f. (की) A vessel holding a Dronā by measure.  E. द्रोण the measure, ठञ् or ठन् affix; also with अण् and ङीष् affixes in the last sense. द्रौणी ।
द्रौपदी: द्रौपदी f. (-दी) A proper name. DRAUPADĪ, the daughter of DRUPADA, king of Panchāla, and the common wife of the five Pāndava princes.  E. द्रपद the father of this lady, and अण् and ङीप् affixes.
द्वन्द: द्वन्द m. (-न्दः) A clock or plate on which hours are struck. 	 n. (-न्दं) A pair, a couple, (male and female especially:) see the next.
द्वन्द्व: द्वन्द्व n. (-न्द्वं) 	 1. A pair, a brace. 	 2. A couple of animals, or male and female. 	 3. Union of the sexes or coupling. 	 4. Strife, dispute. 	 5. A secret. 	 m. (-न्द्वः) 	 1. A form of grammatical combination uniting two or more words in the same case, properly separated by a conjunc-tion, as रामलक्ष्मणौ RĀMA and LAKSHMANA; पाणिपादं hand and foot. 2. A sign of the zodiac (Gemini.) 	 3. A species of disease, a complication of two disorders, or compound affection of two humours.  E. द्वि two, reduplicate, deriv. irr.
द्वन्द्वचर: द्वन्द्वचर m. (-रः) The ruddy goose.  E. द्वन्द्व a couple, and चर who goes; flying in couples.
द्वन्द्वचारिन्: द्वन्द्वचारिन् m. (-री) The ruddy goose.  E. द्वन्द्व, and चर् to go, affix णिनिः see the last.
द्वन्द्वज: द्वन्द्वज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Produced or proceeding from morbid affection of two humours. 	 2. Proceeding from a pair, &c.  E. द्वन्द्व, and ज born.
द्वन्द्वदुःख: द्वन्द्वदुःख n. (-खं) Pain arising from alternation, as a heat or cold, pleasure or pain, &c.  E. द्वन्द्व, and दुःख pain.
द्वन्द्वभिन्न: द्वन्द्वभिन्न n. (-न्नं) Separation of the sexes.  E. द्वन्द्व, and भिन्न broken.
द्वन्द्वयुद्ध: द्वन्द्वयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Sigle combat.  E. द्वन्द्व, and युद्ध war. द्वयोर्द्वयोयुद्धम् ।
द्वन्द्वातीत: द्वन्द्वातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from worldly affections.  E. द्वन्द्व alternation (of pain and pleasure, &c.) and अतीत passed.
द्वय: द्वय mn. (-यः-यं) A pair, a couple, two, chiefly used in composition, as पुरुषद्वयं two men.  E. द्वि two, तयप् aff.
द्वयातिग: द्वयातिग m. (-गः) A saint, a holy or virtuous man.  E. द्वय a pair, the two bad qualities, passion and ignorance, अति beyond, and ग who goes.
द्वाःस्थ: द्वाःस्थ m. (-स्थः) 	 1. A warder, a porter. 	 2. NANDI, one of SIVA'S door-keepers.  E. द्वार् a door, and स्थ who stays; also द्वास्थ ।
द्वाःस्थित: द्वाःस्थित m. (-तः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार् a door, and स्थित staying; also द्वास्थित ।
द्वाःस्थितदर्शक: द्वाःस्थितदर्शक m. (-कः) A warder, a porter, a chamberlain.  E. द्वार् a door, स्थित staying, and दर्शक who shows, who introduces to the prince or great man to whom the mansion belongs; also द्वाःस्थित, and दर्शक severally; also द्वाःस्थितदर्शीन् m. (-र्शी.)
द्वात्रिंशदक्षरिन्: द्वात्रिंशदक्षरिन् m. (-री) A book or composition.  E. द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, अक्षर a letter, a consonant, इनि affix; formed of thirty-two letters.
द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेत: द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having thirty-two auspicious marks, illustrious, great.  E. द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, लक्षण a mark, उपेत possess-ing, endowed with.
द्वादश: द्वादश mf. (-शः-शी) Twelfth. 	 f. (-शी) The twelfth day of the half month E. द्वादशन्, and टच् aff.
द्वादशक: द्वादशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Consisting of twelve, amounting to twelve, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
द्वादशकर: द्वादशकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of VRIHASPATI. 	 2. A name of KĀBTIKEYA. E. द्वादश twelve, and कर a hand or ray.
द्वादशन्: द्वादशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Twelve.  E. द्वा for द्वि two, and दशन् ten.
द्वादशपत्रक: द्वादशपत्रक n. (-कं) A particular religious observance.  E. द्वादश, and पत्र leaf or part, कन् added.
द्वादशलोचन: द्वादशलोचन m. (-नः) The god KĀRTIKEYA.  E. द्वादश twelve, and लोचन an eye; the twelve-eyed, or six-headed deity.
द्वादशांशु: द्वादशांशु m. (-शुः) The deity VRIHASPATI, or planet Jupiter, over which he presides.  E. द्वादश twelve, and अंशु a ray.
द्वादशाक्ष: द्वादशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The god KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. The deity or sage Buddha. E. द्वादश twelve, and अक्ष an eye: the word is sometimes read in the second sense, द्वादशाख्य m. (-ख्यः) the twelve named.
द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्र: द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A prayer of twelve syllables, especially as address-ed to VISHNU, or Om, BHAGAVATE, VASUDEVAYA, RĀMĀYA. E. द्वादश, अक्षर a letter, and मन्त्र formulæ.
द्वादशाङ्गुल: द्वादशाङ्गुल m. (-लः) A measure of twelve fingers.  E. द्वादश, and अङ्गुल a finger.
द्वादशात्मन्: द्वादशात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The sun.  E. द्वादश twelve, and आत्मन् identity; being represented in and identified with the twelve Adityas, or the sun in each month of the year; also द्वादशात्मक ।
द्वादशायुस्: द्वादशायुस् m. (-युः) A dog.  E. द्वादश twelve, (years,) and आयुस् life.
द्वादशार्चिस्: द्वादशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) VRIHASPATI, regent of Jupiter, and precepter of the gods.  E. द्वादश twelve, and अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.
द्वादशार्च्चिस्: द्वादशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) VRIHASPATI, regent of Jupiter, and precepter of the gods.  E. द्वादश twelve, and अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.
द्वादशास्र: द्वादशास्र nf. (-स्रं-स्री) A parallelopipedon, a dodecagonal figure.  E. द्वादश, and अस्र an angle.
द्वापर: द्वापर m. (-रः) 	 1. The third of the four Yugas or great periods, compris-ing 864,000 years. 	 2. The age personified as a god. 	 3. Doubt, un-certainty.  E. द्वा for द्वि two, पर after.
द्वार्: द्वार् f. (-द्वाः) 	 1. A door, a gate. 	 2. A means, an expedient, a medium or way by which any thing takes place or is effected.  E. द्वृ to cover or hold, in the causal form, affix विच् ।
द्वार: द्वार n. (-रं) 	 1. A door, a gate, or rather the door or gateway, a passage, an entrance. 	 2. A way, a means, a medium or vehicle.  E. द्वृ to cover, affix अच् ।
द्वारक: द्वारक mf. (-कः-का) Dwarakā the capital of KRISHNA, supposed to have been submerged by the sea, but represented by a small island of the north part of the Malaber coast.  E. द्वार a way, (to salvation,) affix कन्; also द्वारिका, द्वारवती, &c.
द्वारकण्टक: द्वारकण्टक m. (-कः) A door, gate, the door itself.  E. द्वार a doorway, and कण्टक a thorn.
द्वारकेश: द्वारकेश m. (-शः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. द्वारक as above, and ईश master.
द्वारपाल: द्वारपाल m. (-लः) A warder, a door-keeper.  E. द्वार a door, and पाल who protects; also with कन् added द्वारपालक, or with the radical finals dropped द्वारप ।
द्वारपिण्डी: द्वारपिण्डी f. (-ण्डी) the threshold of a door.  E. द्वार a door, and पिण्ड a ball.
द्वारयन्त्र: द्वारयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A lock, a bolt.  E. द्वार a door, and यन्त्र an instrument.
द्वारवती: द्वारवती f. (-ती) The city Dwārakā.  E. द्वार a door, and मतुप् poss. affix; also द्वारावती ।
द्वारवलिभुज्: द्वारवलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) The Vaka, a sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.)  E. द्वार a door, वलि offal or fragments, and भुज् who eats.
द्वारशाखा: द्वारशाखा f. (-खा) The leaf of a door.  E. द्वार a door, and शाखा a branch.
द्वारस्तम्भ: द्वारस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) A door-post.  E. द्वार, and स्तम्भ a post.
द्वारस्थ: द्वारस्थ m. (-स्थः) A door-keeper.  E. द्वार a gate, and स्थ who stays.
द्वारिक: द्वारिक m. (-कः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार a door, and ठक् affix f. (-का) Dwārakā, KRISHNA'S capital: see द्वारक.  E. द्वार, and ठन् aff.
द्वारिन्: द्वारिन् m. (-री) A porter, a warder, a door-keeper.  E. द्वार, and इनि aff.
द्वास्थ: द्वास्थ m. (-स्थः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार् a door, स्थ who stays, and र rejected; also र being changed to Visarga, द्वाःस्थ ।
द्वास्थित: द्वास्थित m. (-तः) A door-keeper.  E. द्वार, and स्थित who stays; also द्वाःस्थित; see the last.
द्वास्थितदशक: द्वास्थितदशक m. (-कः) A door-keeper: see द्वाःस्थितदर्शक, &c.
द्वि: द्वि dual only. 	 mf. (-द्वौ) 	 n. (-द्वे) Two. 	 m. (-द्विः) Two, (of times, &c.) is only used in composition, as अतिद्वि a thing more than two, and inflected like other nouns in इः in composition with other nume-rals, it is changed to द्वा, as द्वादश twelve, द्वाविंशति twenty-two, द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, &c.
द्विक: द्विक m. (-कः) 	 1. A crow. 	 2. The ruddy goose.  E. द्वि two, and क the letter क, as in काक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Two. 	 2. Twice. 	 3. Two-fold. E. द्वि two, कन् pleonastic aff.
द्विककार: द्विककार m. (-रः) A crow.  E. द्वि two or twice, and ककार the letter क, as in काक.
द्विककुद्: द्विककुद् m. (-द्) A camel.  E. द्वि two, and ककुद् a hump.
द्विकर: द्विकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what makes two of any thing.  E. द्वि and कृ to make, अच् aff.
द्विगु: द्विगु m. (-गुः) A form of grammatical combination, that in which the first member of the compound is a numeral.
द्विगुण: द्विगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Twice, two times. 	 2. Multiplied by two, doubled.  E. द्वि two, and गुण number.
द्विगुणाकृत: द्विगुणाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्विगुणा twice, and कृत ploughed.
द्विगुणित: द्विगुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled, multiplied by two. 	 2. Folded, doubled. 	 3. Inverted, enveloped.  E. द्वि, and गुण a time, इतच् aff.
द्विगुणीकृत: द्विगुणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled. 	 2. Increased.  E. द्विगुण twice, कृत made, च्वि augment.
द्विगुणीभूत: द्विगुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled. 	 2. Augmented.  E. द्विगुण twice, भूत become, च्वि augment.
द्विज: द्विज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Twice born. 	 2. Oviparous. 	 m. (-जः) 	 1. A man of either of the three first classes, a Brahman, a Kshetriya or a Vaisya whose investiture with the characteristic string, at years of puberty, constitutes, religiously and metaphorically, their second birth. 	 2. Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, a fish, &c. first born in the shell, and in the second instance produced from it. 	 3. A tooth. 	 4. Coriander seed. 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. A sort of perfume also called Renukā. 	 2. A plant. (Siphonanthus Indicus.) 	 3. Kundur or gum olebanum.  E. द्वि two, and ज born. द्विः जायते । जन ड ।
द्विजकुत्सित: द्विजकुत्सित m. (-तः) A tree, (Cordia myxa.)  E. द्विज a bird, कुत्सित reviled, disregarded. द्विजैः कुत्सितः । (नोना आता) द्विजानां तद्भक्षण निषेधात् तथात्वम् ।
द्विजन्मन्: द्विजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) 	 1. Twice born, regenerate. 	 2. Oviparous m. (-न्मा) 	 1. A tooth. 	 2. A Brahman. 	 3. A bird. 	 4. A man of the three first classes. 	 5. Any oviparous animal: see द्विज.  E. द्वि twice, जन्मन् birth.
द्विजदास: द्विजदास m. (-सः) A Sudra or man of the fourth and servile tribe. E. द्विज a man of either of the three first castes, and दास a slave.
द्विजपति: द्विजपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. द्विज a Brahman, and पति master. १ चन्द्रे २ कर्पूरे ४ द्विजश्रेष्ठे ५ पक्षिश्रेष्ठे ६ गरुडे ।
द्विजप्रपा: द्विजप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough near a well for watering birds, cattle, &c. E. द्विज a bird, &c. and प्र prefixed to पा to drink, affixes अङ् and टाप्. द्विजार्थं पक्षिणमुद्दिश्य प्रषा । आलवाले ।
द्विजप्रिय: द्विजप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable or friendly to a man of the three first classes, or a Brahman especially. 	 f. (-या) The moonplant, (Asclepias acida.)  E. द्विज a Brahman, and प्रिय beloved, the acid juice being drank at certain sacrifices.
द्विजब्रुव: द्विजब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brahman by birth only, one not studied or not practising the duties of his caste.  E. द्विज a Brahman, and ब्रुव who speaks.
द्विजराज: द्विजराज m. (-जः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The great serpent ANANTA. 	 3. The bird and vehicle of VISHNU. 	 4. Camphor.  E. द्विज a snake or bird, and राज king. see द्विजपति.
द्विजलिङ्गिन्: द्विजलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A Kshetriya or man of the military tribe 2. An impostor, a pretended Brahman, wearing the distinguishing mark of that tribe without belonging to it.  E. द्विज twice born, and लिङ्ग a mark, इनि aff.
द्विजवर्य: द्विजवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An excellent or superior Brahman.  E. द्विज and वर्य्य excellent.
द्विजवर्य्य: द्विजवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An excellent or superior Brahman.  E. द्विज and वर्य्य excellent.
द्विजब्रण: द्विजब्रण m. (-णः) Gumboil, toothache.  E. द्विज a tooth, ब्रण a sore.
द्विजशप्त: द्विजशप्त m. (-प्तः) A sort of pulse; also called Rāja-māsh-kalai and Barbatti, (Dolichos catjang.)  E. द्विज a Brahman, and शप्त cursed; it is a prohibited food on some occasions.
द्विजशुश्रूषा: द्विजशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahmans, by the forth.  E. द्विज and शुश्रूषा service.
द्विजसत्तम: द्विजसत्तम m. (-मः) A respectable Brahman.  E. द्विज and सत्तम best; also द्विजवर द्विजप्रवर &c.
द्विजसेवक: द्विजसेवक m. (-कः) A Sudra or man of the fourth and servile class. E. द्विज a man of the three first classes, and सेवक a servant.
द्विजसेवा: द्विजसेवा f. (-वा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahman by the fourth.  E. द्विज, and सेवा service.
द्विजाग्र्य: द्विजाग्र्य m. (-ग्र्यः) A chief or respectable Brahman.  E. द्विज, and अग्र्य first.
द्विजाङ्गी: द्विजाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A medicinal plant; also कटुरोहिणी ।
द्विजाति: द्विजाति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. A man of either of the three first classes. 	 3. Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, &c.  E. द्वि two, जाति birth. द्विः जातिः जन्म यस्य ।
द्विजानुलोम: द्विजानुलोम n. (-मं) The regular order or series of the three first classes. E. द्विज, and अनुलोम with the hair.
द्विजायनी: द्विजायनी f. (-नी) The characteristic thread or cord which designates the three first classes of the Hindus.  E. द्विज twice-born, ल्युट् affix, fem. affix ङीप् । द्विजः अय्यते ज्ञायते अनया । यज्ञोपवीते ।
द्विजालय: द्विजालय m. (-यः) 	 1. The hollow of a tree. 	 2. The residence of Brah-mans.  E. द्विज a bird, or a Brahman, and आलय an asylum.
द्विजिह्व: द्विजिह्व (mfn.) (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Double-tongued, (literally or figuratively.) 	 m. (-ह्वः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. An informer. 	 3. A rogue, a scoundrel, a bad man. 	 4. A thief.  E. द्वि two, जिह्वा the tongue. द्वे जिह्वे यस्य ।
द्विजिह्वता: द्विजिह्वता f. (-ता) Insincerity, dishonesty.  E. तल् added to the last.
द्विजोत्तम: द्विजोत्तम m. (-लः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. A superior or excellent Brahman. E. द्विज the twice-born, (three first classes,) and उत्तम best.
द्विज्या: द्विज्या f. (-ज्या) The sine or chord of an arc.  E. द्वि, and ज्या sine.
द्विज्यामार्ग: द्विज्यामार्ग m. (-र्गं) A horizontal line.  E. द्विज्य, and मार्ग road.
द्विट्सेवा: द्विट्सेवा f. (-वा) Treachery.  E. द्विष् a foe, सेवा service.
द्विट्सेविन्: द्विट्सेविन् n. (-वी) A traitor.  E. द्विट् an enemy, and सेविन् who serves.
द्विठ: द्विठ m. (-ठः) Swāhā, the expression used with an oblation to fire. द्वौ ठकारौ लेखनाकारे यस्य । विसर्गे स्वाहायाम् । ठकारद्वये ।
द्वितय: द्वितय n. (-यं) A couple, a pair, two.  E. द्वि two, तयप् aff.
द्वितीय: द्वितीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Second. 	 2. Two. 	 m. (-यः) A son, a second or successor. 	 f. (-या) 	 1. A wife, according to the ritual, a woman wedded after the ceremony prescribed by the Vedas, a second self as it were. 	 2. The second day of the fortnight.  E. द्वि two, and तीय affix, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, द्वितीयक ।
द्वितीयत्व: द्वितीयत्व n. (-त्वं) The circumstance or state of second.  E. द्वितीय, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्वितीयता ।
द्वितीयत्रिफला: द्वितीयत्रिफला f. (-ला) A set of three fruits, the grape, the date, and the Gāmbhāri.  E. द्वितीय second, त्रिफल three fruits.
द्वितीयाकृत: द्वितीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed, &c. (a field)  E. द्वितीय a second time, and आकृत made.
द्वितीयाभा: द्वितीयाभा f. (-भा) A scitamineous plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhiza)  E. द्वितीय second, आभा lustre.
द्वितीयीक: द्वितीयीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Second.  E. द्वितीय, and ईकक pleonasm added.
द्वित्र: द्वित्र mfn. plu. always (-त्राः-त्राः-त्राणि) Two or three.  E. द्वि two and त्र for त्रि three.
द्विदत्: द्विदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Two-toothed.  E. द्वि two, दत् for दन्त a tooth; in marking age or period the compound is द्विदन्त.
द्विदन्त: द्विदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Old enough to have two teeth, &c.  E. द्वि, and दन्त a tooth, see the last.
द्विदण्डि: द्विदण्डि ind. Single stick, quarter staff, as द्विदण्डि प्रहरणं fighting with two sticks.  E. द्वि, दण्ड a staff, इच् affix; also similar compounds, as द्विमुषलि, &c.
द्विदश: द्विदश m. plu. (-शाः) Twenty, two tens.  E. द्वि, and दश ten.
द्विदाम्नी: द्विदाम्नी f. (-म्नी) A cow tied with two ropes.  E. द्वि, and दामन् a rope.
द्विदेह: द्विदेह m. (-हः) A name of GANESA.  E. द्वि two, and देह a body; having the head of an elephant, with the figure of a man. द्वाभ्यां देहोऽस्य ।
द्विदैवत्या: द्विदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The constellation Viśākhā.  E. द्वि two, दैवत a deity, and क्यप् affix; INDRA and AGNI jointly presiding over the asterism.
द्विघा: द्विघा ind. Of two kinds, in two ways.  E. द्वि two, धा aff.
द्विधाकरण: द्विधाकरण n. (-णं) Dividing into two parts, arranging in two ways, &c. E. द्विधा, and करण making.
द्विधागति: द्विधागति m. (-तिः) A crocodile.  E. द्विधा of two sorts, गति going; amphibious.
द्विधातु: द्विधातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Having two natures, two roots, &c. 	 m. (-तुः) A name of GANESA.  E. द्वि two or double, धातु nature: see द्विदेह । द्वौ धातू यत्र । धातुद्बयघटिते कांस्यरैत्यादौ, गणेशे च ।
द्विधात्मक: द्विधात्मक n. (-कं) A nutmeg.  E. द्विधा two sorts, and आत्मक being.
द्विधालेख्य: द्विधालेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) To be written in two ways. 	 m. (-ख्यः) The marshy date tree.  E. द्विधा, and लेख्य to be written or described. द्विप्रकारे लेखनीये हिन्तालवृक्षे च ।
द्विनग्नक: द्विनग्नक m. (-कः) A circumcised man, one having no prepuce.  E. द्वि two, नग्न naked, कन् added; exposed either by want of clothes or skin.
द्विनिष्क: द्विनिष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Bought, &c. with two Nishkas.  E. द्वि, and निष्क a measure of value; also द्विनैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
द्विप: द्विप m. (-पः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)  E. द्वि two, and प who drinks, the elephant imbibing fluids by his trunk, and thence conveying them into his mouth. द्वाभ्यां मुखशुण्डाभ्यां पिबति पा-क ।
द्विपथ: द्विपथ n. (-थं) A place where two roads meet.  E. द्वि two, पथिन् a road.
द्विपद: द्विपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Two-footed. 	 2. Having two parts. 	 3. Binomial. m. (-दः) A biped, including four genera, gods, demons. men, and birds.  E. द्वि, and पद for पाद a foot.
द्विपदराशि: द्विपदराशि f. (-शिः) Either of the signs, Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, Virgo, and half of Sagittarius.  E. द्विपद, and राशि a sign.
द्विपमद: द्विपमद m. (-दः) The elephant's temporal juice.  E. द्विप, and मद the exudation.
द्विपर्ण: द्विपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Two leaved, opposite-leaved.  E. द्वि, and पर्ण a leaf.
द्विपात्त्व: द्विपात्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The having of two feet, two parts, &c.  E. द्विपाद्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्विपात्ता.
द्विपाद्: द्विपाद् mfn. (-पाद्-पती-पत्) Biped, two-footed.  E. द्वि two, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
द्विपाद्य: द्विपाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Bought, &c. with two quarters. 	 n. (-द्यं) A double penalty, an amercement of twice the common amount. E. द्वि two, पाद a division, and यत् aff.
द्विपायिन्: द्विपायिन् m. (-यी) An elephant.  E. द्वि two, and पायिन् who drinks: see द्विप.
द्विपृष्ट: द्विपृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A proper name; also VASUDEVA. ब्रह्मसम्भवे राजभेदे ।
द्विप्रतिक: द्विप्रतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought, &c. with two Karshas.  E. द्वि, प्रति for कार्षापण, and ठन् added.
द्विबाहु: द्विबाहु mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु) Two armed.  E. द्वि, and वाहु an arm.
द्विभुज: द्विभुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Two armed. 	 2. An angle or the lines which form it.  E. द्वि two, and भुज an arm.
द्विमय: द्विमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of two, (parts of any thing.) E. द्वि, and मयट् aff.
द्विमातृज: द्विमातृज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having two mothers, born in two ways; it may be said of some of the deities, thus GANESA was the son of PĀRVATI, but not born in the usual way, being made of the scur of her body; see द्वैमातुर.  E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, and ज born. द्वाभ्यां मातृभ्यां जायते जन-ड ।
द्विमुख: द्विमुख m. (-खः) A serpent. 	 f. (-खा) 	 1. A small water jar. 	 2. A leech. E. द्वि, and मुख mouth; double-headed.
द्विमुखाहि: द्विमुखाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of serpent, (Amphisbœna.)  E. द्वि two, मुख face, अहि a snake; the double-headed snake.
द्विमुखोरग: द्विमुखोरग m. (-गः) A sort of snake: see the last.  E. द्विमुख as above, and उरग a snake.
द्विमूर्द्ध: द्विमूर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Two-headed.  E. द्वि two, मूर्द्धन् the fore-head, and यच् aff.
द्विर: द्विर m. (-रः) A bee: see द्विरेफ.
द्विरद: द्विरद m. (-दः) An elephant.  E. द्वि two, and रद a tooth, having tusks and teeth,
द्विरदान्तक: द्विरदान्तक m. (-कः) A lion.  E. द्विरद, and अन्तक destroyer.
द्विरशन: द्विरशन n. (-नं) Eating twice a day.  E. द्वि, and अशन् eating.
द्विरसन: द्विरसन m. (-नः) A snake in general.  E. द्वि two, रसना the tongue; double or forky-tongued.
द्विरात्र: द्विरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of two nights.  E. द्वि, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
द्विराप: द्विराप m. (-पः) An elephant.  E. द्विर् for द्वि two, आङ् prefixed to पा to drink, affix ड; drinking with the trunk and mouth: see द्विप ।
द्विरुक्त: द्विरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Repeated, said twice. 	 2. Said or told in two ways.  E. द्वि, and उक्त said.
द्विरुक्ति: द्विरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Tautology, repetition. 	 2. Variety of narration, telling any thing in two ways. 	 3. (In Grammar,) Repetition of a syllable.  E. द्वि, and उक्ति saying.
द्विरुढा: द्विरुढा f. (-ढा) A woman who has been twice married.  E. द्वि two, उढ a married woman.
द्विरूप: द्विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 	 1. Of two forms, having a different shape. 2. Spelled or written in two ways. 	 m. (-पः) 	 1. A word that may be correctly spelled in two ways. 	 2. Variety of interpretation or reading.  E. द्वि, and रूप form.
द्विरेफ: द्विरेफ m. (-फः) A large black bee.  E. द्वि two, रेफ the letter र; having two rs, in the most common name, भ्रमर, Bhramara.
द्विरेफवृन्द: द्विरेफवृन्द n. (-न्दं) A flight or swarm of bees.  E. द्विरेफ, and वृन्द a number.
द्विवर्ष: द्विवर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं) Two years old, &c. 	 f. (-र्षा) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year.
द्विवर्षिका: द्विवर्षिका f. (-का) A cow two years old.  E. द्विवर्ष, and कन् added.
द्विवर्षीण: द्विवर्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Two years old, two years standing, &c.  E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year, ख affix; also with ठञ् affix द्विवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) when futurity is implied, the first vowel is usually changed, as द्वैवार्षिक.
द्विवाहिका: द्विवाहिका f. (-का) A swing, a swinging cot, a litter.  E. द्वि two, वाह to bear, affix ण्वुल्; born usually by two men.
द्विविद: द्विविद m. (-दः) The name of monkey, slain by RĀMA or VISHNŪ in that incarnation.
द्विविदारि: द्विविदारि m. (-रिः) VISHNŪ.  E. द्विविद as above, अरि the foe.
द्विविध: द्विविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of two kinds, in two ways.  E. द्वि, and विध sort.
द्विवेशरा: द्विवेशरा f. (-रा) A kind of carriage.
द्विशफ: द्विशफ m. (-फः) Any cloven-footed animal.  E. द्वि and शफ a hoof.
द्विशस्: द्विशस् ind. Two, respectively.  E. द्वि two, and शस् aff.
द्विशीर्षक: द्विशीर्षक m. (-कः) A name of AGNI.  E. द्वि two, शीर्ष a head, and कन् added.
द्विशूर्प: द्विशूर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्प-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Bought with two winnowing baskets of any-thing.  E. द्वि, and शूर्प्प a basket; also with ठञ्, द्विशौर्प्पिक, mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
द्विशूर्प्प: द्विशूर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्प-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Bought with two winnowing baskets of any-thing.  E. द्वि, and शूर्प्प a basket; also with ठञ्, द्विशौर्प्पिक, mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
द्विशृङ्गिन्: द्विशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fish, commonly called Marmaka.  E. द्वि two, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.
द्विष: द्विष r. 1st cl. द्विषति also (औ) औद्विष r. 2nd cl. (द्वेष्टि-ष्टे) plu. (द्विषन्ति) To hate, to dislike, to be hostile or unfriendly. अदा० उभ० सक० अनिट् ।
द्विष्: द्विष् mfn. (द्विट्) Inimical, hostile. 	 m. (द्विट्) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, affix क्विप्; also with क affix द्विष m. (-षः) or mfn. (-षः-षा-षं.)
द्विषत्: द्विषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) 	 1. Hating or detesting, hostile. 	 2. Inimical, unfriendly. 	 m. (-न्) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, participal aff. शतृ.
द्विषतीताप: द्विषतीताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or harassing an enemy.  E. द्विषत् and ताप who afflicts, with च्वि augment.
द्विषन्तप: द्विषन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Punishing or annoying an enemy, revenging, retaliating.  E. द्विष an enemy, तप् to burn, affix खच्.
द्विष्ट: द्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, dislike. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Copper: see द्व्यष्ट.  E. द्विष् to hate, affix क्त.
द्विष्ठ: द्विष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Staying in two shapes or places, &c.  E. द्वि two, and स्थ what is or abides. द्वयो स्तिष्ठति स्था-क ।
द्विसप्ताह: द्विसप्ताह m. (-हः) A fortnight.  E. द्वि twice, सप्त seven, and अह a day. twice seven days.
द्विसम: द्विसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Consisting of two equal portions, &c.  E. द्वि two, सम equal. द्वि समे परिमाणमस्य ठञ् तस्य लुक् । द्विवर्षपरिमाणे.
द्विसमत्रिभुजा: द्विसमत्रिभुजा f. (-जा) An isosceles triangle.  E. द्वि, सम equal, त्रिभुजा triangle.
द्विसहस्राक्ष: द्विसहस्राक्ष m. (-क्षः) The great serpent, sovereign of the snake race, and the couch of VISHNŪ.  E. द्विसहस्र two thousand, and अक्षि an eye: the two thousand-eyed. द्विरावृत्तं सहस्रमक्षोणि यस्य, अनन्ते ।
द्विसीत्य: द्विसीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्वि twice, सीता a plough. and यत् aff.
द्विस्तन: द्विस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Two-breasted, two-uddered.  E. द्वि and स्तन breast.
द्विहन्: द्विहन् m. (-हा) An elephant.  E. द्वि two ways, with tusks and teeth, and हन् who kills.
द्विहल्य: द्विहल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्वि two, हल a plough, affix यत्.
द्विहायन: द्विहायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Two years old. 	 f. (-नी) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, हायन a year, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
द्विहृदया: द्विहृदया f. (-या) A pregnant woman.  E. द्वि two, हृदय a heart; having, one of her own and one in the fœtus.
द्विन्द्रियग्राह्य: द्विन्द्रियग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Perceptible by two senses or forms, by sight and touch, &c.  E. द्वि, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, ग्राह्य to be seized.
द्वीप: द्वीप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. An island, any land surrounded by water; the word is hence applied to the seven grand divisions of the terrestrial world, each of these being separated from the next, by a peculiar and circumambient ocean: the seven Dwīpas, reckon-ing from the central one are, Jambu, Kusa, Plaksha, Sālmalī, Krauncha, Sāka, and Pushkara: the central Dwīpa, or the known continent, is again portioned into ten divisions, likewise termed Dwīpas: viz. Kuru, Chandra, Varuna, Saumya, Naga, Kumārikā, Gabhastiman, Tāmrāpurna, Kaseru and Indra. 	 2. A tiger's skin. E. द्वि two, (on both sides,) and आप water, आ dropped and इ made long. द्विर्गता द्वयो र्वा दिशोर्गता आपोऽत्र । अ० समा० ।
द्वीपकर्पूरक: द्वीपकर्पूरक m. (-कः) China camphor.  E. द्वीप and कर्पूर camphor.
द्वीपवत्: द्वीपवत् m. (-वान्) The ocean. 	 mf. (-वान्-वती) A river. 	 f. (-वती) The earth. E. द्वीप an island, मतुप् possessive aff.
द्वीपिन्: द्वीपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Island, islander. 	 m. (-पी) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. An ounce or panther.  E. द्वीप an Island, इनि affix; haunting the small woody islands that abound in the rivers in India, or द्वीप a tiger's spotted skin, derived from द्वि two; इ to go or be, प affix: and इनि as before.
द्वीपिशत्रु: द्वीपिशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)  E. द्वीपिन् a tiger, and शत्रु obnoxious. शतावर्य्याम् । द्वीपिनः व्याघ्रस्य शत्रुरिव ।
द्वीप्य: द्वीप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Island, an islander, &c. 	 m. (-प्यः) 	 1. A sort of crow. 	 2. A name of VYĀSA.  E. द्वीप, and यत् aff.
द्वृ: द्वृ r. 1st cl. (द्वारति) 	 1. To accept, to appoint. 	 2. To cover.
द्वेधा: द्वेधा ind. In two ways: see द्विधा.
द्वेष: द्वेष m. (-षः) Hate, enmity.  E. द्विष to hate, affix घञ्.
द्वेषण: द्वेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Inimical, hostile. 	 m. (-णः) An enemy. 	 n. (-णं) Hate, enmity.  E. द्विष् to hate, and ल्यु or युच् aff.
द्वेषिन्: द्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse, obnoxious. 	 m. (-षी) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, णिन् aff.
द्वेष्टृ: द्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Hating, inimical, an enemy.  E. द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
द्वेष्य: द्वेष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्य) Hateful, detestable.  E. द्विष to hate, affix ण्यत् । द्वेष्टु-मर्हः यत् कर्मणि ण्यत् वा ।
द्वेष्यता: द्वेष्यता f. (-ता) Aversion, dislike, detestableness.  E. द्वेष्य and तल् aff.
द्वैगुणिक: द्वैगुणिक m. (-कः) A usurer, a money lender.  E. द्वि two, गुण number, affix ठक्; who requires cent. per cent.
द्वैगुण्य: द्वैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. Duality. 	 2. The possession of two out of the three qualities. 	 3. Doubling.  E. द्विगुण and अण् aff.
द्वैजात: द्वैजात mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Twice-born.  E. द्विजात, and अण् aff.
द्वैत: द्वैत n. (-तं) 	 1. Duplication, doubling or being doubled. 	 2. Duality, in philosophy, the assertion of two principles, as the distinctness of life and soul, spirit and matter, god and the universe.  E. द्वि two तल् affix, द्वित double, two-fold, abstract affix अण्. द्विधा इतं द्वीतं तस्य भावः स्वार्थे वा अण् ।
द्वैतवादिन्: द्वैतवादिन् m. (-दी) A philosopher who asserts two principles.  E. द्वैत, and वादिन् who asserts. द्वैतं जीवभेदं जीवेश्वरयोः भेदं वा वदति वद णिनि जीवभेदवादिनि जीवेश्वरयोः भेदवादिनि च नैयायिकादौ ।
द्वैतीयीक: द्वैतीयीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Second.  E. द्वितीय second, pleonastic affix अण् and ईकक् added.
द्वैध: द्वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Two-fold, of two sorts. 	 n. (-धं) 	 1. A double resource, a stratagem, a secondary arrangement or array, a reserve. 	 2. Contest, dispute, difference. 	 3. A two-fold form or state.  E. द्वैधम् and ड added.
द्वैधम्: द्वैधम् ind. In two ways.  E. द्वि, and धमुञ् aff.
द्वैधीकरण: द्वैधीकरण n. (-णं) Making two, separating, disuniting.  E. द्वैध and करण making, च्वि augment.
द्वैधीकृत: द्वैधीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Separated. 	 2. made into two, sundered. E. द्वैध and कृत made, च्वि augment.
द्वैधीभाव: द्वैधीभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Sowing dissension, causing tho separation of allies. 2. Dividing into two. 	 3. The nature or property of being two or distinct.  E. द्वैध, and भाव property, च्वि aff.
द्वैधीभूत: द्वैधीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being two, being separated or disunited.  E. द्वैध and भूत become, च्वि augment.
द्वैप: द्वैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 	 1. Made of a tiger's skin. 	 2. Island, islander. 	 m. (-षः) A car covered or hung with a tiger's skin.  E. द्वीप a tiger's skin, and अञ् aff.
द्वैपायन्: द्वैपायन् m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the author or compiler of the Vedas and Purānas.  E. द्वीप an island, फक् affix; the island-born, the place of his nativity being a small island in Jamunā.
द्वैप्य: द्वैप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of or belonging to an island.  E. द्वीप an island, यञ् aff.
द्वैमातुर: द्वैमातुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having two mothers, or the natural mother and a step-mother. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of GANESA. 	 2. An epithet of JARĀSANDHA: see जरासन्ध.  E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, अण् affix, उ substituted for the penultimate: see द्विमातृज.
द्वैमित्रि: द्वैमित्रि mfn. (-त्रिः-त्री-त्रि) Born of two friends, the children, &c.  E. द्वि, and मित्र a friend, इञ् aff.
द्वैयह्निक: द्वैयह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to two days.  E. द्व्यहन्, and ठञ् aff.
द्वैरथ: द्वैरथ m. (-थः) Single combat in chariots.  E. द्विरथ two cars, अण् aff.
द्वैरात्रिक: द्वैरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a period of two nights. E. द्विरात्र, and ठञ् aff.
द्वैवर्षिक: द्वैवर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) After two years, of or belonging to two years to come.  E. द्वि, वर्ष a year, ठञ् aff.
द्वैविध्य: द्वैविध्य n. (-ध्यं) The state of being two-fold.  E. द्विविध, and ष्यञ् aff.
द्वैहायन: द्वैहायन n. (-नं) The age of two years.  E. द्विहायन, and अण् aff.
द्व्यंश: द्व्यंश m. (-शः) Two shares.  E. द्वि, and अंश part.
द्व्यक्षर: द्व्यक्षर n. (-रं) A word of two syllables.  E. द्वि, and अक्षर a syllable.
द्व्यङ्गुल: द्व्यङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Measuring two fingers. 	 n. (-लं) Two fingers. E. द्वि two, अङ्गुलि a finger, if wood (काष्ठ) is implied, the fem. form is द्व्यङ्गुलि.
द्व्यञ्जल: द्व्यञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Measuring, &c. two Anjalis. 	 m. (-लिः) Two Anjalis collectively.  E. द्वि, and अञ्जलि a certain measure, टच् affix; also with the final retained द्व्यञ्जलि.
द्व्यणुक: द्व्यणुक n. (-कं) The aggregation of two atoms, the first step in the formation of substances, and when they become perceptible, The molecule of two atoms.  E. द्वि and अणु an atom, कन् added.
द्व्यन्य: द्व्यन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Accompanied, &c. by two others. 	 n. (-न्यं) Two others collectively.  E. द्वि, and अन्य another.
द्व्यर्थ: द्व्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Having two senses, meaning two things. 	 2. Having two objects. 	 m. (-र्थः) Two-fold meaning, double-entendre. E. द्वि, and अर्थ sense.
द्व्यष्ट: द्व्यष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper.  E. द्वि two, (metals; gold and silvers.) अश to pervade, affix क्त; mixed as alloy with the fine metals; also the य being interchanged with its congener इ, द्विष्ट.
द्व्यह: द्व्यह m. (-हः) Two days.  E. द्वि two, and अह a day.
द्व्यहीन: द्व्यहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of or belonging to two days.  E. द्व्यह, and ख aff.
द्व्यात्मक: द्व्यात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Comprising two, being two. 	 m. (-कः) A sign of the zodiac, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces.  E. द्वि, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.
द्व्यामुष्यायण: द्व्यामुष्यायण m. (-णः) A boy who remains heir to his father though adopted by another.  E. द्वि, and आमुष्यायण a certain person. अमुष्य प्रसिद्धस्यापत्यम् फक् आमुष्यायणः द्वयोरामुष्यायणः ६ तत् पु० स० ।
द्व्यायुष: द्व्यायुष n. (-षं) Two lives.  E. द्वि, and आयुष् life.
द्व्याहिक: द्व्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in two days.  E. द्व्यह, and ठञ् aff.
द्व्येकान्तर: द्व्येकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having two between, two off.  E. द्वि, and एकान्तर an interval, a line.
